title: Aprende colores con Hogi
description: Es muy fácil pintar los animales del mar con estas canciones. ¡Ven y pinta con nosotros! ¡Aprendamos los colores con Pinkfong!

title: Aprende Nombres con Hogi
description: ¡Aprendamos varias palabras con Hogi!

title: April Fool's Day
description: When Muffy St. John invited her college friends up to her parents’ secluded island home for the time of their lives, she just forgot to tell them it might be the last time of their lives.

title: April Wilkerson: This Old House Makers Channel
description: A master woodworker and welder April Wilkerson builds almost everything from scratch for her home. Working from her woodshop in the Texas Hill Country, there's not much April can't make.

title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
description: Join us as we travel beyond the glass, delving behind the scenes of Africa's premier Aquarium.  In this five-part adventure, we'll unpack the daily odyssey of the Two Oceans team.  Meet the local community of penguins, turtles, seals and jellyfish!

title: Aqui Entre Nos (LAS)
description: Cansado de ques su esposa y sus 3 hijas lo den por sentado, Rodolfo Guerra se levanta una mañana y decide no ir a trabajar. Entonces comienza la locura.

title: Arabian Inferno
description: The parched and barren landscape of the Arabian Peninsula offers a vivid backdrop for life in the harsh desert. Follow some of the desert’s most iconic creatures and learn the unique ways in which they’ve adapted to the stark conditions around them.

title: Arangol
description: La vida de un héroe anónimo que se convierte en el Cid Campeador del fútbol en un país en el que se juega béisbol.

title: Arañas en las Alturas
description: Un grupo de pasajeros encuentra su vuelo infestado de mortales arañas mutantes.

title: Arbitrage
description: Robert Miller is a New York hedge-fund magnate who appears to have it all—money, power, a loving wife working by his side, and a devoted daughter. But his fortunes turn when a deadly error threatens to destroy his financial empire and his family.

title: Arbor Demon
description: An adventurous married couple and an injured hunter are held captive inside a claustrophobic tent by a supernatural threat.  For an unknown reason, the tent has become their only safe haven.  Soon tensions rise inside the Arbor Demon.

title: Arcadia
description: Tom (John Hawkes) crams his three kids into a station wagon for the 3,000 mile journey from New England to California. His mood shifts as often as the landscapes zip by, and the kids feel their mother's presence receding with every mile.

title: Archangel
description: Daniel Craig stars as an Oxford historian who is in Moscow to attend a conference on the newly-opened Soviet archives. He becomes embroiled in a series of murders that seem to be getting closer to him.

title: Archie And Zooey's Cool Facts: Christmas Trees
description: Archie and Zooey’s Cool Facts Christmas Trees is a holiday-themed educational adventure for kids of all ages! School has never been so cool!

title: Archie And Zooey's Cool Facts: Emperor Penguins
description: Penguin explorers Archie and Zooey are on a thrilling mission to learn all they can about the cutest, goofiest and most beloved penguin this side of Antartica: the Emperor Penguin.

title: Archie's Weird Mysteries
description: Since a high school physics lab experiment went wrong, Riverdale has become a supernatural hotspot. There's excitement, chills, and lots of laughter. Join Archie and his pals as they do their best to unravel Archie's Weird Mysteries.

title: Architects of Darkness
description: Six one hour episodes each focusing on a key individual that traces the trajectory and design of Hitler’s thousand year Reich. These individuals were truly Architects Of Darkness of the Nazi Third Reich.

title: Architecture School
description: The six-part series from creators Michael Selditch and Stan Bertheaud follows a group of students at Tulane University's prestigious School of Architecture as they submit competing designs for an affordable home in Katrina-battered New Orleans.

title: Archive
description: 2049. A roboticist has been working on a true, human equivalent android and each prototype is an increasingly advanced version of his deceased wife.

title: Archivos de lucha contra el crimen
description: Casos inolvidables, protagonizados por dedicados detectives de homicidios y científicos forenses que persiguen a los autores.

title: Archy: Built for Speed, Born to Ride (2012)
description: When Matt Archbold started surfing back in 1979 at age 11 the world had no idea that it was about to witness one of the most explosive surfers to ever set foot on a surfboard.

title: Arctic Apocalypse
description: A massive influx of glacial melting triggers a new ice age in the Northern Hemisphere, forcing a family to make their away the across ice-covered landscape before they are frozen out for good.

title: Arctic Circle (Dubbed)
description: A Finnish detective and a German virologist pursue dangerous investigations in Lapland.

title: Arctic Manhunt Hunt for the Mad Trapper
description: In 1931, a stranger appeared out of nowhere in the Canadian Arctic. Months later, the North's biggest manhunt was launched to find the elusive murderer and thief. The fugitive's unknown identity died with him, never to be discovered until now.

title: Arctic Monkeys: Behind The Music
description: This British music documentary delves into the rise of the Arctic Monkeys, one of the most influential indie rock bands of the 21st century.

title: Arcángel
description: Daniel Craig interpreta a un ex historiador, que se encuentra en Moscú para asistir a una conferencia sobre los archivos soviéticos recién abiertos.

title: Ardennes Fury
description: As the Battle of the Bulge rages on, an American tank unit gets trapped behind Nazi lines. With just hours before the bombs of Operation Ardennes Fury fall, the tank's commander makes the risky decision to rescue an orphanage.

title: Are They Here? UFOs Caught on Camera
description: Award winning Fox Television Special, which includes never before seen UFO footage. This collection of clips and videos shot all over the world shed light on the long debated presence of aliens on planet earth.

title: Are You Here
description: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

title: Are You In The House Alone?
description: After moving to a new city, a beautiful high school student (Kathleen Beller) becomes the target of a campaign of terror and eventually becomes the victim of an attack and mental torture in this iconic and terrifying thriller. Dennis Quaid co-stars.

title: Are You Proud?
description: From legal victories to corporate rainbow colors, Ashley Joiner's documentary tracks half a century of campaigning against prejudice.

title: Are You Smarter Than a Fifth Grader?
description: Are you Smarter Than a 5th Grader? demonstrates exactly how much adults have forgotten since their elementary school days. Adult contestants team up with students to answer questions based on material from elementary school textbooks.

title: Are You Smarter Than a Fifth Grader?
description: Are you Smarter Than a 5th Grader? demonstrates how much adults have forgotten since their elementary school days. It's all up on the chalkboard again as adult contestants team up with students to answer questions based on material from elementary school.

title: Area 51
description: Three young conspiracy theorists attempt to uncover the mysteries of Area 51, the government's top secret location rumored to have hosted encounters with alien beings. What they find at this hidden facility exposes horrifying, unimaginable secrets.

title: Area Bombing
description: The story of the unprecedented Allied bombing campaign during WWII. At first, they target enemy manufacturers; next, the civilian populations.

title: Arena Series In 25
description: Monster Jam brings you all the action from the Arena Championship Series in every action packed 25-minute episode. Buckle up for Monster Jam! Every 25-minute episode is packed with non-stop action from the Arena Championship Series.

title: Arena Wars
description: In 2045, convicted criminals are given the opportunity to compete on the world's #1 televised sporting event, Arena Wars. They must survive 7 rooms and 7 of the most vicious killers in the country. If they win, they regain their freedom.

title: Arena: Produced by George Martin
description: This profile of legendary music producer Sir George Martin, with the help of his son Giles and wife Judy, contains contributions from Sir Paul McCartney, Ringo Starr, Michael Palin, and Cilla Black.

title: Argent: In Performance
description: Argent: IP offers a comprehensive retrospective assessment of the classic lineup of the band Argent. The documentary includes rare television footage of Rod Argent, Russ Ballard, Bob Henrit, and Jim Rodford performing live.

title: Aria
description: 10 of the world's greatest directors were commissioned to create short pieces based on the world's greatest opera music. Erotic, demented, funny, poignant, extravagant, and outrageous, the result is breathtaking and totally unique.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders set out to help the Master's Stage Line in their fight against saloon-boss Steve Taggert.

title: Arizona Days
description: Tex and sidekick Grass join McGill's traveling show. When Price has McGill's wagons burned, Tex becomes the county tax collector to earn money. This leads to trouble as one of those owing money is Price who says he will not pay.

title: Ark of The Covenant
description: It is a quest that has fascinated scholars and adventurers for centuries. What happened to that treasure and centerpiece of ancient Jewish life — the Ark of the Covenant?

title: Arkeo
description: Viajamos con el arqueólogo Peter Eeckhout para descubrir los sitios arqueológicos más espectaculares del mundo.

title: Armed and Deadly: Gang Wars
description: In this brand new series, we meet some of the UK's most feared Underworld leaders, to find out what it's really like to be a Gangster.

title: Armed and Deadly: Police UK
description: Britain's Armed Police Officers are busier than ever. Last year, they carried out more than 16,000 operations across England & Wales, that's one every 30 minutes.

title: Armed Response
description: The owners of a security firm begin conducting burglaries in their city to generate business. But they bite off far more than they can chew when they rob a mobster’s home.

title: Armin Only - Intense
description: Armin van Buuren's closing show of his Intenz World tour.

title: Armstrong
description: Dramatic, moving and insightful, ARMSTRONG tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong: From his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon, and unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

title: Army Dog
description: Ride Along with this four-legged military hero and his owner as they celebrate their return home from Afghanistan with a camping trip that puts their military skills to the test!

title: Army of One
description: The film is inspired by the true story of Gary Faulkner (Nicolas Cage), a handyman who receives a vision from God (Russell Brand) telling him to capture Osama bin Laden.

title: Arnold's Caribbean Pizza
description: A riotous sitcom centered around Jamaican businessman Arnold Brooks, who opens a unique Caribbean restaurant.

title: Arnold's Wrecking Company
description: A student tries pot for the first time, loves it and decides to distribute it in a big business kind of way. Soon he has the police and the mafia on his tail.

title: Around the Next Bend
description: Follow two daring adventurers as they embark on a 1,500 mile rafting expedition down India's Ganges River. They are forced to learn a new set of survival skills as they discover the vast and beautiful country of India.

title: Around the World in 80 Anthems
description: Narrated by Daymond John, this film follows Guinness World Record-setting 11 year old Capri Everitt and her family through 80 countries as she sings the national anthem in each country’s national language to raise money for orphaned kids.

title: Around the World in 80 Gardens
description: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens.

title: Arpo
description: Arpo was designed as a commando robot, built as a fierce fighting machine. But, with world peace achieved Arpo has been re-equipped for caregiving, re-coded for cuddling, and officially reassigned as Nanny Robot!

title: Arranged
description: Rochel is an Orthodox Jew and Nasira a Muslim. Both are going through the process of arranged marriages. With family pressure on the one hand and the outside world’s rejection of traditional values on the other, they rely their friendship to pull through.

title: Arrow
description: Oliver Queen was presumed dead for years before being discovered alive on a remote island. He returned home to Star City, bent on righting wrongs and fighting injustice. As the Green Arrow, he protects his city with the help of a team of vigilantes.

title: Arrows of Fire (2016)
description: ARROWS OF FIRE is more than just a chronicle of a father, his adult son and two friends on a picturesque motorcycle ride in the Australian Outback.

title: Art and Craft
description: A funny, fascinating, too-good-to-be-true documentary about Mark Landis, one of the world’s most prolific art forgers, who for over 30 years has duped museums across the country--until one determined registrar sets out to stop him.

title: Art of the Game: Ukiyo-E Heroes
description: A journey of discovery into how an American and a Canadian artists with a father and son generation gap team up to revive the ancient Japanese woodcut printing by juxtaposing traditional art with pop culture icons: Super Mario and Pokémon.

title: Art of the Prank
description: Joey Skaggs, Godfather of the media hoax, famed for such media fictions as Celebrity Sperm Bank, Cathouse for Dogs, Fat Squad, and Portofess, decides to pull off the most demanding hoax of his career.

title: Art Paul of Playboy Man Behind the Bunny
description: A feature-length documentary film on the life and impact of Art Paul, the founding art director of Playboy magazine, creator of the iconic bunny logo, and prolific artist, who blurred the lines between commercial and fine art.

title: Art School Confidential
description: A satirical look at the cult of celebrity in the story of a cop who goes undercover as an art student and gains critical acclaim for his work.

title: Arthur & Merlin
description: A young Celtic warrior and a hermit wizard must unite to defeat an evil druid.

title: Arthur Hailey's Detective
description: A serial killer on death row promises to reveal the truth about his past, the crimes he committed, and the crimes he confessed to—but only to the detective who helped to convict him.

title: Arthur Newman
description: A story of a man who fakes his own death and assumes a new identity in order to escape his life, who then moves in with a woman who is also trying to leave her past behind.

title: Article 99
description: "Article 99" is a fictitious hospital regulation at a Veterans' Administration hospital that promises full medical benefits...but, in fact, does not. A spunky surgeon and his compatriots try to thwart the bureaucracy.

title: Artik
description: A comic book obsessed serial killer teaches his son how to get away with a series of brutal murders.

title: As Dreamers Do
description: Behind every great mouse there is a man…Follow Walt Disney through his early life, as his ever-growing imagination and eternal optimism lead to the birth of a legend.

title: As Far as the Eye Can See
description: Jack Ridge is a former piano prodigy living on his family’s north Texas farmland. But his first public performance in years is threatened when he punches his fist into a wall. Jack is living in the past, but the future is coming for him.

title: As Good As Dead
description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

title: As It Happened: Guadalcanal
description: US Marines strike back on their first attack of the Pacific War. In horrific conditions US Marines fight a six month campaign of attrition against the seemingly invisible Japanese.

title: As It Happened: Iwo Jima
description: In the final year of World War 2, one of the most dramatic battles took place on the volcanic island of Iwo Jima, Japan. This dramatic documentary features the stories of the brave heroes who were on the ground that day fighting for our freedom.

title: As It Happened: Pearl Harbour
description: Take a look into the events that unfolded in Pearl Harbour, in 1941. Aerial reconnaissance photographs have been used to reconstruct Pearl Harbour to create an unprecedented vantage point on the most infamous attack of World War II.

title: As It Happened: Saipan
description: June 15th 1944, just nine days after D-Day in Normandy, on the far side of the world another invasion fleet was about to land its troops. The battle for the Island of Saipan would be savage, its capture to three, long, gruesome weeks.

title: As It Happened: Tarawa
description: Tarawa was the most strongly defended island in the Pacific which the Japanese boasted that a million Americans couldn’t take the island in one hundred years. On Tarawa the Marines faced their sternest test yet.

title: As Long As We Both Shall Live
description: After Malcolm tragically loses his wife, Sarah, he succumbs to depression until he meets Nya, who pulls him out of his shell. That's when he starts seeing his dead wife everywhere, terrorizing him at every turn, eroding his sanity.

title: As the Gears Turn
description: Meet the man, the champion, and off-road phenom Kurt Caselli. This unique and breathtaking film will show you the way of a true champ and where his love for motorcycles and the sport have taken him.

title: Asesina en fuga
description: Maya es objeto de la mafia rusa tras la muerte de su esposo. Al negarse a cooperar, es incriminada y enviada a prisión.

title: Asesinato al ritmo del tango
description: En este thriller evocador, un sicario experto (Robert Duvall) va a Buenos Aires para abatir a un general corrupto. Tras un repentino retraso de la operación, una sensual bailarina de tango le ha seducido y una conspiración mortal le ha traicionado.

title: Asesinato justo
description: Dos detectives veteranos de la ciudad de Nueva York (ganadores del Premio de la Academia® Robert De Niro y Al Pacino) buscan a un justiciero que puede ser uno de los suyos.

title: Asesinatos accidentales
description: Mike Fallon es un sicario experimentado conocido por hacer que la muerte de sus objetivos parezca un accidente. Cuando su novia aparece muerta, él va tras sus antiguos colegas para encontrar al responsable.

title: Asesinatos accidentales: unas vacaciones para morir
description: Mike Fallon está de regreso y debe vencer a los mejores asesinos del mundo, para proteger al hijo de un jefe de la mafia, salvar la vida de su único amigo y reavivar su relación con su figura paterna.

title: Asesinatos en cruceros
description: Es una serie de crímenes reales que narra las historias de personas que nunca regresaron a casa después de tomar unas vacaciones en un crucero, presentando entrevistas con familiares, amigos, investigadores y expertos.

title: Asesino a Sueldo
description: Slevin (Josh Hartnett) se marcha de Los Ángeles, por un error de identidad cae en medio de una guerra entre los dos jefes criminales más temidos de la ciudad: El rabino (Ben Kingsley) y el jefe (Morgan Freeman).

title: Asesino Kung Fu
description: Donnie Yen es un asesino y experto en kung fu, reclutado por la policía para rastrear a un asesino a cambio de recuperar su libertad.

title: Asesino perfecto
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme se enfrenta a su oponente más letal hasta el momento, él mismo, cuando interpreta tanto a un atroz asesino en serie como al clon replicado que los científicos han construido para matarlo.

title: Asesino por naturaleza
description: Sean, un joven pintor de casas, no tiene rumbo ni apegos en su vida. Duke, su jefe, le pide que mate a un hombre que amenaza los negocios turbios en los que están involucrados él y su empleador, Matthews. Sean acepta, por un precio.

title: Asesinos en serie
description: Un condecorado detective de homicidios, viaja a través del depravado inframundo de Memphis para enfrentarse a un perverso asesino serial en este thriller de acción.

title: Asesinos internacionales
description: Asesinos disfuncionales intentan matar a Gunther (Arnold Schwarzenegger), el asesino a sueldo más infame de todos los tiempos, en esta divertida comedia de persecución entre aspirantes a criminales.

title: Asesinos Seriales del Siglo XXI
description: En esta serie documental sobre crímenes, destaca algunos de los asesinos en serie más notorios del siglo XXI.

title: Ash vs Evil Dead
description: Chainsaw-wielding Ash fights to save the world from evil with Pablo and Kelly, and unexpectedly makes a shocking discovery.

title: Asher
description: An aging hitman's last job goes sideways, forcing him to redeem himself.

title: Ashes to Agassiz
description: It’s been a journey, you could say. A real barnburner. A man at the top of his professional prowess, his mountain bike a natural extension of him, one of the best riders the sport has ever seen. But like all great heroes, adversity comes a-knocking.

title: Ashfall
description: In the face of a disaster that will engulf both North and South Korea, a mission is put into action to stop a super volcanic eruption.

title: Ashgrove
description: Dr. Jennifer Ashgrove - one of the world's top scientists - is battling to find a cure to a crisis that affects the world's water supply.

title: Ashley Jones is Perfectly Normal
description: Ace reporter Ashley Jones has a perfectly normal life until she meets a 500,000-year-old woman and strange things start happening to her. Can she make sense of her new upside-down world and is being "different" her new normal?

title: Asia - Secret Lives, Hidden Places
description: Follow us into the unfamiliar and fascinating lands of Asia, where opulent images allow us to experience the unique beauty of nature and the stories of people and animals that live in a world that remains untouched.

title: Asia's Monarchies
description: Journey to the heart of these beautiful lands to understand the relationship between the people and their monarchs. To many, their monarchy is an anachronism – an institution that hampers progression. To others it is the heart and soul of their nation.

title: Asia: In Performance
description: Get the inside track on the band and their music, from some of their peers and industry experts.

title: Asia: Live Legends
description: Some classic performances from Asia.

title: Ask the Dust
description: Arturo Bandini, a young would-be writer who comes to Depression-era Los Angeles to make a name for himself. While there, he meets beautiful barmaid Camilla, a Mexican immigrant who hopes for a better life by marrying a wealthy American.

title: Ask This Old House
description: Ask This Old House features some familiar faces, including Kevin O'Connor, general contractor Tom Silva, plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey, and landscape contractor Roger Cook—and we make house calls!

title: Askari
description: Mientras tanto, Emma, una huérfana de 16 años, se esfuerza por adaptarse a la vida en una reserva de animales en África dirigida por sus tíos, ella desarrolla un fuerte vínculo con uno de los elefantes recién nacidos.

title: Assassin's Bullet
description: A woman is killing off int'l bad guys (and witnesses). An ex FBI new man at the American Embassy in Sofia, Bulgaria, is put in charge of investigating the vigilante's actions there.

title: Assassination Tango
description: John J. is a seasoned hit man sent on a job to Argentina. When the General he's sent to kill delays his return to the country, John passes the time with Manuela, a beautiful dancer who becomes his teacher and guide into Argentina's world of the tango.

title: Assassinaut
description: A team of four teenage astronauts brave the alien wilderness of a distant planet to save the Earth's President from a deadly assassin.

title: Assault on Precinct 13 (1976)
description: The isolated inhabitants of an abandoned police station are under attack by the overwhelming numbers of a seemingly unstoppable street gang.

title: Assault On Wall Street
description: Jim, an average New Yorker, lives with a sick but loving wife. Suddenly, everything changes when the economy crashes and causes him to lose everything. Filled with anger and rage, Jim goes to seek revenge for the life taken from him.

title: Assaulted - Civil Rights Under Fire
description: Dead Patriot Films presents Assaulted: Civil Rights Under Fire, a documentary that brings audiences to the center of the controversy over the issue that is dividing our nation  gun control.

title: Assholes: A Theory
description: Ever get the impression that assholes are taking over? Assholes: A Theory, a timely new doc from John Walker, investigates the breeding grounds of contemporary asshole culture and searches for signs of civility in a rude-'n-nasty universe.

title: Assignment Outer Space
description: In the 22nd Century, Ray Peterson, reporter for the Interplanetary News, is assigned to write a story aboard a space station. Tension mounts between Peterson and the station commander, who believes he is in the way, but has orders to leave him alone.

title: Assimilate
description: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH) and Randy (Calum Worthy) discover that people are being killed and replaced by duplicates. Their only chance to survive is to record the takeover in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

title: Assistant Motives
description: When a young woman accepts a position as a receptionist, she finds herself falling for the boss, and entering a world of drama and danger.

title: Astaroth
description: Shrouded by the mists of time, the demon Astaroth has been forgotten. But there is always someone there to remember…

title: Asterix and the Mansion of the Gods
description: When Julius Caesar plans to build an opulent mansion right next to their village, aiming to tempt the locals away from their traditional ways, it’s up to Asterix and Obelix to outwit the Romans.

title: Asteroid-a-geddon
description: A global summit fails to stop a massive asteroid headed for Earth. With the outlook now bleak, a young tech genius assembles a team of specialists, and using cutting edge aeronautics, they try to stop the asteroid before it’s too late.

title: Asteroide
description: Un hombre de familia desconectado se muda con su esposa y su hija de la gran ciudad a la casa de sus sueños en las afueras de un pequeño pueblo justo a tiempo para el apocalipsis.

title: Astraea
description: When disease nearly wipes out the human race, a telepathic teenage girl named Astraea believes her visions confirm that survivors are living in Northern Canada. She leads her doubting brother on a five thousand mile journey, through a silent America.

title: Astro Boy
description: A crime-fighting young robot named Atom finds himself battling the harsh realities of the world in his pursuit of justice.

title: Astro Boy
description: In futuristic Metro City, scientist Tenma (voiced by Nicolas Cage) creates an amazing robot boy with hidden talents unlike anything you've ever seen.

title: Astronaut: The Last Push
description: When disaster strikes the dangerous mission to explore life on Jupiter's moon, Europa - stranded and alone, astronaut Michael Forrest must fight to maintain his sanity as he holds his tiny spacecraft together for the trip home.

title: Asunder
description: When a freak accident kills his wife and unborn child, he invades the troubled marriage of his best friends in this gripping thriller.

title: Asuntos pendientes antes de morir
description: Un exgánster (Andy Garcia) reúne a su banda para un trabajo. Cuando las cosas salen mal y alguien resulta asesinado, Jimmy y sus compañeros parecen los culpables, dejando a Jimmy 48 horas para aclarar todo para sus amigos y la mujer de sus sueños.

title: Asya
description: Asya es una joven que ha vivido en orfanatos. Al morir sus padres, sus tíos debían encargarse de ella, pero deciden entregarla y quedarse con su fortuna. La vida se encargará de encontrarlos de nuevo.

title: Asylum
description: In order to secure a job at a mental institution, a young psychiatrist must interview four patients inside the asylum.

title: Asylum: Twisted Horror and Fantasy Tales
description: Brandon prepares to give his last stand-up comedy show. But during the show, he will realize that these stories have a strong relationship with his past. More than he imagines.

title: At Close Range
description: A son wants to be like his father and earn himself a place in the family crime syndicate. Together with his brother, he forms his own gang to gain his dad's respect. Efforts backfire as the father fears that he is losing control.

title: At First Sight
description: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

title: At Her Feet
description: Archeology students and their Hawaiian guide encounter unseen allies and a misguided protector as they risk their lives saving artifacts in the path of an erupting volcano in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park.

title: At Home with the Braithwaites
description: On her 40th birthday, Alison Braithwaite gets the surprise of her life when she wins 38 million in a multimillion-pound lottery, but she decides to keep the news of her win from her family.

title: At The Chef's Table
description: Imagine being invited to sit at the chef's personal table in one of the country's top restaurants. Only At the Chef's Table and host Alex Boylan provide your backstage pass to experience the chef's realm as you've never seen it before.

title: At The Drive-In
description: Unable to purchase a $50,000 digital projector, a group of quirky film fanatics in rural Pennsylvania fight to keep a dying drive-in theater alive by screening only vintage 35mm film prints and working entirely for free.

title: At the Edge of the World
description: The story of the controversial Sea Shepherd Antarctic Campaign against a Japanese whaling fleet. The international volunteer crew, under-trained and under-equipped, develop a combination of bizarre and brilliant tactics with which to stop the whalers.

title: At the Fork
description: Filmmaker and omnivore John Papola, together with his vegetarian wife Lisa, offer up a timely and refreshingly unbiased look at how farm animals are raised for our consumption.

title: At The Gate Of The Ghost (Sub)
description: In this worthy adaptation of the Japanese film Rashomon (1950), a young monk is left to determine the truth behind three competing perspectives after a bandit's disturbing murder trial.

title: At War With The Army with Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis
description: When former business & nightclub partners Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis enlist in the U.S. Army, (in their first starring film ) they have different ambitions. Martin wants to see action rather than the drudgery of his current post.

title: Ataque Animal
description: Historias reales de ataques de animales mortales y los humanos que los sobrevivieron.

title: Atardecer
description: En esta comedia hilarante y llena de acción, los mejores amigos Logan y Blake viajan a la destinación exótica de Puerto Vallarta para las vacaciones de primavera. Allí van a encontrar un paraíso de tequila con grandes problemas.

title: Atari: Game Over
description: A crew digs up all of the old Atari 2600 game cartridges of 'E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial' that were tossed into a landfill in the 1980s.

title: Atheist America
description: The Atheist Experience is the only atheist TV show in the United States. Every Sunday afternoon, two atheists debate people on the phone for one hour - on camera.

title: Atlantic
description: Documentary about the two big resources in the North Atlantic, fish and oil, and the impact of their exploitation on the environment in various countries on both sides of the Atlantic.

title: Atlantic Edge
description: The Atlantic coast of the British Isles is renowned as one of the most dangerous and hostile coastlines in the world.

description: Bobby Grady is married with two children, and his marriage is in crisis. Bobby is invited to work the night shift at a fashion-design studio whose owner believes that his talented, introspective designer Joanna Crane is selling his designs to competitors.

title: Crimes Of The Century
description: Exclusive footage and interviews shed new light on infamous news events.

title: Crimes Of The Heart
description: Three sisters with quite different personalities and lives reunite when the youngest of them, Babe, has just shot her husband.

title: Crimes of the Mind
description: A woman spends five years trying to get her brainwashed daughter back from a cult.

title: Crimes That Made History
description: Crimes and bloody tales that made the headlines usually reveal a lot about the hidden fantasies of their time. From Jack the Ripper to the Andes crash, the ten episodes of this collection shed a black light on a page of history that left a mark on time.

title: Crimes That Shook Australia
description: Dig deep into the biggest crimes to hit Australia, through the eyes of the people placed right at the centre of the tragedies - the families, the victims and the police officers involved.

title: Crimes Uncovered
description: Crimes Uncovered takes a closer look at shocking crimes that have gripped the nation - every crime different, every case unique. Intensely emotional and gives you first-hand insight into how crime can traumatise people.

title: Crimewave
description: In a nod to film noir, a businessman hires two inept hitmen to kill his partner. But the businessman's dim-witted wife witnesses the crime and becomes their next target... along with the nerd framed for the murder. Sam Raimi directs this zany comedy.

title: Criminal
description: The memories and skills of a deceased CIA agent are implanted into an unpredictable and dangerous convict in order to complete the agent's final assignment.

title: Criminal Intent
description: Devon thought that his share of difficulties was over after a difficult divorce but on the road to rebuilding his life, tragedy strikes leaving him in a fight for his freedom and his innocence.

title: Criminal Minds
description: Their job is to catch criminals. Their specialty is to think like them. Special Agents Jason Gideon and Aaron Hotchner head up the FBI's most elite profiling team — experts in analyzing criminal minds.

title: Crips And Bloods: Made In America (2008)
description: In Made In America, renowned documentarian Stacy Peralta blends gripping archival footage and photos with in-depth interviews of current and former gang members, historians, and experts, documenting the emergence of the Bloods and the Crips.

title: Crisis (ESP)
description: El descubrimiento revolucionario de un profesor, una misión encubierta de la DEA contra un cartel y una madre en busca de justicia se entrelazan en un mundo de corrupción, avaricia y dilemas morales dentro de la industria farmacéutica.

title: Crisscross
description: Goldie Hawn delivers a moving portrayal as a poor, single mother, abandoned by her husband (Keith Carradine), and left to raise her young son (David Arnott) in a seedy Key West neighborhood.

title: Cristiana Felgueiras: This Old House Makers Channel
description: Working from her studio in Porto, Portugal, woodworker Cristiana Felgueiras of Get Hands Dirty creates furniture with an inviting, modern aesthetic built for maximum efficiency in tight spaces.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo: The World At His Feet
description: Ronaldo makes headlines wherever he goes. From winning his second Ballon d'Or to heading a fashion line, he has the world at his feet. An intimate, behind-the-scenes look at the icon that will appeal to both ardent fans and football newbies!

title: Critical Rescue
description: When disaster strikes and tragedy seems certain, there is only one hope -- CRITICAL RESCUE -- highly trained teams of paramedics, rescuers and doctors. Their jobs are dangerous; their rescues dramatic.

title: Critters
description: This film captures the bizarre, undersea life of Indonesia's Lembeh strait, host to the best muck diving on the planet.

title: Crocodile Kingdom
description: Today's 25 species are a testament to the crocodile's intelligence and adaptability.

title: Cromartie High School
description: In this anime series classic, student Kamiyama gets an education at Cromartie High, a surreal school of hard knocks like none on Earth.

title: Crooked
description: Two police detectives must protect a beautiful call girl from mob hitmen and a crooked cop.

title: Crooked Arrows
description: A story centered on a Native American lacrosse team making its way through a prep school league tournament.

title: Cropsey (2010)
description: Filmmakers uncover a reality that is more terrifying than any urban legend.

title: Cross Purposes
description: An ambitious young medical professional with aspirations of becoming a surgeon encounters a teenage boy with terminal cancer. The two quickly find themselves at odds with each other and must learn from each other how to find purpose in life.

title: Crossed Over (LAS)
description: Basada en el libro Crusader: A Murder / A Memory, esta es la historia real de la amistad curativa entre una madre afligida (Diane Keaton) y un prisionero en el corredor de la muerte.

title: Crossed the Line
description: A young woman refuses to bow down to the local criminal kingpin who wants to take control of her late mother's flower shop in order to run drugs. However, when he crosses the line, she and her siblings seek revenge.

title: Crossfire
description: After a former FBI agent's wife is killed by a member of a crime syndicate, he learns that they are targeting his daughter, stopping at nothing to get to her, and they must team together to prepare for the final showdown.

title: Crossing Over
description: This ensemble piece focuses on immigrants of different nationalities trying to achieve legal status in Los Angeles.

title: Crossover
description: The lives of a gifted athlete and his best friend change when they take a fateful trip to Los Angeles. The young hopefuls must use every skill at their command to topple the reigning street ball champions from their thrones.

title: Crossroads: A Story of Forgiveness
description: Bruce Murakami discovers that the tragic accident that killed his wife and daughter was the result of a street racing incident.

title: Crown Vic
description: This story follows one memorable night in the life of LAPD officer Ray Mandel (Thomas Jane) as he hunts two cop killers on the loose. Co-starring Bridget Moynahan and David Krumholtz.

title: Cruel and Unusual
description: Cruel and Unusual' is the story of three men who have spent longer in solitary confinement than any other prisoners in the US because of the murder of a prison guard in 1972 at Angola.

title: Cruel Game
description: A handsome L.A. playboy juggles four gorgeous girlfriends, searches for true love, and gets involved in an elaborate con.

title: Cruel Intentions
description: Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

title: Cruel Jaws
description: In 1995, legendary director Bruno Mattei, here as 'William Snyder', stunned the civilized world with this ultimate sharksploitation saga.

title: Cruel World
description: Reeling from his dismissal from a reality show, a deranged runner-up holds a group of co-eds hostage on the set of his own fictitious show, where losers suffer a deadly fate.

title: Cruise
description: In the summer of '87, a working-class Italian-American kid from Queens falls for a rich suburban Jewish girl from Long Island. A romance-drama in the tradition of DINER and AMERICAN GRAFFITI.

title: Cruise Ship Killers
description: Cruise Ship Killers is a true crime series that tells the stories of people who never returned home after taking a holiday on a cruise ship, featuring interviews with family, friends, investigators and experts.

title: Crusoe
description: A thrilling adventure series, follows Robinson Crusoe stranded on a deserted island. Survival, friendships, and daring escapades test his resilience and ingenuity.

title: Crusty Demons 18: Twenty Years of Fears
description: The all new unrated, unapologetic and uncensored Crusty Demons film! Get an all access pass to never before seen crashes, parties and jumps.

title: Cryo
description: In an underground facility, five scientists wake from cryosleep with no memory of who they are or how long they've been asleep. They soon make a shocking realization: a killer is hunting them down there, and may even be hiding among them.

title: Cryptic
description: Eight members from various London crime families meet in a Crypt to guard a coffin. Nobody seems to know what the contents of said coffin are, but one by one they start winding up dead, and the word "vampire" comes to mind.

title: Crypto
description: In this cyber-thriller starring Kurt Russell and Beau Knapp, a Wall Street banker connects a small-town art gallery to a global conspiracy, putting his own family in grave danger.

title: CryptoKnights
description: CryptoKnights is a groundbreaking reality show that merges the dynamic world of cryptocurrency with mainstream media. It brings together some of the most influential figures in Web3 to evaluate and invest in promising crypto projects.

title: Crystal Fairy
description: Michael Cera stars in a hilarious comedy about an obnoxious American and a girl named Crystal Fairy (Gaby Hoffman) who take a hallucinogen on a trip through Chile.

title: Crímenes audaces
description: A través de dramatizaciones, filmaciones de noticias y entrevistas con testigos y funcionarios encargados de hacer cumplir la ley, Crímenes audaces lo lleva por el camino moral en el tentador mundo peligroso y diabólico del criminal.

title: Crímenes imperfectos
description: Forensic Files (Crímenes imperfectos) es el programa de crimen verdadero con más tiempo en el aire en la historia de la televisión. Evidencia y entrevistas con expertos ayudan a resolver casos verdaderos y accidentes alrededor del mundo.

title: CS: Go for Gold
description: Counterstrike is one of the biggest eSports, played in stadiums across the world for incredible prize pools and by the best players on the planet. As a highly competitive and intense game, it requires devotion, skill, and focussed teamwork.

title: CSI
description: Set in the gritty, neon-splashed streets of Las Vegas, CSI tracks the action with an elite team of forensic investigators. With its groundbreaking mix of science and police procedural, CSI reinvented the TV crime genre.

title: CSI en español
description: Ambientada en las calles con luces de neón de Las Vegas, el CSI sigue la acción con un equipo selecto de investigadores forenses. Su innovadora combinación de procedimientos científicos y policiales, CSI reinventó el género criminal en la televisión.

title: CSI: Miami
description: David Caruso plays a high-tech homicide cop in this action-fueled look at crime and punishment in Florida's tropical paradise.

title: CSI: Miami en español
description: David Caruso interpreta a un policía de homicidios de la científica en este drama repleto de acción sobre crimen y castigo en el paraíso tropical de Florida.

title: CSI: New York en español
description: CSI: NY, un drama criminal, trata sobre investigadores forenses que utilizan la ciencia de alta tecnología para seguir la evidencia y resolver crímenes en la gran manzana.

title: CSI: NY
description: CSI: NY, a crime drama, is about forensic investigators who use high-tech science to follow the evidence and solve crimes in the Big Apple.

title: CTRL
description: A reclusive computer programmer creates an artificial intelligence device that has the ability to evolve and adapt, enhanced with a game based predatory tendency to \"sacrifice the weak\" and win at all costs.

title: Cuando los hermanos se encuentran
description: Tom Cruise interpreta a un comerciante de ruedas egocéntrico que descubre que tiene un hermano autista (Dustin Hoffman) y lo lleva a un viaje inolvidable por todo el país en esta histérica, profunda y conmovedora ganadora del Oscar® a la Mejor Película.

title: Cuando vivas conmigo
description: Basada en el libro “El héroe discreto” del premio Nobel Mario Vargas Llosa, la historia contará la vida de Gertrudis y Armida. Son dos jóvenes hermanas completamente opuestas que olvidan sus diferencias para apoyarse la una a la otra.

title: Cuarenta noches
description: "Cuarenta noches" es una historia profunda sobre una de las figuras más conocidas, cuestionadas y misteriosas de la historia de la humanidad.

title: Cuatro bodas y un funeral
description: Charles (Hugh Grant) y sus amigos, todos ellos solteros y sin compromiso, han llegado a una edad en la que casi todos sus conocidos se han casado. En una de las bodas, a la que el grupo ha sido invitado, Charles conoce a Carrie (Andie Macdowell), una americana de la que se enamora a primera vista. Esa noche la pasan juntos, pero no vuelven a verse. Tendrán que esperar a la siguiente boda, en la que Carrie le presenta a su prometido.

title: Cuatro habitaciones
description: Año Nuevo en el Hotel Mon Signor. Es la primera noche en el trabajo de Ted, el botones, y los huéspedes inusuales del hotel lo pondrán en aprietos escandalosos. Una noche alocada con un gran elenco de estrellas.

title: Cuatro Labios OV7
description: La famosa agrupación musical OV7 muestra de manera original, emotiva y hasta divertida, cómo fue que vivieron su proceso de desintegración, luego de más de 15 años.

title: Cuba, Embracing its Future
description: In half a century, the world has changed dramatically. Everywhere, except Cuba that is. Isolated by the rest of the world for 60 years, Cuba has developed its own uniqueness and identity. Rediscover Cuba, and meet those who uphold "La Cubania."

title: Cuban Fury
description: Beneath Bruce Garrett’s shabby, overweight exterior, the passionate beating heart of a salsa king lays dormant. Only one woman can reignite his Latin fire. Spotlight hits, sweat drips, heels click – Nick Frost IS CUBAN FURY!

title: Cube
description: Seven complete strangers of widely varying personality characteristics are involuntarily placed in an endless maze containing deadly traps.

title: Cube
description: A group of strangers wake up in mysterious room inscribed with an unfamiliar code. Looking for ways to escape, they discover the room is riddled with lethal traps. As fear and distrust swirl around them, the group must work together to survive.

title: Cube²: Hypercube
description: Eight Strangers wake up in a bizarre cube with no recollection of how they got there. They soon discover that they're in a deadly dimension where the laws of physics don't apply and they must unravel the secrets of the hypercube in order to survive.

title: Cubic Zirconia
description: After a missing woman is found deceased, detectives race to locate her missing children and the motive behind it all.

title: Cuckoo
description: Cuckoo is the story of Ken Thompson - the proud father of a Midlands family who is still dealing with the fallout of his daughter's marriage to crazy hippy traveler Cuckoo.

title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
description: When children start disappearing, a rebellious teen under house arrest suspects the legendary boogeyman, the Cucuy, may be behind the eerie disappearances haunting her town.

title: Cuenta pendiente
description: Veinte años después de un robo fallido, tres estafadores secuestran a un paciente con amnesia para refrescar su memoria y encontrar el dinero que se perdió hace tanto tiempo.

title: Cuentos clásicos musicales
description: Una recopilación de entretenidas historias llenas de lecciones morales y valores para niños.

title: Cuentos de Navidad
description: ¡Pinkfong les trae regalitos de Navidad!

title: Cuentos de princesas
description: ¿Qué tal si llamamos a varias princesas y escuchamos sus historias con Pinkfong?

title: Cuentos Musicales de dinosaurios
description: ¡Bienvenido al mundo de los dinosaurios!

title: Cuentos para ir a dormir
description: ¡Ya es hora de acostarse!

title: Cuffin Season
description: Nate is a part-time Uber drive and a music video director, and is becoming a rising star in the music and video world. Everything is going great, except for the fact that he doesn't have citizenship.

title: Cuidado con el amor
description: Pedro, con la ayuda de dos mejores amigos de su padre busca un tesoro enterrado en una hacienda colonial. Elsa y su madre quieren impedirlo. Al fin el amor interviene y Pedro y Elsa comparten la fortuna y su felicidad.

title: Cujo
description: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

title: Cujo
description: Mientrtas Donna y Vic Trenton luchan para salvar tambaleante su matrimonio, su hijo Tad se hace amigo del adorable San Bernardo de 90 kilos de su mecánico.

title: Culinary Travels with Dave Eckert
description: Welcome to the world of Culinary Travels with Dave Eckert, the only series that takes you directly \\"to the source\\" of great food, wine, and personalities around the globe, and learn how to pair delectable wines with delicious food.

title: Culprit
description: After being exonerated on a murder charge, Jack Harris teams up with Lucy, the victim's sister, to find the killer and prove his innocence.

title: Cult-Tastic: With Roger And Julie Corman
description: Roger and Julie Corman detail their lifetime of innovative genre filmmaking. The Cormans discuss their iconic pool of collaborators and their bare-bones production philosophy that created some of the film's most memorable SFX sequences.

title: Culto de Amityville
description: Después de heredar inesperada y misteriosamente la mansión de su abuela, Stanley DeFeo se encuentra en la pequeña ciudad de Amityville, rodeado de secretos familiares enterrados y un complot siniestro en su contra.

title: Cumbres borrascosas
description: Cumbres borrascosas, de William Wyler, es una de las primeras adaptaciones a la gran pantalla de la clásica novela de Emily Brontë.

title: Cupcake Wars
description: Cupcake bakers are called to compete for the best cupcakes. The war is on!

title: Cupid
description: Meet Cupid, an adorable little angel whose job is to make everybody fall in love! But there is a problem. Cupid is new at his job and doesn’t know how! Will Cupid learn how to make people fall in love in time for Valentine's Day? Find out in Cupid!

title: Cupid & Cate
description: Mary-Louise Parker stars as a vibrant young woman who breaks off an uninspired relationship when she falls for a witty and kind young lawyer. Also stars Peter Gallagher and Bebe Neuwirth. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

title: Cupid And Valentine's Day
description: Each year on February 14, love is celebrated all across the globe. Valentine's Day, also known as Saint Valentine's Day or the Feast of Saint Valentine, wasn't always just greetings, candy and flowers.

title: Cupid's Christmas
description: As Santa Claus searches for his lost Reindeer (Cupid) in the small town of Holly; the love story of Katie Valentine and Army veteran/firefighter Luke Murphy is re-ignited.

title: Cupido navideño
description: Dos asistentes ejecutivos muy trabajadores, hacen arreglos para que sus jefes se enamoren durante las vacaciones.

title: Cupido no funciona
description: Holly, profesora universitaria, se inscribe en un servicio de citas románticas en línea, pero sospecha que algo anda mal cuando ve que las acciones del chico no coinciden con sus bonitos mensajes.

title: Curdled
description: A young woman obsessed with violent crimes becomes an employee of the Post-Forensic Cleaning Service. William Baldwin, Angela Jones, Lois Chiles, Barry Corbin, Daisy Fuentes and Kelly Preston star in this dark comic thriller.

title: Cure: RCS
description: Respected musicians, rock journalists, and fans bring new perspectives to the music of The Cure, alongside analysis of rare tracks and performances.

title: Current Wrestling Stars
description: They are today's greatest professional wrestling stars.  Don't miss a single minute of action as Jon Moxley, Adam Cole, Joey Janela, The Young Bucks, Kevin Steen, Drew Gulak step into the squared circle.

title: Curry And Pepper
description: Two best friends and cop partners become the subject of a beautiful news reporter's documentary. The two soon find themselves competing for screen time as well as the love of the reporter while after a murderous arms dealer.

title: Curry Scent
description: The Desai family, a proud and traditional family recently immigrated from India and are struggling to make ends meet. This puts pressure on their daughter Geetha to find a suitor to legitimize their family and keep them from being deported.

title: Curse of the Jade Scorpion
description: CW Briggs is a veteran insurance investigator and Betty Ann Fitzgerald is a new employee. One night, the office goes to a magic show and the two get hypnotized for the magician's own schemes. Will they end up investigating themselves?

title: Curse of the Man Who Sees UFOs
description: Christo Roppolo claims to have been filming and communicating with UFOs for several years. Filmmaker Justin Gaar follows his journey and finds that sometimes aliens from space can tell us more about our own humanity on Earth.

title: Curvature
description: An intriguing sci-fi drama about an engineer (Lyndsy Fonseca, 'Kick-Ass') who risks everything to go back in time to stop herself from committing a murder she now regrets.

title: Curves Under the Mistletoe
description: Faced with trials and tribulations, curvaceous Delight finds love as she makes her way in the world.

title: Customer Wars
description: With supply chain shortages and prices skyrocketing, positive customer relations are nearly impossible. This series spotlights conflicts that arise when disgruntled customers face employees doing their best to help.

title: Customs
description: Customs officers are at war with smugglers in ports, airports and at sea. This observational series joins the officers that turn up the heat on smugglers, seizing millions of contraband cigarettes and millions of pounds worth of illegal drugs.

title: Customs Frontline
description: Hong Kong stars Nicolas Tse and Jacky Cheung team up in Herman Yau’s latest action spectacle. Customs finds illegal arms in Hong Kong waters, their quest to take down the dealers leads to some of the most incredible action in recent memory.

title: Cut Poison Burn
description: Cut Poison Burn is a searing film that illuminates the grim truth about America's so-called War on Cancer.

title: Cut Throat City
description: After Hurricane Katrina, four boyhood friends return to NOLA’s Lower Ninth. As FEMA fails to provide aid, they reluctantly turn to a local gangster for help. When the job tanks, they must outrun, and outsmart, a system rife with corruption.

title: Cut: Exposing FGM Worldwide
description: Part adventure travelogue, part anthropological study, and certainly an explosive human rights exposé, Cut investigates the secret practice of female genital mutilation (FGM) globally.

title: Cutter's Way
description: This intriguing film features John Heard as a boozy, belligerent Vietnam vet who seeks passionate revenge on a murderer after his aimless friend (Jeff Bridges) is falsely accused of the crime.

title: Cutthroat Island
description: A female pirate and her companion race against their rivals to find a hidden island that contains a fabulous treasure.

title: Cutting Class
description: Troubled Brian Woods, back from a mental institution and dealing with his father's death, competes for Paula's love against rebel Dwight. As students vanish, suspicion falls on Brian, but the threat lurks elsewhere.

title: Cutting Edge 4: Fire and Ice
description: Former skater Alexandra 'Alex' Delgado (Francia Raisa) had left skating behind her. But now a bad boy (Brendan Fehr) want to lure her back to the ice and become her new partner. But will their tempestuous relationship destroy their chances for gold?

title: Cutting Edge Comedians of the 60s and 70s (2007)
description: In the late 1950s, a fresh style of standup comedy emerged tackling previously taboo subjects as sex, religion, politics, and drugs. Here are those comedians who took the big risks years ago and paved the way for today's crop of maverick comics.

title: Cutting It: In the ATL
description: Maja vows to expand her hair empire in the ATL, but will outspoken Mushiya, professional but fiery Dedra, and sweet but sassy Beautii follow her lead? LaKenya seeks their mentorship as she plans her own rise.

title: Cyber-Seniors
description: A humorous and heartwarming documentary feature, CYBER-SENIORS chronicles the extraordinary journey of a group of senior citizens as they discover the world of the Internet through the guidance of teenage mentors.

title: Cyborg
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

title: Cyborg
description: En una tierra azotada por la plaga del siglo XXI, un hermoso Cyborg mitad humano tiene la información que puede salvar la civilización. ¡Pero solo la fortaleza y astucia de un guerrero solitario será capaz de salvar esos hechos importantes!

title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
description: In the year 2074 the PinWheel corporation creates cyborg Cash designed specifically to charm her way into a rival manufacturer's headquarters and then self-detonate. Things go awry when she starts to have feelings for a human, Colt 45.

title: Cyborg Cop 2
description: A police officer comes up against the psychopathic brother of a man he killed. When the brother is captured in a shoot-out, a government agency turns him into a cyborg who soon escapes and concocts a plan to destroy the human race.

title: Cyborg Cop 3
description: A cop tries to stop a scientist's experiments to turn students into cyborg-mercenaries.

title: Cyborgs: Human Machines
description: Technology has improved our lives in so many ways. Trans-humanists are fusing their bodies with digital implants to increase their abilities and expand their senses. How is life going to change for us all if some people have supernatural powers?

title: Cyclying - Follow Me (2010)
description: The filmmakers who brought you the Collective, Roam and Seasons present a new mountain bike film, Follow Me.

title: Cyrano
description: Award-winning director Joe Wright envelops moviegoers in a symphony of emotions with music, romance, and beauty in Cyrano, re-imagining the timeless tale of a heartbreaking love triangle. Peter Dinklage, Haley Bennett and Kelvin Harrison Jr. star.

title: Cyrano
description: El director Joe Wright envuelve a los espectadores en una sinfonía de música, romance y belleza en Cyrano, reinterpretando la historia de un triángulo amoroso. Peter Dinklage, Haley Bennett y Kelvin Harrison Jr. son los protagonistas.

title: Cyrano de Bergerac (Questar)
description: A poet and sword fighter helps another man woo the woman he loves with words of love and devotion.

title: Cásate conmigo
description: Después de perder a la mujer de sus sueños, Anderson (Biggs) es empujado por su mejor amigo para conocer a una completa extraña. Justo cuando pensaba que su vida había terminado, se da cuenta de que es sólo el comienzo.

title: Cézanne Et Moi
description: This film traces the parallel paths of the careers and friendship of painter Paul Cézanne and novelist Emile Zola. Soon Emile had it all. Meanwhile, Cézanne rejected the Parisian scene and was ignored by his peers.

title: Cíclope extraterrestre: El extraordinario caso de la Sagrada Familia
description: En 1963 en Brasil, tres niños son testigos de un OVNI en su patio trasero. Un cíclope alienígena desciende y el Sr. Alberto investiga el fenómeno.

title: Círculo rojo
description: La muerte de Clara, una famosa diseñadora, desencadenará la venganza de dos mujeres contra las personas que destrozaron su vida en el pasado.

title: Código alienígena
description: Cuando un ex-analista de la NSA recibe un misterioso mensaje alienígena, se ve atrapado en una peligrosa conspiración que podría cambiarlo todo. Mientras descifra el mensaje, se enfrenta a oscuros secretos del gobierno y la amenaza de fuerzas ocultas.

title: Código de honor
description: Luego de recibir una beca para una exclusiva escuela privada, David Green se transforma en el atleta estrella y gana la atención de una bella debutante. Pero sus nuevas amistades se romperán cuando un estudiante revela el secreto de David.

title: Código Paz
description: Pedro Ruiz es un corredor de bienes raíces dominicano de día y un ladrón inteligente pero sin suerte por la noche. Sueña con una vida mejor y dinero fácil. Desesperado, se mete en la mansión equivocada en el momento equivocado.

title: Códigos de guerra
description: John Woo dirige este épico drama de acción sobre un soldado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial (Nicolas Cage) asignado para proteger a un soldado navajo (Adam Beach) ... y el código secreto que conoce.

title: Cómo asesinar a un millonario
description: Joan Rivers interpreta a la ama de casa de Beverly Hills, Irma Summers, quien está convencida de que su esposo planea matarla.

title: Cómo detectar una secta
description: Los cultos están volviendo, según algunos de los expertos que los estudian. El documental es una mirada interna a estos cultos y consta de historias de ex creyentes, e investiga las similitudes que dicen que existen entre grupos.

title: Cómo entrenar a tu esposo
description: Una terapeuta matrimonial intenta arreglar su propio matrimonio centrándose en cómo cambiar a su marido.

title: Cómo no casarse con una princesa
description: Tras el nacimiento del príncipe, tres Parcas predicen una profecía. Un cuento de hadas sobre viajes en el tiempo, cambiar el curso del destino y descubrir que una profecía puede ser la mayor de las bendiciones.

title: Cómo vive la otra mitad
description: La "pareja más querida De Gran Bretaña" Eamonn Holmes y Ruth Langsford se muestran cercanos y personales con algunas de las personas más emprendedoras y multimillonarias del país.

title: D-Day - 80th Anniversary
description: In 1944, Operation Overlord, liberated France and Western Europe in D-Day. A new documentary explores this pivotal event.

title: D-Day Operation Overlord - The Normandy Invasion
description: Do you want to learn more about World War II, but don't have time to listen to lengthy audiobooks? Then let The History Journals take you on an hourly history tour of the different facets of the war.

title: D-Day: Over Normandy
description: American football coach Bill Belichick narrates the events of D-Day, combining modern-day aerial and archival footage and interviews with veterans.

title: D-Day: The American Way
