description: Charlotte y Rory son mejores amigos, y para su 30 cumpleaños, él viaja por el mundo. Un año después, Charlotte visita a una vidente que le dice que está destinada a estar con Rory cuando él regrese a casa. Rory regresa a casa... pero comprometido.

title: El padrino
description: Ganadora del Óscar a la mejor película, esta primera entrega de la épica trilogía de Francis Ford Coppola sobre una familia mafiosa en plena transformación narra la violenta vida y la época del patriarca de la mafia, Don Corleone.

title: El pago
description: Michael Jennings trabaja en proyectos ultrasecretos. Luego de cada trabajo, borran su memoria.

title: El Palenque
description: El show tiene lugar en un colorido ambiente de Palenque mexicano, rodeado de una audiencia entusiasta, música y alegría.

title: El partido perfecto
description: Una madre soltera necesita inspiración para reinventar su restaurante en apuros. Pero cuando su ex novio de la secundaria regresa al pueblo convertido en una super estrella de béisbol, su futuro toma un nuevo rumbo.

title: El pequeño unicornio
description: Después de que su yegua favorita muere al dar a luz, Polly se anima cuando descubre que el potro es un unicornio. El secreto se extiende por toda la ciudad y los alborotadores intentan robarlo.

title: El perro que salvó la navidad de vacaciones
description: Un astuto can y un caniche francés deben salvar su hogar de unos tontos ladrones que atacan durante las vacaciones de Navidad.

title: El perro que salvó las Navidades
description: Un perro valiente y su todavía cachorra hermana trabajan juntos para evitar que dos ladrones entren en una casa.

title: El pescado en el plátillo
description: Fish the Dish es una serie divertida y deliciosa que sigue al chef Spencer Watts mientras cocina sus platos de mariscos favoritos. Mostrándonos lo rápido, fácil y divertido que son las recetas de pescado.

title: El pistolero
description: Uno de los hombres más poderosos de México llega a un pueblo en busca de nuevos pistoleros que quieran formar parte de su equipo, y recluta a un hombre sencillo que acepta el trabajo porque quiere vengar la muerte de su padre.

title: El poder de la repostería
description: El poder de la repostería es una serie divertida, elegante y lúdica centrada en el amor y la alegría de hornear.

title: El Potro Salvaje
description: Gastón halla en el campo el cadáver de Gerardo, dueño del potro blanco Rayo de Plata, e impide que el animal sea asesinado por El Manco.

title: El precio de la codicia
description: Cuando un analista de nivel inicial descubre información que podría demostrar la caída de la empresa; sus colegas se ven obligados a elegir entre el dinero y la moral en este thriller de alto riesgo.

title: El primer gran robo al tren
description: Durante el siglo XIX, tres hombres conspiran para realizar el robo de un tren que lleva una fortuna. Sean Connery, Lesley-Anne Down, Donald Sutherland, Alan Webb, Robert Lang.

title: El principal sospechoso
description: La ganadora del premio Emmy Helen Mirren interpreta a la DCI Jane Tennison en este aclamado drama sobre una serie de asesinatos y la lucha por la justicia en un mundo dominado por hombres.

title: El profesor chiflado
description: Jerry Lewis es un profesor de química tímido y miope que descubre una poción mágica que lo transformará en un guapo y encantador Romeo.

title: El príncipe de Bel Air
description: Robin Prince es una soltera y limpiadora de piscinas que se mantiene ocupada haciendo compañía a las mujeres mientras atiende sus piscinas.

title: El príncipe y el mendigo
description: Una narración moderna del clásico de Mark Twain: "El príncipe y el mendigo".

title: El punto sobre la i
description: El cineasta Matthew Parkhill añade un giro tras otro, formando una sorprendente película de suspenso romántico. Gael García Bernal interpreta al forastero, Natalia Verbeke es Carmen y James D’Arcy retrata a su prometido.

title: El puño del cóndor
description: Un grupo de luchadores de artes marciales de todo el mundo está buscando un libro que contenga los antiguos secretos de cómo superar los límites del cuerpo humano.

title: El páramo
description: Un equipo de soldados llega al pie de una base de montaña y descubre que algo siniestro acecha en la niebla y las sombras.

title: El que busca encuentra (LAS)
description: Esperanza y Marcos son dos personas que creen en el destino y en el amor verdadero.

title: El que sabe, sabe
description: Una extraordinaria serie donde caben todas las preguntas y todas las respuestas imaginables e inimaginables a los temas más extraordinarios relacionados con el mundo de todas las ciencias, naturaleza, flora y fauna, geografía, lugares, cultura, realidad virtual… narrada de manera disruptiva, divertida e innovadora con fascinantes imágenes.

title: El Quijote
description: Versión miniserie de la primera mitad de la famosa novela de Cervantes.

title: El regalo de Navidad
description: Una periodista decide escribir un artículo navideño sobre su búsqueda de un “Amigo Secreto’” de su infancia, cuyo regalo anónimo tuvo un gran impacto en su vida.

title: El regreso de la tribu Brady
description: Mike (Gary Cole) planea una fiesta de aniversario, pero el primer marido de Carol (Shelley Long), Roy (Tim Matheson), aparece y sacude el árbol genealógico. Roy lleva a Carol a Hawái, y los Brady los persiguen en busca de diversión, sol y aventura.

title: El regreso de los muertos vivientes
description: En su primer día en un almacén de material médico, Freddy (Thom Mathews) libera sin querer un gas tóxico de un contenedor militar secreto. El gas reanima un ejército de cadáveres, que salen de la tumba con un hambre voraz... ¡de cerebros!

title: El regreso del corcel negro
description: Negro' es un magnífico caballo de carreras famosas en el mundo entero; pero para su joven dueño americano, Alec Ramsay, es mucho más. Así que, cuando le roban el sensacional animal, Alec está dispuesto a hacer lo imposible por recuperarlo.

title: El reino escondido
description: Cuando un niño curioso descubre accidentalmente una magnífica ciudad en miniatura ubicada detrás del fregadero de la cocina, él, su hermano y hermana adolescentes son transportados a una tierra extraña.

title: El reino infantil
description: ¡Llega un nuevo programa de El reino infantil con las canciones más queridas y los episodios más divertidos! ¡Te esperamos para cantar y bailar con todos tus personajes preferidos!

title: El Rey de Monterrey
description: Capulina y su novia, la sirvienta de una casa rica, deciden dar un paseo usando el automóvil de los patrones. Una banda de roba coches les roban el auto. Capulina y su novia tienen que recuperar el auto antes de que sus patrones se enteren.

title: El rey del fin del mundo
description: Las aventuras de Sir James Brooke, que desafió al Imperio Británico para gobernar el reino en la jungla de Borneo en 1840, embarcándose en una cruzada para acabar con la piratería y la esclavitud durante el resto de su vida.

title: El rostro oscuro de la ley
description: “Del autor de Training Day”, llega este excelente drama sobre policías corruptos, ambientado en los días previos a los disturbios en la ciudad de Los Ángeles.

title: El sabor de verano
description: Gabby se muda a Bright Shore, donde abre un restaurante y redescubre su pasión. Un día se encuentra con Caleb, un ex jugador de béisbol, que es dueño de su propio restaurante.

title: El sabor del amor
description: Alice, una joven y talentosa sous chef del mejor restaurante de Nueva York, recibe una invitación para ser jueza de un concurso de comida para una prestigiosa recaudación de fondos anual.

title: El salvaje Bill
description: El inicio de la carrera de Wild Bill Hickock como un legendario hombre de leyes y culmina en su reubicación en Deadwood, donde se produce el reencuentro con Calamity Jane.

title: El Sargento Capulina
description: Capulina quiere convertirse en superhéroe para combatir el crimen. Se enlista en la policía y después de un riguroso entrenamiento llega a ser sargento y confronta a los criminales en una serie de cómicos incidentes.

title: El secreto del lago
description: Cuando el oscuro secreto de Holly es descubierto por su nuevo vecino, ellos se enfrascarán en una cruenta batalla con su padre.

title: El Sexo de las Madres
description: Ana y Laura son hermanas de la vida. Cada una ha seguido su camino hasta que un día, desde un bello pueblo escondido, Ana hace una llamada a Laura. El reencuentro destila alegría, pero merodea y acecha un peligro que ninguna de las dos quiere nombrar.

title: El señor de la guerra
description: Nicolas Cage, ganador de un Oscar®, protagoniza esta historia tensa y llena de acción sobre un famoso traficante de armas que vendió armas a dictadores y consiguió eludir la ley durante casi veinte años.

title: El señor mamá
description: Michael Keaton y Terri Garr protagonizan este clásico en el que interpretan a una pareja que ve alterada su vida cuando Garr se pone a trabajar y Keaton se convierte en quién tiene que lidiar con los niños ¡Y con una lavadora que también se queja!

title: El Shincal, el Cusco al sur del Cusco
description: Como se sabe, el imperio Inca se extendió mas allá del Perú. En el norte de la actual Argentina, los Incas crearon y construyeron una ciudad desde sus cimientos, destinada a ser capital de la región sur de su imperio.

title: El show de Jerry Springer
description: Jerry Springer  es presentador y refereé de los divertidos enfrentamientos entre sus invitados, por casos que van desde infidelidad hasta crisis de identidad.

title: El show de Jerry Springer
description: Jerry Springer es presentador y refereé de los divertidos enfrentamientos entre sus invitados, por casos que van desde infidelidad hasta crisis de identidad.

title: El show de Maury
description: El presentador Maury Povich entrevista a sus invitados con temas provocativos y sensibles.

title: El show de Steve Wilkos en español
description: Steve Wilkos es un ex-policia que se dedica a reunir familias separadas y traumatizadas, mientras expone las feas verdades que causaron los rompimientos.

title: El Smoking
description: Jimmy Tong es un taxista común transformado en chofer, que se tropieza con un traje de superespía de 2 mil millones de dólares, e inadvertidamente se convierte en un elegante agente secreto.

title: El sol de cada mañana
description: Un pronosticador del tiempo de Chicago (Cage), separado de su esposa y sus hijos, se cuestiona si el éxito profesional y el éxito personal se excluyen mutuamente.

title: El solista
description: Un periodista de Los Ángeles descubre a un músico brillante y distraído, de pasión inagotable. Su amistad y vínculos únicos les transformará la vida a ambos.

title: El sordo (LAS)
description: Un escultor que fabrica imágenes de santos es golpeado por un matón y queda sordo. A causa de esto, se avergüenza y se va del pueblo.

title: El sospechoso
description: Un robo a un banco toma un giro mortal y no planificado.

title: El superciclón
description: Cuando un súper ciclón amenaza a toda la Costa Este de los Estados Unidos, un meteorólogo solitario y un ingeniero petrolero deben luchar contra los elementos para detener la amenaza.

title: El sustituto (1996)
description: Un exmarine se hace pasar por maestro sustituto en una preparatoria para identificar a la pandilla que está sembrando el terror. Cuando la situación se hace más peligrosa, entra en acción para limpiar la escuela de crimen.

title: El Talisman
description: Tras perder un rancho en Texas, Camila Nájera (Blanca Soto) y su familia se mudan a California. El destino los llevará a ser vecinos del despiadado Gregorio Negrete, dueño del rancho "El Alcatraz".

title: El taller de Gecko
description: Ríase y aprenda con Gecko y los mecánicos en Gecko's Garage. Gecko recibe la visita de sus amigos Max The Monster Truck, Amber The Ambulance y más camiones grandes para niños.

title: El templo del oro
description: Dos mercenarios con mala suerte (Chuck Norris y Louis Gossett Jr.) conocen a una hermosa chica (Melody Anderson) con un mapa de una mina de oro perdida y deciden intentar hacerse ricos. ¡Pero el camino hacia el tesoro no es cosa fácil!

title: El tercer deseo
description: Eugenio despierta de una borrachera y descubre cerca una tetera de metal. Cuando la toca, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le ofrece tres deseos. Eugenio comprobará que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada.

title: El tesoro de Da Vinci
description: Un antropólogo forense aburrido debe desentrañar el misterioso código encerrado en las obras de Leonardo Da Vinci. Basada en hechos históricos.

title: El tren de la muerte
description: Jon Voight y Eric Roberts interpretan a un par de presos que en su fuga suben a un tren de mercancías, pero cuando el maquinista muere de un ataque al corazón, se encuentran atrapados, solos y a toda velocidad hacia un desastre seguro.

title: El tren Navideño de las sorpresas
description: De Hallmark Hall of Fame, un periodista aborda un tren de larga distancia en Navidad, ignorando que este viaje le hará atravesar el terreno inhóspito de su corazón.

title: El túnel
description: Un camión cisterna choca dentro de un túnel en Noruega, dejando atrapada a la gente dentro del mismo. Se desata una fuerte tormenta de nieve, impidiendo que el principal equipo de rescate llegue a lugar.

title: El Ultimo Tren Al Rock'n Roll
description: The Last Call, una vieja banda de rock, es finalista en una batalla de bandas por primera vez en su carrera. Sin embargo, el día de la final, el cantante y el técnico de sonido desaparecen misteriosamente.

title: El Vampiro
description: Marta viaja a visitar a su tía enferma, pero al llegar se entera que su tía murió y decide quedarse en la hacienda, sin percatarse de que está a merced de los vampiros.

title: El Vampiro y el Sexo
description: Santo prueba su máquina del tiempo enviando a una joven al siglo XIX, donde enfrenta el peligro del Conde Drácula.

title: El vengador 4: yo soy la justicia
description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) tiene una misión: acabar con el tráfico de drogas de Los Ángeles. Y es que la hija adolescente de su novia ha muerto trágicamente de una sobredosis. Está armado, es peligroso... y está loco de remate.

title: El vengador anónimo 2
description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) no es una víctima: su arma es la venganza. Después de empezar una nueva vida en Los Ángeles, agreden sexualmente y matan a su hija. No descansará hasta encontrar a los agresores... y enterrarlos a todos.

title: El vengador anónimo III
description: El arquitecto y justiciero Paul Kersey vuelve a Nueva York, donde un deshonesto detective de la policía le obligará a combatir el crimen callejero causado por una importante pandilla que aterroriza los vecindarios.

title: El verano de los peces voladores
description: Manena va de vacaciones con su padre, Francisco, a una parte del sur de Chile. Ella descubre que la obsesión de su padre por atrapar todos los peces carpa en su laguna artificial está haciendo enojar a la tribu Mapuche local, así que tiene que detenerlo.

title: El vuelo antes de Navidad
description: Dos extraños que por casualidad trabajan en marketing comparten una habitación en un bed and breakfast cuando una tormenta de nieve retrasa su vuelo en Montana la víspera de Navidad.

title: El yakuza americano
description: Viggo Mortensen (Green Book) interpreta a un agente del FBI encubierto que ha ascendido en las filas de la Yakuza y ahora se ve atrapado en una guerra entre la Yakuza, la mafia y el FBI.

title: El álamo
description: John Wayne y Richard Widmark protagonizan esta espectacular película histórica sobre el ataque de las tropas mexicanas en el  in Álamo.

title: El último castillo
description: Sus servicios al país lo hicieron un héroe pero un error lo convirtió en prisionero. Para el General Eugene Irwin (Robert Redford) es solo cuestión de cumplir su sentencia, hasta que descubre que otros presos están siendo asesinados.

title: El último cuerpo
description: El asesinato de un travesti despierta en el periodista Heriberto Camargo una sed de verdad. En su investigación, descubre que no es un delito aislado. Es parte de una serie de asesinatos brutales de agentes de policía.

title: El último minuto
description: Cuando Karla descubre que se está muriendo, decide reconectar con Angie, una sobrina que no había conocido en años. La niña está siendo tratada después de un suicidio fallido.

title: El último paseo triunfal
description: Un chico, su nueva amiga, su abuela y su viejo vecino que solía trabajar de chófer para un mafioso, buscan el tesoro supuestamente oculto hace mucho tiempo por el delincuente, para ayudar al vecino a conservar su casa.

title: El último secreto de Sherlock Holmes
description: Del fantástico guionista y director Billy Wilder nos llega este entretenido misterio que desvela el diario del Dr. Watson (Colin Blakely) que implica al gran Sherlock Holmes (Robert Stephens).

title: El último traje
description: Abraham, un sastre judío de 88 años, emprende un largo viaje en busca del hombre que lo salvó de una muerte segura durante el Holocausto, en los últimos alientos del nazismo.

title: Electra Glide In Blue
description: In this visually stunning cult classic, when good-hearted motorcycle cop John Wintergreen (Robert Blake) is promoted to detective, he heads out on his bike, the Electra Glide, and makes a discovery that could cost him his life!

title: Electric Dreams
description: An artificially intelligent PC and his human owner find themselves in a romantic rivalry over a woman.

title: Electric Kingdom
description: Electric Kingdom is a behind-the-scenes documentary following the first Formula E electric car race in the Middle East.

title: Electric Light Orchestra: In Performance
description: This is the essential critical review of the music of the Electric Light Orchestra (E.L.O.) during the Roy Wood era.

title: Elefante blanco
description: Un asesino es contratado por un hombre de negocios para vengar el asesinato de su hija por parte de traficantes de esclavos blancos en Tailandia.

title: Elementary
description: ELEMENTARY stars Jonny Lee Miller as detective Sherlock Holmes and Lucy Liu as Dr. Joan Watson in a modern-day drama about a crime-solving duo that cracks the NYPD's most impossible cases.

title: Elements
description: I am just a rider like you, I love every aspect of riding my dirt bike, from the freedom to the rush of twisting the throttle.

title: Elephant Empire
description: It is said that the “King of Beasts” has always been the Lion, monarch of all predators.  But the hierarchy of authority in the animal kingdom - perhaps better described as the food chain - is not all dominated by red tooth and sharp claw.

title: Elephant White
description: An assassin is hired by a businessman to avenge the murder of his daughter by white slave traders in Thailand. Starring Kevin Bacon.

title: Elephants
description: A true indie film through and through, Elephants takes an authentic look at a modern relationship in a "slice of life" style.

title: Elephants: Changing Lives
description: Few animals have more complex societies and interactions than elephants.

title: Elevate
description: Trina’s job gets the best of her as she tries to complete just one day of healthy eating and overwhelmed by the trapped elevator occupants that reach out to her for help. In this slow-building drama of intertwining stories about people who must fight.

title: Elevate (2011)
description: Filmed over four years and across two continents, Elevate traces the extraordinary journeys of four exceptionally tall West African teenagers as they embark for US prep schools, where success can equal college and maybe even a shot at the NBA.

title: Elevator
description: Nine Wall Street partygoers become stranded in an elevator, and one has a bomb. The other eight people will do anything to survive while their civility and morality disintegrate.

title: Eleven Minutes
description: The feature documentary "Eleven Minutes" chronicles "Project Runway" winner Jay McCarroll's year-long journey preparing his first independent runway show in NYC.

title: Elf Day
description: Another holiday season is over, and joy still blankets the land - that is, until Santaʼs beloved Christmas tree goes missing! Enter Bingle, Jingle, Tingle, Dorabelle, and Cheer - the E.L.F. Detective Agency!

title: Elf Land
description: This season, Christmas has the tiniest new heroes!

title: Elf Quest
description: A boastful elf and his prank-happy orc brother must learn to work together to stop a fiendish orc gang from retrieving a magical stone that will give them the power to take over the world.

title: Elf-Man
description: When Santa leaves an Elf behind on Christmas Eve, the Harper kids find out his true identity as the super-hero "ELF-MAN". Together they must save their Dad's new invention from a bumbling gang of thieves, and enjoy the best Christmas, ever.

title: Elfette Saves Christmas
description: When Santa Claus is kidnapped by the New York mafia, Elfette, a special not-so-ordinary elf, must stop the bad guys, find Santa, and save Christmas.

title: Elian
description: ELIÁN is the remarkable story about Elián González, a five-year-old Cuban boy plucked from the Florida coast in 1999, and how the fight over his future sparked a flashpoint for simmering US and Cuban tensions.

title: Elias: Rescue Team Adventures
description: In the quaint seaside town of Cozy Cove, a friendly rescue boat named Elias and his pals patrol their home and keep their neighbors safe. When trouble strikes, this group is prepared for anything, with compassion and teamwork on their side!

title: Elimination Game
description: A disgraced Navy SEAL is forced into a deadly televised game of survival. Hunted in a dystopian future, he must outwit his pursuers in a brutal race for freedom, seeking redemption and revenge in a world where justice is a game.

title: Elite Formations: The Story of the Red Arrows
description: Explore the beginnings of powered flight and the exponential development during the 20th century of precision engineering, lighting speed and human ingenuity.

title: Elizabeth at 80: Continuity and Change
description: This touching program covers the early years of Elizabeth’s life, from colonies to independence and the emergence of a multi-cultured British society.

title: Elizabeth Taylor: An Unauthorized Biography
description: For more than 60 years Elizabeth Taylor's dazzling beauty and scandalous life captured our fascination, provoked our envy, teased our curiosity and, at times aroused our pity. She was American royalty and the undisputed queen of the tabloids.

title: Elizabeth Windsor
description: A woman caught between ruling a nation, duty, and family, and how she has led a monarchy through some of the greatest changes in modern history. A woman who never chose her life, but who has become the world's longest-ever serving Queen.

title: Elke
description: Sexual problems plague an affluent Malibu family until a backpacking free spirit (Shauna O'Brien) arrives.

title: Ella Bella Bingo
description: Ella Bella and Henry are best friends, but she becomes jealous when Henry wants to play with the cool new kid. When Henry runs away, Ella Bella and a new kid go on a bicycle adventure to find Henry and learn the magic of friendship.

title: Ella es así
description: En esta comedia romántica, Freddie Prinze, Jr. es un atleta que apuesta que puede convertir a cualquier chica en la reina del baile. Para la cerebrito Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook), el destino convierte a una atracción engañosa en un romance verdadero.

title: Ella espera un bebé
description: Jake y Kristi eran dos jóvenes solteros locos y enamorados. Pero un año después, se convirtieron en dos adultos locos y casados atravesando una fase de transición.

title: Ella está encantada
description: Anne Hathaway, ganadora de un Oscar, protagoniza un inolvidable cuento de hadas moderno en el que una muchacha recibe el don de la obediencia de su hada madrina. Una asombrosa aventura mágica repleta de coloridos personajes, música, ingenio y fantasía.

title: Ella The Elephant
description: Welcome to the Elephant Islands, home of Ella, a spirited little girl with a big heart, bigger imagination, and a magic hat that can transform into almost anything.

title: Elle: A Modern Cinderella Tale
description: Elle dreamed of becoming a singer. She is now in L.A. interning at a record label and meets her Pop Prince Charming. But the divas at the label will do anything to keep her from success. Elle proves happily ever after is just a song away.

title: Elliot Moose
description: Elliot Moose is a part animated, part live action series about a group of stuffed toys who live together in a playhouse.  Together they have many adventures only limited by their imaginations.

title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer
description: Elliot, a small but determined horse, travels to the North Pole to compete for a spot alongside the famous reindeer that pull Santa's sleigh. Against all odds, Elliot and his friend Hazel the goat set out to prove that no dream is too big.

title: Ellis Island: History
description: About 12 million emigrants landed on Ellis Island; First outpost of the American federal immigration station in the New York Bay, the ultimate gateway to the United States of America. However, when they first arrive, their fates did not belong to them.

title: Elmer Gantry
description: A Best Actor Oscar went to Burt Lancaster for his outstanding performance as a con-man-turned-preacher in this provocative indictment of religious corruption.

title: Eloise
description: Four friends break into an abandoned insane asylum in search of a death certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance.

title: Elon Musk: The Real Life Iron Man
description: Discover the meteoric rise of Elon Musk, the man who is transforming the way we think about travel techlogy through electric cars, the Hyperloop, and revolutionary ideas on how we live through artificial intelligence and colonizing Mars.

title: Elsa's Legacy: The Born Free Story
description: More than 50 years have passed since the publication of Born Free -- the book, and then a film, that changed forever the way we think about wildlife. What has happened to lions since this story?

title: Elsbeth
description: Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney, utilizes her singular point of view to corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD.

title: Else
description: Anx has just met Cass when a mysterious virus breaks out: everywhere, people’s bodies are merging with objects. Stuck in their apartment, the couple must face this dreadful threat.

title: Elton John: Becoming Rocketman
description: 2019 is the year of Elton John, with the release of the box office hit 'Rocketman', his autobiography and his final farewell tour all eyes are on the musical genius. We take a glimpse into his incredible journey and uncover the truth behind the turbule...

title: Elvira
description: La verdadera historia de Elvira Arellano, una inmigrante mexicana, que en 2006 se refugió durante un año en una iglesia de Chicago para evitar la deportación.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Attack Of The Giant Leeches
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Beast From Haunted Cave
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Don't Look In The Basement
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. While hosting "Don't Look in the Basement," Elvira hears radio reports of a deranged killer on the loose in her neighborhood.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Eegah
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira celebrates the achievements of "Eegah" (or lack thereof) by honoring the film at the Elvie Awards.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Frankenstein's Castle Of Freaks
description: The count (Rossano Brazzi) recruits a dwarf (Michael Dunn) and others to help him put a brain in the body of a brute.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Gamera, Super Monster
description: With the intention of conquering Earth, the evil alien Zanon unleashes the biggest threat Gamera's ever faced! Tasked with defeating each of his former adversaries again, Gamera and the Spacewomen are the world's only hope against total enslavement.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Hercules And The Captive Women
description: Elvira's stuck hosting this Greek tragedy about Hercules and his voyage to Atlantis to rescue his son and battle an army of identical men and a strange up-right dragon.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: I Eat Your Skin
description: While hosting "I Eat Your Skin," Elvira complains that there's no actual flesh eating in the film, so she invents the I Eat Your Skin Diet and hawks Zombatrim pills.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Lady Frankenstein
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. The son Elvira never knew she had abruptly appears and tries to take over her show.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Legacy Of Blood
description: When their father dies, three greedy sisters and their husbands reunite to hear the reading of the will. His fortune is theirs, assuming, of course, they're able to survive a full week at the family mansion.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Maneater of Hydra
description: While vacationing in the Mediterranean, a group of tourists pays to spend a weekend exploring a lush island occupied by the botanist Baron von Weser.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Maneater Of Hydra
description: While vacationing in the Mediterranean, a group of tourists pay to spend a weekend exploring a lush island occupied by the botanist Baron von Weser and his bloodthirsty, carnivorous plants.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Monstroid
description: When a small Colombian village is viciously attacked by a creature from a nearby lake, a corrupt chemical company sends a specialist (Jim Mitchum) to destroy the beast and cover up their involvement with its creation. Inspired by a true story!

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Night Of The Living Dead
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira decides to clean out her basement, relaunch "Movie Macabre," and host "Night of the Living Dead."

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Santa Claus Conquers The Martians
description: Elvira celebrates Christmas with a stop-motion animated segment, a variety of puppets, stockings stuffed with amputees' legs, gingerdead men cookies and a special yuletide appearance by her longtime nemesis, The Breather.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Scared To Death
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares for her annual Halloween party by kidnapping Martha Stewart and holding her captive in a wooden crate.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Teenagers From Outer Space
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira gets in touch with her inner child while hosting "Teenagers from Outer Space."

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Devil's Wedding Night
description: A quest for the mythical Ring of Vermougglian leads the Schiller brothers to Transylvania and Castle Dracula, where they find more than they bargained for in the castle's current resident and her undead servant.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Doomsday Machine
description: When a Chinese plot to destroy the Earth is uncovered, the U.S. teams up with the Soviet Union to replace members of its all-male crew with women. Now, it's up to the crew of Project Astra to keep the human race alive and thriving.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Giant Gila Monster
description: Elvira pet-sits six animals while hosting "The Giant Gila Monster," but complications quickly arise when the pets begin feasting upon each other.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The House That Screamed
description: Headmistress Madame Fourneau runs her French boarding school for troubled girls with an iron fist. Still, one by one, her students are going missing without a single trace of evidence left behind.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Killer Shrews
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Manster
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to figure out a way to avoid being deported.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Satanic Rites Of Dracula
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira decides that the film she's hosting is so boring that she catches up on her reading and various personal chores.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Terror
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira mocks Roger Corman classic "The Terror" until she falls asleep.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Werewolf of Washington
description: While on assignment in Hungary, a young reporter is attacked by a mysterious animal.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Werewolf Of Washington (1981)
description: While on assignment in Hungary, a young reporter (Quantum Leap's Dean Stockwell) is attacked by a mysterious animal.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Werewolf Of Washington (2010)
description: Elvira decides to throw her "ring into the hat" and campaign for office. To improve election odds, she masquerades as Sarah Palin and accepts a phone call from the dreaded Breather.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: They Came From Beyond Space
description: After a team of scientists are dispatched to investigate the remnants of a meteor shower, they return controlled by a mysterious alien force. Meanwhile, nearby town residents are infected with the deadly "Crimson Plague."

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Tormented
description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira becomes paralyzed by a spider bite and is forced to watch "Tormented."

title: Elvis And Annabelle

description: Basado en hechos reales de un bombardeo de 1994 en Buenos Aires. "Esclavo de Dios" es la historia de Ahmed, un terrorista islámico asignado para ejecutar un atentado suicida en una sinagoga, y David, el agente especial israelí que hará lo que sea para evitar el ataque.

title: Escobar: La herencia maldita
description: Al morir su padre, su hijo de 16 años, Juan Pablo, se esfuerza por permanecer con vida en las ruinas del imperio de la droga que fue destinado a heredar.

title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
description: A young surfer, Nick, falls madly in love with a beautiful girl. It all seems perfect until he meets her uncle, the famous drug kingpin Pablo Escobar.

title: Escobar: paraíso perdido
description: Nick, un joven surfista, cree que todos sus sueños se han hecho realidad cuando va a Colombia a visitar a su hermano. Nick se enamora perdidamente de la bella María. Todo parece perfecto hasta que Nick conoce al tío de la joven, un tal Pablo Escobar.

title: Escogiendo un cachorro
description: Acompaña a estas familias mientras visitan a varios criadores, propietarios y refugios de animales en un intento por encontrar el cachorro perfecto, descubriendo tanto sobre ellos mismos en el proceso como sobre las razas que exploran.

title: Escondete
description: Dos parejas jóvenes han elegido un nuevo sitio para su borrachera: un cuartel abandonado donde hace 45 años, una niña, con discapacidad mental, fue seducida y violada, estrangulada y luego quemada.

title: Escritores de la libertad
description: Hilary Swank protagoniza esta emocionante historia sobre chicos de barrio, que han crecido entre disparos y actitudes muy difíciles, y la maestra que les da lo que más necesitan: una voz propia.

title: Escríbeme en Navidad
description: Jessica envía tarjetas de Navidad a aquellos quienes son especiales para ella; la tía que la crió, su hermano, una estrella del pop que envejece, la maestra que la inspiró, y su amiga que siempre dice la verdad.

title: Escuadron oculto
description: Versión de la gran pantalla de la impactante serie de televisión de los 60. Un trío de delincuentes juveniles se convierten en policía secreta para infiltrarse en una red de tráfico de drogas en Los Ángeles.

title: Escuadrón tiburón
description: En algunas de las regiones más remotas del planeta, los investigadores se sumergen en un peligro profundo y valiente para desbloquear comportamientos secretos de tiburones.

title: Escuela de la vida
description: Un nuevo maestro se enfrenta a su malhumorado competidor por el premio al maestro del año.

title: Escuela de verano (LAS)
description: Dos mujeres fundan una escuela de verano para jóvenes del continente, pero el consejero les roba el dinero.

title: Escuela para solteras
description: Amador quiere casarse con sus novia. La jefa de la familia le pone una condición: todas las hermanas mayores de ella tienen que casarse primero y por orden de edades. Siendo su novia la menor, Amador tiene que buscarles marido a todas sus cuñadas.

title: Espalda con espalda
description: Después de que un ex-policía (Michael Rooker, Guardians of the Galaxy) se ve atrapado en una batalla entre mafiosos japoneses y pandilleros locales, descubre que fue incriminado por un policía corrupto.

title: Espantapájaros de Amityville
description: Después de que su madre fallece, dos hermanas se encuentran como dueñas de un campamento de verano cerrado. Pronto, las hermanas aprenderán los secretos oscuros y mortales que sucedieron en el campamento de verano hace muchos años ... Y la leyenda de.. El Espantapájaros.

title: Españoles en el mundo
description: Programa que se acerca a destinos de todo el mundo a través de los españoles que han decidido instalarse en otro país. Estos ''nuevos emigrantes'' ofrecen su particular punto de vista sobre el país que los ha acogido.

title: Especialista
description: In this action-packed thriller, Jason Statham is a mechanic—an elite assassin wa strict code and unique talent for cleanly eliminating targets. Simon West (CON AIR) directs this hit remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson movie.

title: Especie mortal II
description: Un extraterrestre en forma de parásito se incuba en el cuerpo de un astronauta. Justin Lazard, Natasha Henstridge, Marg Helgenberger, Michael Madsen, Mykelti Williamson. Director: Peter Medak.

title: Especies
description: Un experimento genético genera a una hermosa mujer mutante que amenaza a la raza humana.

title: Especies III
description: A medida que su especie se extingue por infecciones y enfermedades, una alienígena seductora inmunológicamente más fuerte se convierte en la única esperanza para que sigan viviendo.

title: Especies: el despertar
description: Helena Mattsson y Ben Cross protagonizan esta aterradora continuación acerca de una sobrina y su tío que destapan la verdad de sus raíces alienígenas como consecuencia de una oleada de masacres. Dirigida por Nick Lyon.

title: Espérame en Siberia, vida mía (LAS)
description: El soltero y millonario Mauricio, cansado de ir de mujer en mujer e influenciado por su médico de cabecera, decide casarse. Sin embargo, su futuro suegro le pide cambiar su testamento.

title: Espía por accidente
description: Después de frustrar un intento de robo a un banco, un vendedor aburrido (Jackie Chan) se transforma en héroe. Su fama revela que es el último de una larga lista de espías profesionales, y se verá envuelto en un misterio que solo él será capaz de resolver.

title: Essex Boys
description: When an ex-con is released from prison, he returns home and realizes that his old cohorts have all profited from the empire he helped build. To restore his reputation and authority, he sets off a chain of events that shakes up the underworld.

title: Essex Boys Retribution
description: The next generation of Essex Boys vie for control 20 years after Britain's most infamous gangland murders as revenge is sought by all sides.

title: Estación zombi
description: Una desgarradora película de terror y suspenso zombi, que sigue a un grupo de pasajeros aterrorizados que se abren camino a través de un brote viral en todo el país. Atrapados en un viaje en tren bala, lleno de sospechas y drenado de sangre hacia la zona segura.

title: Estado paranormal
description: Sigue la vida del estudiante de la Universidad de Pensilvania, Ryan Buell, y los demás miembros de la primera sociedad de investigación paranormal apoyada por la universidad (alias PRS) mientras buscan la verdad detrás de aterradores misterios.

title: Estallido mortal
description: Mientras graba sonidos en exteriores, un técnico de efectos sonoros (John Travolta) captura el mortal accidente de un candidato a la presidencia. Pero, ¿el sonido que oyó fue el estallido de un neumático o el disparo de un asesino?

title: Estampillas de droga
description: La película cuenta la historia de un valiente e inteligente oficial de policía, Wu Xian Jun, que se gana la confianza de un narcotraficante, Hua Ge, con su comportamiento tranquilo y decidido.

title: Esther
description: Experience the Bible story of Esther, who infiltrated the King of Persia's harem in order to stop a planned genocide of Jewish people, saving many innocent lives.

title: Esther
description: Following the conquest of Babylon, the King of Persia gives a banquet for his people, but his wife, Vashti, refuses to attend. Ahasuerus disowns Vashti and goes in search of her replacement.

title: Esther And The King
description: When a modern-day girl faces a big challenge in her life, her mother teaches her about the power of fasting by sharing the story of a heroine from the Bible.

title: Estrella del Sur
description: Vivir en Estrella del sur no es fácil. Allí, las vidas de cuatro adolescentes se han cruzado desde siempre en un entorno violento y carente de una esperanza en el futuro.

title: Estrella quiero ser
description: La determinación de Lorena por darle un giro a su vida y escapar de un entorno decadente, hará que encuentre en la actuación un camino que le ayudará a descubrir sus talentos y habilidades.

title: Estructuras enormes
description: La fascinante historia del deseo de la humanidad de levantar grandes construcciones. Esta fascinante serie analiza algunas de las empresas más grandes en construcción, ingeniería civil y fabricación, mostrando el ingenio continuo del hombre.

title: Eternally Yours
description: Anita Halstead, swept off her feet by magician Arturo, finds the results less than magical.

title: Etheria
description: Step into the dark and twisted world of Etheria, the ultimate anthology series where fierce female filmmakers deliver spine-chilling horror, mind-bending sci-fi, and pulse-pounding thrills, one bold, unforgettable story at a time.

title: Ethiopiques
description: The story of forgotten Ethiopian musicians who became an considerable inspiration for free jazz and pop music nowadays.

title: Eureka
description: Set in the Canadian wilderness, about a gold prospector (Hackman) who, after a gold strike, moves to a Caribbean island where his reward will be misery and paranoia and pursuit by killers.

title: Europa Report
description: Six top astronauts set out to explore the possibility of a hidden ocean – and life – beneath Europa’s icy surface. After a near-catastrophic technical failure, the survivors must overcome the tolls of deep space travel.

title: Eva Braun: In Love With Adolf Hitler
description: It was a strange affair, full of love, lust and despair... That of Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun, his mistress from 1932 to their double suicide in Hitler's Berlin bunker, that fateful day in April 1945.

title: Eve Of Destruction
description: After an unexpected mishap during testing, Eve VIII, a sophisticated android, begins killing anything she perceives as a threat. Now, a terrorism expert must find and deactivate her before she realizes her ultimate capability: nuclear annihilation!

title: Eve of Destruction
description: Two scientists find a way to harvest the power of "dark energy," using a tool called the "Proteus Accelerator." In theory, it will drill a hole in the universe and power our world forever.

title: Evelyn
description: Based on the true story of Desmond Doyle, who after losing his job and watching his wife leave with another man, has his children taken away by an arcane custody law. Doyle cleans up his act and wages an unlikely legal battle to regain custody.

title: Evelyn (ESP)
description: Son tiempos difíciles en Dublín, Irlanda. Pero nadie lo tiene más difícil que Desmond Doyle cuando su esposa se marcha y el gobierno decide mandar a su amada hija Evelyn y sus otros dos hijos jóvenes a un orfanato.

title: Even Dwarfs Started Small
description: The inhabitants of an institution in a remote country rebel against their keepers. Their acts of rebellion are by turns humorous, boring and alarming.

title: Even Mice Belong In Heaven
description: Two enemies - a little Mouse and a Fox, who after an accident, meet in animal heaven. They lose their natural instincts and become best friends. Their wish to stay together after they return to earth comes true, but they are reborn into opposite roles.

title: Even Money
description: Gambling addiction brings the stories of three otherwise unconnected people together as it destroys each of their lives.

title: Even When I Fall
description: An intimate, beautiful film that harnesses the visual power of circus to give a unique perspective into the complex world of human trafficking.

title: Event Horizon
description: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

title: Event Horizon: La nave de la muerte
description: En 2047, un equipo de astronautas se embarca en una misión para recuperar una nave espacial. Sin embargo, esta simple tarea los conducirá a algo mucho más aterrador de lo que imaginaban.

title: Every 40 Years
description: An exploration of Gunhill Road's return to music 40 years after breaking into the Billboard Top 40 charts in 1973. Every 40 Years is about second chances and the power of chasing your dream down one more time.

title: Every Day
description: Based on David Levithan’s novel, this charming romance tells the story of a 16-year-old girl (Angourie Rice) who falls in love with a spirit named A, a traveling soul who wakes each morning in a different body, living a different life... every day.

title: Every Day is a Saturday: Poor Boyz
description: Every day begins with a process, even on a Saturday. This season, Poor Boyz brings you a candid account of what it takes to get from point A to point B. 'Everyday Is A Saturday' will bring the entirety of the sport into light.

title: Every Other Holiday
description: Two sisters' only wish is to spend the holidays as a family, forcing their divorced parents to work out their issues and find love again.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description: Inspired by his childhood experiences, comedian Chris Rock narrates the hilarious, touching story of a teenager growing up as the eldest of three children in Brooklyn, New York during the early 1980s.

title: Everybody Hates Christmas
description: A family that has lost faith in Christmas, is reminded that the spirit of the holiday is more than just gifts.

title: Everybody Loves Chris Rock
description: Comedian, actor, and producer Chris Rock boasts critical acclaim and global stardom. We take an intimate look into the life of one of the world's greatest entertainers as fans agree Everyone Loves Chris Rock.

title: Everybody Loves Somebody
description: Karla Souza (How to Get Away with Murder) stars as a young single doctor in L.A. who’s torn between two lovers—and two futures—in this fun-filled bilingual romantic comedy.

title: Everybody Loves Sunshine
description: Two cousins lead a Manchester street gang against rising Triad power. While one seeks to leave crime behind for love, the other's obsession threatens their lifelong bond. An aging gangster tries to prevent all-out war.

title: Everybody Wants Some!!
description: In 1980, freshman Jake and his new rowdy teammates must navigate their way between girls, parties and baseball, all in the last weekend before college begins. From writer and director Richard Linklater comes the movie that proves good times never get old.

title: Everyday But Christmas
description: A Christmas-hating author is taken by fate on a ride outside of his comfort zone and back to a place where he will face his fears, find his fate, and ultimately discover the true meaning of Christmas.

title: Everyone Is Going To Die
description: A father tries to reconcile with his daughter by inviting her to his house for dinner. But when the home is invaded by two masked individuals armed with shotguns, a lethal game of cat and mouse ensues, culminating in a life-altering revelation.

title: Everything and Nothing: The Amazing Science of Empty Space (2012)
description: Uncover the true size of everything and the learn amazing science behind empty space. Part science, part philosophy and part history, this film combines all these elements into a gripping and spectacular narrative that are truly unforgettable.

title: Everything I Ever Wanted
description: During pivotal moments in their lives, a struggling musician and a budding playwright collide, igniting a spark that will change their lives forever.

title: Everything is Both
description: This thriller follows a girl who runs for her life and depends on a mysterious stranger to escape danger and pull off the biggest score of her life.

title: Everything That Glitters
description: Victoria Robinson seems to have the perfect life. But her unfaithful husband and a sexy younger man with dark motives will lead her into a dangerous game of cat and mouse, where she'll discover that the perfect life comes with a high cost.

title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
description: Woody Allen heads up an amazing cast including Gene Wilder, Tony Randall and Lynn Redgrave, in several hysterical vignettes that spoof the unorthodox joys of sex.

title: Evidencias del Crimen
description: Al enfrentar el crimen, la única solución del investigador es hacer que las pistas hablen. No existe un crimen perfecto. Asalto, secuestro, asesinato... el culpable siempre deja rastros detrás de él.

title: Evil
description: Swedish filmmaker Mikael Hafstrom directs the coming-of-age drama Ondskan (Evil), based on the autobiographical novel by Jan Guillou.

title: Evil Cat
description: Master Cheung is the last of a large family whose members for centuries have protected the Earth from a demonic cat with nine lives.

title: Evil Dead II
description: Ash, the sole survivor of THE EVIL DEAD, returns to the same cabin in the woods and again unleashes the dead. With his girlfriend possessed and his body parts running amok, Ash must again single-handedly battle the damned in this unhinged horror classic!

title: Evil Takes Root: The Curse of the Batibat
description: Felix must battle the forces of evil and unravel the mystery of the Batibat in order to save Amanda's daughter, Sarah, from its hellish grip.

title: Evil Under the Sun
description: Agatha Christie detective Hercule Poirot returns in this 'sleekly designed whodunit' set in a posh island resort.

title: Evilspeak
description: An outcast military cadet taps into a way to summon demons and cast spells on his tormentors through his computer.

title: Evolución
description: Una aventura de alto octanaje para descubrir cómo la naturaleza puede ayudarnos a resolver los mayores desafíos de la humanidad.

title: Evolución
description: Un recluta de bombero, dos profesores universitarios, y la geek científica enviada por el gobierno, luchan contra un organismo alienígena que ha evolucionado rápidamente desde que llegó a la tierra dentro de un meteorito.

title: Evolution
description: Embark on a journey through the depths of the ocean, the beautiful savannah and the majestic forest to discover amazing creatures and the characteristics they have developed to evolve and adapt to their environment.

title: Ex psicópata
description: Una relación tóxica toma un giro aterrador cuando la ex de un hombre reaparece con intenciones siniestras.

title: Excavating the 2000 Year Old Man
description: A documentary that explores the origin and influence of The 2000 Year Old Man, the classic comedy routine created by Mel Brooks and Carl Reiner.

title: Excellent Cadavers
description: The story of the biggest anti-mafia trial in history and the people who made it possible.

title: Exceptional Beings
description: Two Immortal Gods, Athena and Hermes, who have lived on earth for over 4000 years, find out that there is much to the planet than they have always believed, when then come into contact with Mina, a woman who makes them question their own reality.

title: Exes of Christmas Past
description: An ambitious hotel manager returns to her family's B&B for Christmas to find all three of her high school exes staying there.

title: Exhibition Awesome
description: From extreme sports and gymnastics to fitness, martial arts and more - all you need to be awesome is passion, determination and a camera.

title: Exists
description: A camping trip becomes a blood-soaked nightmare as five friends are terrorized by a mysterious creature seeking vengeance.

title: Exit Speed
description: Strangers use improvised weapons, adrenaline and sheer guts to mount a defense against murderous bikers and their survival depends on doing the unthinkable - fighting for their lives!

title: Exit Strategy
description: James gets evicted from his apartment and has no choice but to move in with his girlfriend Kim. He quickly discovers that she is not what he wants and needs an exit strategy fast. But for Kim, breaking up just isn't an option.

title: Exit The Dragon, Enter The Tiger
description: A student of Bruce Lee travels to Hong Kong to search for answers.

title: Exodus
description: Paul Newman delivers an inspiring performance as a resistance fighter who helps rescue 600 Jews from detention camps which results in the rebirth of an entire nation.

title: Exorcism At 60,000 Feet
description: We all know that air travel can be hell, but on the last flight of a transatlantic passenger airliner, things turn positively demonic when a pandemic of infernal possessions breaks out, spreading from passenger to passenger and eventually to the pilot.

title: Exorcist Chronicles (2013)
description: Demonic possessions are occurring at an alarming rate. The ultimate battle between good and evil commences with a perpetrator so ancient only the illuminated know of its existence.

title: Expecting
description: When Andie (Michelle Monaghan, SOURCE CODE) gets pregnant after a one night stand, she offers to give the baby to her best friend (Radha Mitchell, RED WIDOW), who has been unable to conceive. But can their friendship survive the pregnancy?

title: Expecting Amish
description: Expecting Amish tells the story of 18-year-old Hannah Yoder, who is ready to join the Amish Church and marry her boyfriend Samuel. But things change when she goes to Hollywood and gets a glimpse of the world beyond.

title: Expedition Antarctica
description: Join a team of marine scientists as they embark on an unprecedented journey across the great Southern Ocean and beyond to Antarctica. In this extreme environment, the stakes are high but if successful; their findings could profoundly affect all our lives.

title: Expedition Borneo
description: Wildlife adventure series following explorers on the tropical island of Borneo.

title: ExperiMental
description: ExperiMental travels the world in search of the craziest experiments ever performed and challenges the scientists responsible to repeat their bizarre experiments in front of the cameras.

title: Experimenter
description: Stanley Milgram (Peter Sarsgaard) conducts an experiment in which people think they’re delivering electric shocks to strangers. Ignoring pleas for mercy, most subjects don't stop because they’ve been told to go on. With Winona Ryder and Jim Gaffigan.

title: Expired
description: A turbulent and intriguing love story between two parking officers in the city of Los Angeles.

title: Explicit Ills
description: A drama of four interconnecting stories revolving around love, drugs, and poverty in Philadelphia.

title: ExplodingTNT in the Minecraft Summer
description: This summer was amazing! In this movie, we look at the top 3 videos on the ExplodingTNT channel from Summer 2017!

title: Exploited
description: When a college freshman becomes obsessed with a missing webcam model, he and his friends are terrorized by a voyeuristic hacker.

title: Exploradores
description: En su laboratorio improvisado, tres niños hacen uso de su ingenio y un descubrimiento sorprendente para construir una nave espacial y emprender un increíble viaje interplanetario.

title: Explorers
description: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

title: Exploring Hitler's Berlin/Munich
description: This series explores the Third Reich's architectural ambitions, including Berlin's unrealized transformation into the global capital 'Germania' and Munich's redesign as the 'capital of the movement'.

title: Exploring Hitler's Mountain
description: Adolf Hitler spent over 1,000 days on the Obersalzberg, his mountain holiday refuge near Berchtesgaden. It was there he made his decisions about war and destruction.

title: Expo - Magic of the White City
description: Narrated by Gene Wilder, "Expo - Magic of the White City" immerses viewers in one of the most unforgettable events in American history, the Chicago World's Fair of 1893.

title: Exposure, Vol. 1
description: In this first installment of the Exposure Series, we'll follow professional climbers Dave Graham, Nalle Hukkataival, Matt Wilder, Cheyne Lempe, Mason Earle, Angie Payne, and Cody Roth.

title: Exposure, Vol. 2
description: Exposure Vol. II is the second installment in the Exposure Series and follows five of the strongest climbers in the world in four heart-pounding segments.

title: Exquisite Corpse
description: A gifted med student revives his dead girlfriend, but each day she lives demands another life in return.

title: Exterminators Of The Year 3000
description: In a post-apocalyptic future where the earth is a desert and water is the most precious substance of all, a band of survivors must turn to a mysterious stranger to battle a ruthless gang of motorcycle psychos for control of the wasteland and the water.

title: Extortion (2017)
description: Near death, family man Riley must race to find his dying wife and son on an unfamiliar island before their time runs out.

title: Extra-Terrestres
description: Una familia, 100 000 pollos con una sentencia de muerte, una niña con un secreto que revelará a su familia, y una estrella a 2500 años luz, los hará entender que todos estamos, metafóricamente, fuera de este mundo.

title: Extraordinary World with Jeff Corwin
description: Everyday people who are making an extraordinary impact on the world through advocacy, conservation, youth empowerment, and more.

title: Extraterrestres ancestrales: el origen de la Humanidad
description: La creciente evidencia y los avistamientos de ovnis sugieren contacto con seres extraterrestres que pueden haber influido en los orígenes de la vida humana.

title: Extraterrestres contra la guerra nuclear: Edgar Mitchell
description: 12 caminantes lunares afirman que los extraterrestres visitaron la Tierra, el gobierno lo encubrió. Los extraterrestres detuvieron la guerra nuclear. ¿Una locura o vale la pena escuchar más?

title: Extraterrestres de las profundidades
description: Explora los misterios de las profundidades marinas: anomalías submarinas, abducciones alienígenas, USOs y casos inexplicables que desafían nuestra comprensión.

title: Extraterrestres en la URSS
description: Misterios alienígenas sin resolver de la Unión Soviética: incidente del Paso Dyatlov, milagro de Petrozavodsk, caso Voronezh. Asombro y miedo, pero duda de la participación alienígena.

title: Extraterrestres entre nosotros: la teoría de Michael Wolf
description: Michael K. Wolf comparte 30 años de ideas sobre ovnis, extraterrestres, proyectos gubernamentales y círculos de las cosechas.

title: Extraterrestrials: They Are Among Us
description: Embark on a gripping journey as witnesses share chilling encounters with UFOs.

title: Extravagant Spaces
description: There are everyday homes and then there are homes with a little something EXTRA. Designer Kelli Ellis takes her curiosity behind the doors of some seriously phenomenal homes. Kelli deep dives into the world of utterly extravagant home design.

title: Extreme Cake Makers
description: A reality series lifting the lid on the elite bakers turning cakes into works of art. Narrated by Rufus Hound.

title: Extreme Dinosaurs Series
description: In the present, a team of four anthropomorphic dinosaurs created by aliens, must stop three anthropomorphic velociraptors, who want to cause a cataclysm that would speed up global warming and make Earth's climate pleasant for dinos again.

title: Extreme Dodgeball
description: Eight teams battle it out in this competitive sports game show based on the playground game. Hosts Bil Dwyer and Zach Selwyn mock the action play by play in front a live audience.

title: Extreme Iceland (LAS)
description: El explorador Mike Wilson siempre ha querido experimentar aventuras de los deportes más extremos y tiene la mirada puesta en el destino perfecto: Islandia.

title: Extreme Legends
description: Don't miss out on these classic matches featuring only the greatest Pro-Wrestling Extreme Legends that ever stepped into the squared circle.

title: Extreme Mission In Antarctica
description: How do you build a research station in Antartica? The wild Antarctic ocean is the definition of 'extreme conditions,' after all. This is the dramatic story of the building of the Jang Bogo Antarctic Station.

title: Extreme Salvage Squad
description: Any job, any time.Enter the high-stakes world of marine recovery and rescue with Extreme Salvage Squad. Based in the Whitsunday in Australia.

title: Extremities
description: In a Golden Globe®-nominated performance that stunned critics and audiences alike, Farrah Fawcett stars as a woman who turns the tables on a would-be rapist and walks the perilously thin line between justice and vengeance. Alfre Woodard co-stars.

title: Extremity
description: A young woman obsessed with horror subjects herself to hours of grueling torment inside an extreme haunt in an attempt to confront her fears and conquer the tragic past that haunts her.

title: Eye For An Eye: The Blind Swordsman
description: After being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman, a highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman seeks justice—and revenge.

title: Eye of the Beast
description: After several locals disappear off the coast on Fells Island, a small fishing community in the North Atlantic, terrified survivors claim the existence of a Giant Squid.

title: Eye of the Beholder
description: A private eye shadows a female serial killer of men all over the U.S. without her knowing as he, strangely enough, occasionally acts as her guardian angel.

title: Eye See You
description: In this twisting cop thriller, an alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic after a serial killer targets his friends and family.

title: Eye Trip
description: Turn out, tune on, and drop in. Skiing’s counterculture continues to buck the trends of what’s come before them- this is a worldwide documentation of ski action as you’ve never seen it presented before!

title: Eyes of the Dead
description: After a plague of zombies invades a family’s once-peaceful hometown, the havoc they wreak is deadly. Taking place in real time, it’s a zombie thriller that immerses the audience in a pulse-pounding, innovative survival experience.

title: Eyes of the Mothman
description: A feature length documentary of the real story behind the legend of The Mothman.

title: Eyes Wide Open
description: The modern movement in skiing is progressing more than ever, and it is hard to keep up with the stream. Field Productions has gathered skiers with all different backgrounds, but they all share the same vision about skiing.

title: Eyes Without A Face
description: A surgeon causes an accident which leaves his daughter disfigured and goes to extreme lengths to give her a new face.

title: F/X
description: Rollie Tyler, a movie special-effects man, accepts $30,000 from the Justice Department's Witness Relocation Program to stage the fake assassination of a mob figure who has agreed to name names.

title: F/X 2
description: Movie special-effects expert Rollie Tyler gets himself into trouble again when he agrees to help a police officer catch a serial killer. With the help of an ex-cop pal and some of his own movie magic, Tyler outwits the bad guys.

title: F/X 2: Ilusiones mortales
description: El técnico de efectos especiales Rollie Tyler se vuelve a meter en problemas cuando acepta ayudar a un policía a atrapar a un asesino en serie. Con la ayuda de un policía retirado y su propia magia cinematográfica, Tyler derrota a los malos.

title: F/X: Efectos mortales
description: Rollie Tyler, un técnico de efectos especiales, acepta 30.000 dólares del Programa de Protección de Testigos para escenificar el falso asesinato de un miembro de la mafia que está dispuesto a dar nombres.

title: Face Value
