description: Big Game fishing is the most exhilarating and dramatic form of angling available to the modern-day fisherman. It is to fishing what the Grand Prix Circuit is to Motor Racing and this guide covers the many skills needed to take on the major fish species...

title: Guilty
description: Caught in a web of deceit, Traci is thrown into dager after she lies for a friend about an innocent teacher who commits suicide.

title: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
description: Martin Sheen and Brendan Fraser star in this true story chronicling a doubting father's realization of his wrongly convicted son's innocence and the six-year struggle to win his release.

title: Guinea Pig
description: Extreme performer Ryan Stock turns himself into a human guinea pig to test just how far the human body can go. Along with his partner in profession and in life, Amber Lynn Walker, Ryan travels all over North America.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: In 1939 the brilliant animation team of Max and Dave Fleischer took a break from Popeye and Betty Boop cartoons to tackle Gulliver's adventures in Lilliput.

title: Gumby's Christmas Capers
description: Join everybody s favorite playmates as they bring a world of Christmas adventure to life in these wonderful, stop-action holiday stories…

title: Gun
description: Presented by producer/director Robert Altman, Gun, a six-part anthology nominated for two Primetime Emmys, features stories about one particular pearl-handled gun falling into the hands of different sets of characters. Top writers, directors and actors including James Gandolfini, Martin Sheen, Kirsten Dunst, Edward James Olmos, Will Wheaton, and many others contributed to a different story in each episode.

title: Gun Shy
description: A spoiled and pampered, aging rock star (Antonio Banderas) must pull it together to find his wife, who gets kidnapped and held for ransom while on vacation in Chile.

title: Gun The Man Down
description: When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he’ll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

title: Guncrazy
description: A trashy teen (Drew Barrymore, "Never Been Kissed") murders her sexually abusive step-father, helps her reformed prison pen-pal get released on good behavior and takes off on the run.

title: Gundala
description: Basada en el exitoso cómic clásico Gundala. Cuando la avaricia y la violencia alcanzan un punto álgido, Sancaka, un huérfano convertido en malote, se convierte en la única esperanza de paz del pueblo.

title: Gundala
description: Based on the hit classic comic, Gundala is a poignant reminder that anyone can be a hero (though a superpower never hurts). When greed and violence reach a fever pitch, orphan-turned-badass Sancaka becomes the people’s only hope for peace.

title: Gunfight at Cold Cross
description: Willam McCarthy's quest for vengeance takes him to the town of Cold Cross where he goes up against those who betrayed and murdered his parents.

title: Gunfight at Dry River
description: In the Old West, a family of renegades controls the only water source in a Mexican border town ravaged by severe drought. However, when a stranger arrives to reclaim his father's land, a violent confrontation changes all of their lives forever.

title: Gunfight At The O.K. Corral
description: Frontier lawman Wyatt Earp joins his three brothers in their feud against the villainous Clanton gang, a local clan of cattle thieves in Tombstone, Arizona.

title: Gung Ho!
description: The true story of Carlson's Raiders and their World War II attack on Makin Island

title: Gunman from Bodie
description: The Rough Riders are back in town!  In this gritty Western favorite, which begins with a suspenseful opening sequence, the three Rough Riders are special agents assigned to look into a series of rustlings near the small town of Larabie.

title: Guns Akimbo
description: A guy relies on his newly acquired gladiator skills to save his ex-girlfriend from kidnappers.

title: Guns N' Roses: Live Rarities
description: Axl and the guys live on stage.

title: Guns N' Roses: Rock Case Studies
description: The ultimate review of the life and music of Guns N' Roses.

title: Guns Of Redemption
description: A scarred gunslinger tries leaving violence behind, but his past catches up. Near death from an ambush, he straps on his guns for one final mission: to save two captives and avenge a murdered priest before time runs out.

title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
description: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

title: Gunsight Ridge
description: Stage line agent investigates a series of robberies by taking the job of a deputy sheriff in a border Arizona town.

title: Gunslinger
description: When the town marshal is gunned down, his wife Rose (Beverly Garland) dons his badge. But now an evil dancehall diva (Allison Hayes) wants her dead and hires a gunslinger (John Ireland), who agrees to kill Rose...until he falls in love with her!

title: Gunslingers
description: In a town named Redemption, reformed gunslinger Keller and mad genius Ben are guided by spiritual leader Jericho towards vindication. While confronting their violent histories, their newfound peace is challenged by violence and revenge.

title: Gunsmoke
description: Marshall Matt Dillon is responsible for bring law and respectability to the Dodge City in this western action-drama. In black-and-white.

title: GunsNRoses: Appetite
description: A critical review of the album that changed the world, featuring unseen archive footage of performances and reflections from guitarist Izzy Stradlin.

title: Gurov & Anna
description: Ben is a failed writer-turned-academic whose "happily ever after" has begun to feel more like "the end". He immerses himself in Chekhov's story "The Lady with the Dog," a permanent fixture on his sylllabus, about an affair giving way to true love.

title: Gustavo Cisneros: Sin Descanso
description: Gustavo Cisneros: “Sin descanso” revela la fascinante vida del empresario desde su infancia en Caracas hasta su éxito global, afrontando desafíos con optimismo y trabajando incansablemente.

title: Gutterbug
description: A crust punk named Bug grapples with the realities of homelessness, mental health, drug use and toxic friendships. On his 21st birthday he resolves to find his way home, a decision that leads him and his misfit crew down a dangerous path.

title: Guy Martin vs. The Robot Car
description: Guy Martin investigates the most disruptive new technology to be introduced to the automotive world: autonomous vehicles.

title: Guy Martin: D-Day Landing
description: To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Guy Martin restores a Dakota plane and parachutes into the Normandy countryside where the operation occurred.

title: Guy Martin: Fastest Man on Two Wheels
description: This is the inside story about Guy Martin's fastest and most dangerous speed challenge to date: his recent attempt to break the Motorcycle Land Speed Record. The existing record is 376mph, beating it will mean Guy has to master a special one-off machine.

title: Guy Martin: Industrial Wonders
description: In this six part series mechanic, motorcycle racer and engineering enthusiast Guy Martin celebrates the workers of Britain's Industrial Revolution by getting stuck into six of the country's biggest restoration project.

title: Guy Martin: Last Flight of the Vulcan Bomber
description: British TV host Guy Martin helps restore the last airworthy Avro Vulcan bomber to prepare it for a 1,000-mile farewell tour of Great Britain.

title: Guy X
description: A young corporal is mistakenly posted to a base in Greenland, where no one believes his protests. Forced into the role of Public Information Officer, he befriends an injured soldier and stumbles on a conspiracy, with his blunders turning it into comedy.

title: Guys and Dolls
description: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

title: Guys Reading Poems
description: A resourceful boy creatively uses poetry to survive when his mother, a disturbed avant garde painter, locks him in a puppet box and builds an art installation around his imprisonment.

title: Gypsy
description: Tony Award winning musical of one of most famous stage mothers of all time comes to life in this award winning adaptation. Based on true-life story of gypsy Rose Lee, the famous striptease artist.

title: Gypsy (2015)
description: Loosely based on the memoirs of world-renowned striptease artist Gypsy Rose Lee, Gypsy follows the journey of the irrepressible Rose, the mother to end all stage mothers.

title: Gümüs
description: Gümüs es una humilde diseñadora de modas que se casa con el hombre de sus sueños, Mehmet Sadoglu, un chico atractivo y adinerado que todavía sufre la aparente muerte de Nihan, su amada novia.

title: H is for Happiness
description: Based on the award-winning book My Life as an Alphabet by Barry Jonsberg, it is the genuinely heart-warming and unflinchingly honest story of one twelve-year-old’s determination to unite her family and spark happiness in their lives.

title: H2O: Just Add Water
description: As if being a teen weren't hard enough, the three gals in this Australian fantasy series must cope with the added burden of growing a giant fin and transforming into mermaids whenever they come into contact with water -- a fact they try to hide.

title: Habit
description: There are as many paths as there are people. Some choose to be a carpet salesman, others choose to be skiers. These behaviors are part of life's routine, and consciously or not, we're all slaves to it somehow.

title: Habitación Ouija
description: Una mujer agorafóbica comienza a convocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano / cuidador no está durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo.

title: Haciendo de cupido
description: La hija de David Martínez comienza un negocio de citas para un proyecto escolar y planea todo para que su papá salga con su maestra.

title: Hacked
description: Rebel hackers fight to escape a data center overrun by a deadly artificial intelligence.

title: Hackers for Freedom
description: A fascinating investigation to meet activists and industrials who struggle to defend the free code, not only in the computer business, but every industry such as automobiles or agriculture.

title: Hada de dientes
description: Los adultos de una pequeña comunidad agrícola se reúnen, comienzan a darse cuenta de que el hada de los dientes maldita, que los traumatizó en su juventud, está suelta de nuevo. ¡Esta vez, viniendo tras sus hijos!

title: Hada de dientes 2: La raíz del mal
description: 20 años después de ser aterrorizada por el Hada de los Dientes, Corey comienza a sospechar que ha regresado para terminar el trabajo.

title: Hada de los dientes: La última extracción
description: Corey y su hija, Sally, decidieron irse de vacaciones de verano con sus amigos, Diane, Christy, Toby y Benny. Poco saben, el pasado de Corey lo alcanzará.

title: Haikara-San: Here Comes Miss Modern: Part 1 [Japanese-Language Version]
description: Adapted from Waki Yamato's popular manga, Haikara-San is a heartfelt, and sometimes comical, tale of love surviving through the perils of war and separation.

title: Haikara-San: Here Comes Miss Modern: Part 2 [Japanese-Language Version]
description: After marrying the head of the military, Benio hears her husband died in Siberia during a war. However after finding out he's alive and fighting against his home land, Benio starts looking for her first love.

title: Hail Satan?
description: Hail Satan? offers a look at a group of misunderstood outsiders whose commitment to social and political justice has empowered thousands of people. An inspiring and entertaining documentary from acclaimed director Penny Lane (Nuts!, Our Nixon).

title: Hair
description: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

title: Hair Brained
description: Eli, a 14-year-old genius outcast, attends Whittman College with Leo, a 41-year-old freshman with a gambling problem.

title: Hairy Bikers Route 66
description: The Hairy Bikers, Si King and Dave Myers, embark upon the famous American road traveling all the way from Chicago to Los Angeles, showcasing the diversity of the country's cuisine along the way.

title: Hakaba Kitaro
description: Kitaro, known as Hakaba (Graveyard) Kitaro for his eerie appearance, is the last of the long-standing Ghost tribe. Together with his father, he observes insatiable human greed from the standpoints of the Spirit World and the human world.

title: Half & Half
description: Half-sisters Mona and Dee Dee had only one thing in common – their father. Though they grew up separately, when these two virtual strangers become neighbors in the same apartment building, they realize that they share more similarities than they thought.

title: Half Built House
description: Tough talking property guru Sian Astley comes to the aid of those who have started their home renovation but have no idea how to finish it.

title: Half Light
description: Real terror and the supernatural conspire to haunt grieving novelist Rachel Carlson (Demi Moore, "G.I. Jane") when she moves to a remote Scottish village after the death of her son.

title: Half Magic
description: Three women use their newly formed sisterhood to fight against sexism, bad relationships and low self-esteem. Through embracing their wild adventures, they learn the secret to ultimate fulfillment.

title: Half Nelson
description: A powerful, award-winning film about an inner-city junior high school teacher with a drug habit who forms an unlikely friendship with one of his students after she discovers his secret.

title: Half of a Yellow Sun
description: Sisters Olanna and Kainene return home to 1960s Nigeria, where they soon diverge on different paths. As civil war breaks out, political events loom larger than their differences as they join the fight to establish an independent republic.

title: Half Off
description: HALF OFF! Half the crew, half the price, twice as good! If you are wondering where the Rendered Useless crew has gone, well most of them have come here mixed with some of the guys from Videogracias. This is our fall offering...enjoy

title: Half-Life of Memory: America's Forgotten Atomic Bomb Factory
description: In the suburbs of Denver, the U.S. secretly manufactured thousands of atomic weapons, leaving behind a toxic legacy that will persist for generations.

title: Halloweed
description: Stoner Trent, son of the Bridgeport Killer, and his best bud move to a small town to escape an evil legacy. But soon after they roll up, everything goes to pot as the bodies pile high and they must weed out suspects to smoke out the killer.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description: America's top bakers battle to create Halloween's spookiest treats.

title: Halloween Ball 2024
description: Get ready for a fierce competition of performances at Halloween Ball, sponsored by göt2b!

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description: Bakers compete to make the most ghoulish and outlandish Halloween cakes.

title: Halloween Dance
description: It’s Halloween and besties BeezBee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn the lion already picked out their Halloween costumes! Now it’s just about discovering where the best Trick Or Treat yummies are to be found!

title: Halloween Dance With Baby Shark
description: HALLOWEEN SHARK DANCE! How well can you follow the Halloween Sharks dance?

title: Halloween With The New Addams Family
description: America's first family of ghastly giddiness reunites for a Halloween celebration that will raise the…dead! John Astin, Carolyn Jones, Ted Cassidy, Jackie Coogan, Lisa Loring and Ken Weatherwax all reprise their roles from the hit original series!

title: Hallucinations
description: Aliens descend in crystal spaceships to make contact with people through guitar amp distortion and glowing animal skulls.

title: Hallways of Hope
description: Educators and students at Dixon Elementary Public School keep art real in and outside the classroom. Students led by teacher Joy Parham connect history and today’s news in spoken word poetry inspired by the school’s museum-like art collection.

title: Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn
description: UNSC Cadet Thomas Lasky must conquer his inner fears and join forces with super-soldier John-117 to take down a massive faction of the Covenant.

title: Halo Legends
description: The universe of the Halo video game series is expanded in seven short animated films from Japan's greatest anime directors and studios.

title: Halo: The Fall Of Reach
description: Animated series adapted from the original book, Halo: The Fall of Reach. It's an explanation and backstory of the shaping and creation of Spartan 117, The Master Chief.

title: Hamburger Hill
description: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

title: Hamilton: One Shot To Broadway
description: The story of the hit musical that changed Broadway forever and brought the genius of Lin Manuel Miranda to the attention of legions of fans across the world. Featuring interviews with Miranda, as well as the cast and crew of Hamilton.

title: Hamish MacBeth
description: Hamish is a young policeman, whose beat is the apparently sleepy village of Lochdubh in the Scottish Highlands. However, bizarre cases have a habit of coming his way, and, despite his laid-back style, Hamish has a shrewd knack of solving them.

title: Hamlet
description: Prince Hamlet struggles over whether or not he should kill his uncle, whom he suspects has murdered his father, the former king.

title: Hamlet
description: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, finds out that his uncle Claudies killed his father to obtain the throne, and plans revenge

title: Hammer
description: Fred Williamson stars a boxer on the rise who is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success. His moral dilemma hits close to home when the life of his girlfriend (Vonetta McGee) is put in jeopardy.

title: Hammer House Of Horror
description: This British anthology series, which was produced by England's leading exporters of horror films, told tales of haunted houses, demons, ghosts, and other supernatural wonders.

title: Hammer Of The Gods
description: Britain, 871 AD – A young Viking warrior’s epic journey across terrifyingly hostile territory gradually sees him emerge as the man his father wants him to be – the ruthless and unforgiving successor to his throne.

title: Handmade: Good with Wood
description: In this charming competition series presented by the hilarious Mel Giedroyc, woodworkers are tasked with crafting beautiful and ambitious builds.

title: Hands Across the Border
description: Horse breeders Adams and Brock are vying for the Army contract. When Adams is killed trying to ride his horse Trigger; Roy saves the horse from being shot. He trains him and then plans to ride him in the race to win the contract.

title: Hands of God
description: Executive produced by Academy Award winner Alfonso Cuarón, HANDS OF GOD is a stirring portrait of resilience in the face of crisis, as it follows the Iraqi National Boxing Team's historic attempt to qualify for the 2016 Summer Olympics.

title: Handyman Hal
description: Join Handyman Hal for family-friendly fun! Go on adventures, see how things work, and visit cool places like fire stations and garbage trucks. Learn and laugh with Handyman Hal!

title: Hang 'Em High
description: Clint Eastwood stars in this brazen tale about a rampaging band of vigilantes who make two mistakes: they hang the wrong man and they don't finish the job. Inger Stevens, Pat Hingle, Bruce Dern & Dennis Hopper co-star in this action-packed western.

title: Hang Out With Pinkfong And Baby Shark
description: An entertainment variety show hosted by Baby Shark and Pinkfong

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description: Just out of school and on his own for the first time, former college basketball superstar Mark Cooper shares a house with two beautiful women—his best friend and her roommate. Mark also happens to be the coolest substitute teacher around.

title: Hangman (2017)
description: Decorated homicide detective Ray Archer (Al Pacino) partners with criminal profiler Will Ruiney (Karl Urban) to catch one of the city's notoriously vicious serial killers.

title: Hangmen Also Die
description: After the German administrator of Czechoslovakia is shot, his assassin tries to elude the Gestapo and struggles with his impulse to give himself up as hostages are executed.

title: Hanna Ranch
description: Cattleman Kirk Hanna struggled to protect a once prominent way of life in Colorado. Born into ranch life, Hanna became a leader in the environmental ranching movement, setting out to protect encroachment of development and misuse.

title: Hannah
description: Hannah is the intimate portrait of a woman's loss of identity as she teeters between denial and reality. Left alone grappling with the consequences of her husband's imprisonment, Hannah begins to unravel.

title: Hannah And Her Sisters
description: Woody Allen wrote, directed and stars in this comedy/drama about the amorous affiliations of three sisters and the men in their lives. Story touches on such universal themes as life, death, love, adultery, religion and family relations.

title: Hannah Has a Ho Phase
description: When Leslie, a brazen pole-dance instructor, gets fed up with her prudish roommate, Hannah, she challenges her to the bet of a lifetime: Hannah must sleep with ten guys while Leslie does the unthinkable and re-virginizes".

title: Hannibal
description: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

title: Hannibal Hopkins & Sir Anthony
description: This captivating documentary tells the lesser-known story of a well-known actor: two-time Academy Award winner Anthony Hopkins, whose career has spanned more than 60 years and 300 movies.

title: Hannibal Rising
description: Young Hannibal moves in with his aunt and begins plotting revenge after his baby sister is killed during World War II. Based on Thomas Harris' novel.

title: Hannibal: The Father of Strategy
description: There have been few military leaders through the ages to have become truly memorable but one strategist stands out from the crowd in the 21st Century, even though he lived long, long ago, before the birth of Christ. The man in question is of course Han...

title: Hanoi Hilton
description: A group of POW'S, captives inside Hanoi's Hoa prison during the Vietnam War, endure some brutal lessons in the art of survival and find dignity in the bargain.  A top-notch drama with a superb cast.

title: Hans Christian Andersen
description: The opening scene of the movie describes it best: "Once upon a time there lived in Denmark a great storyteller named Hans Christian Andersen. This is not the story of his life, but a fairy tale about the great spinner of fairy tales."

title: Hans Christian Andersen My Life as a Fairy Tale
description: The inspiring and true fairy tale life of the world’s most magical storyteller, Hans Christian Andersen.

title: Hansan: Rising Dragon
description: In 1592, Korea is facing the threat of the powerful Japanese navy. As defending admiral Yin Sun-sin’s forces fall into crisis, they resort to a secret weapon—the dragon head ships known as geobukseon—to change the tide of the war.

title: Hansel & Gretel Get Baked
description: Stoner siblings Hansel and Gretel battle an evil witch (Lara Flynn Boyle) who uses a magical blend of marijuana to lure in teenage bait. Will this be the last high of their lives?

title: Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters
description: Get ready for a twisted take on the classic tale as Hansel and Gretel have turned pro, coping with the trauma of their childhood captivity by slaying witches for hire.

title: Hansel vs. Gretel
description: Trapped under a dark spell, Gretel assembles a coven of witches that starts to terrorize the town until Hansel gains the courage to fight his sister and the sinister forces that control her.

title: Hansel y Gretel: Cazadores de brujas
description: Prepárate para una versión retorcida del cuento clásico. Convertidos en profesionales, Hansel y Gretel se enfrentan al trauma de su cautiverio infantil, asesinando brujas a sueldo.

title: Happily Ever After
description: A young documentary filmmaker (Janet Montgomery) turns her camera on her former best friend (Sara Paxton), a seemingly carefree bride-to-be, in this delightful dramedy about family and secrets - and best friends forever.

title: Happy as a Cat
description: The famous writer Bernard Werber narrates this fantastic journey into the feline world. After being obsessed with ants, cats have become his new passion.

title: Happy Birthday
description: When two friends embark on a journey to Mexicali for a Birthday celebration, they soon realize their psychedelic shenanigans have taken a turn for the worse.

title: Happy Days
description: The Cunningham family live through the 1950s with help and guidance from the lovable and almost superhuman greaser, Fonzie.

title: Happy Endings
description: Happy Endings weaves multiple stories to create a witty look at love, family and the sheer unpredictablity of life itself.

title: Happy Go Lucky
description: A look at a few chapters in the life of Poppy, a cheery, colorful, North London schoolteacher whose optimism tends to exasperate those around her.

title: Happy Happy Christmas
description: Come join Baby Shark and Shark Family for fun Christmas Caroling!

title: Happy Happy Joy Joy - The Ren & Stimpy Story
description: Happy Happy Joy Joy chronicles the rise and fall of one of the most influential animated series. It's the story of a group of talented artists whose incredible work created two of the most beloved characters of all time - Ren and Stimpy

title: Happy Hell Night
description: A fraternity-hazing prank goes terribly wrong and a psychotic killer is set loose. Now a relentless evil has been unleashed, and the coeds of Winfield College will face the bloody horror of Happy Hell Night.

title: Happy Hunting
description: An alcoholic drifter must battle withdrawal and psychotic rednecks after he becomes the target of a deranged sporting event.

title: Happy, Texas
description: Dos convictos fugitivos son confundidos con dos asesores de un concurso de belleza local en la ciudad de Happy, Texas y se hacen pasar por la pareja que organiza el concurso. ¡Los dos se enfrentan rápidamente a consecuencias impredecibles!

title: Hara-Kiri: Death of a Samurai
description: Revenge, honor, and disgrace collide when a samurai's request to commit ritual suicide leads to a tense showdown with his feudal lord. From cult auteur Takashi Miike (13 ASSASSINS). In Japanese w/ English subtitles.

title: Harbin
description: Layered with explosive visceral action and complex political intrigue, Woo Min-ho’s Harbin is a gripping tale of a nation on the edge of conquest. As Japan marches toward Korean annexation, heroic freedom fighters formulate a deadly plan.

title: Harbinger Down
description: While studying the effects of global warming on a pod of whales, graduate students on the ship Harbinger uncover a frozen Soviet space shuttle. After 30 years of thawing from the ice, a once trapped monstrous organism is unleashed on the students.

title: Hard Boiled [English Subtitled]
description: A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.

title: Hard Breakers
description: Driven by a history of dating pitfalls and frustration, Alexis and Lindsay decide to turn the tables and devise a plan to lure unsuspecting men to their lair.

title: Hard Cash
description: Released from prison, an infamous thief and his new crew pull off a brilliant robbery, but then become embroiled with a corrupt FBI agent when they discover the money is marked.

title: Hard Copy
description: A rookie reporter gets drawn into a shady, sexy club scene as she writes about it.

title: Hard Country
description: A factory worker (Jan-Michael Vincent) with no ambition loves a woman (Kim Basinger) who wants to pursue a life outside of Texas.

title: Hard Holiday
description: Weeks before Christmas, a struggling single mom battles addiction to reclaim her voice—and the love she lost.

title: Hard Time
description: A cop does time for a crime he did not commit and then comes out of prison to track down the person who set him up.

title: Hard Time: Hostage Hotel
description: When a congressman's daughter is taken hostage in a deserted hotel, a disgraced ex-cop and his drunken ex-partner may be the only ones who came save her.

title: Hard Time: The Premonition
description: A serial bomber terrorizes a city, leaving no clues in his terrifying wake and a veteran police officer investigates the cops only witness: a notorious convicted murderer.

title: Hardball
description: An aimless young man who is scalping tickets, gambling and drinking, agrees to coach a Little League team from the Cabrini Green housing project in Chicago as a condition of getting a loan from a friend.

title: Hardball: The Girls of Summer
description: “Hardball: The Girls of Summer” follows the top female baseball players in the USA, all members of the globally ranked US Women’s National Baseball Team.

title: Hardware Wars
description: The original Star Wars Parody from 1978!

title: Hardwell & the Metropole Orchestra - Symphony
description: Experience Hardwell's last performance to date, as he takes you on a journey through 30 years of Dance Music.

title: Hardwell - Live at the Biggest Guestlist, Mumbai
description: Experience Hardwell live in India as he performs for the biggest guestlist in Mumbai.

title: Hardwell - United We Are, The Final Show Live at Hockenheim
description: Experience Hardwell's last show of his world tour in Hockenheim; a crowd of 40.000 was bathed in the light of one of the biggest light installations in the world.

title: Hardy Bucks
description: A circle of young men entertains vague ambitions involving quick cash, women, and showbiz in this mockumentary on small-town Irish life.

title: Harlem Nights
description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

title: Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man
description: Don Johnson and Mickey Rourke race onto the screen as two modern-day "Robin Hoods" in this futuristic adventure film that features high-speed motorcycles, daring stunts, and explosive action.

title: Harold Risks It All
description: Harold Buttleman, a small-town tuxedo salesman, thinks he's the next great daredevil. He is on the brink of TV stardom, a 3am spot on the late night cable access, but the life of a daredevil stuntman is harder than it looks.

title: Harper
description: Recently orphaned, Harper must choose between the troubled aunt she loves and the mother she's never met.

title: Harpoon
description: Rivalries, secrets, and sexual tension emerge when three friends find themselves stranded in the middle of the ocean.

title: Harriet And Herbert's Day At The Beach
description: Two hermit crabs, Harriet and Herbert, find friendship during their adventurous sunny day at the beach.

title: Harriet the Spy: Blog Wars
description: Young spy Harriet Welsch and popular student Marion Hawthorne both vie to become the official blogger of their high school class.

title: Harriet Tubman: They Called Her Moses
description: This compelling documentary narrated by Alfrelynn Roberts features expert interviews with leading scholars.

title: Harry & Meghan: A Modern Royal Romance
description: Meet the newest royal couple Prince Harry and Meghan Markle as we follow the story from the beginning of their unconventional romance to engagement and discover how an American actress will become a member of the British Royal family.

title: Harry & Meghan: A Modern Royal Wedding
description: Follow the royal couple's journey from the engagement to their epic wedding with actual footage, the cake and flowers to the location - Windsor Castle - with commentary from close friends, correspondents and stylists.

title: Harry & Meghan: The Next Step
description: On January 8th 2020 The Duke and Duchess of Sussex made a shocking announcement that sent ripples around the world... they were leaving the Royal Family.

title: Harry & Meghan: The Price of Freedom
description: Harry and Meghan's decision to leave royal life behind was far and away from the stiff upper lip announcements of the past. Now for the first time we're taking a look behind the headlines at a version few of us got the chance to hear.

title: Harry & Meghan: The Revelations
description: Ever since the former Duke and Duchess of Sussex left royal life for Los Angeles tension has been mounting between the two households. Too many questions remained unanswered as the newly independent couple built their new life together.

title: Harry & Meghan: Two Became Three
description: Life hasn't slowed down since their happily ever after. Now the Duke and Duchess of Sussex are officially a family as they announce the birth of their new son, Archie Harrison Mountbatten-Windsor. Celebrate this momentous occasion and get up close and ...

title: Harry & Meghan: Your Royal Invitation
description: You are invited to the most anticipated royal event of the year. The long-awaited wedding of Great Britain's Prince Harry and American actress, activist, and sweetheart Meghan Markle. On November 27th, 2017 the couple will be in Windsor Castle.

title: Harry & Snowman
description: This is the Cinderella story of immigrant Harry DeLeyer and the plow horse he rescued from slaughter. Together, Harry and Snowman beat the odds, winning jumping competitions and worldwide fame.

title: Harry And Son
description: This character study centers on the agonies and delights of a widower and his artistically inclined son, who try to salvage their relationship after the father gets fired from his construction job.

title: Harry Benson: Shoot First
description: The illustrious career of the renowned photographer who has taken some of the most vibrant and intimate portraits of The Beatles, Muhammad Ali, Michael Jackson, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., Winston Churchill and many more.

title: Harry Brown
description: An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.

title: Harry Dean Stanton - Partly Fiction
description: A lyrical conversation with legendary actor Harry Dean Stanton.

title: Harry Enfield's Television Programme
description: Harry brings his collection of characters to television.

title: Harry Price: Ghost Hunter
description: A TV movie about Britain's real-life ghost hunter and skeptic Harry Price, who investigated tales of the paranormal and supernatural.

title: Harry Tracy
description: By the year 1900, Butch Cassidy, the Sundance Kid, John Wesley Hardin, and virtually all of the West's legendary outlaws are either dead or in jail pending execution-all of them, that is, except train robber and escape artist extraordinaire, Harry Tracy.

title: Harsh Times
description: An unstable Gulf War veteran with a savior complex receives a shocking wake-up call upon returning stateside and accepting a position with the Department of Homeland Security.

title: Hart Of Dixie
description: Rachel Bilson leads a stellar ensemble cast in this fish-out-of-water comedic drama about small-town living, big-city attitudes and complicated love triangles. Hart of Dixie — it's where you want to be.

title: Harts of the West
description: After suffering a heart attack, Dave Hart decides to pursue his dream of living in the Wild West. After committing to the change, Dave soon discovers that the idea of becoming a cowboy doesn't quite encapsulate the reality.

title: Harvest of Fire
description: An FBI agent is sent to investigate an arson in a peaceful Amish township, but she must first gain the trust of an Amish widow suspicious of outsiders. Stars Lolita Davidovich and Patty Duke.

title: Hashtag Blessed
description: It's Christmas time and Jessi is all but excited. She finds herself with comparisonitis in the world of social media. Will she continue down her dark path of negativity and struggle, or will the magic of Christmas shine?

title: Hasta que voces humanas nos despierten
description: Helena Bonham Carter y Guy Pearce protagonizan esta romántica historia australiana de fantasmas acerca de un psiquiatra que salva a una mujer suicida del ahogamiento, pero luego comienza a revivir recuerdos dolorosos de su pasado.

title: Hatari
description: Director Howard Hawks reteams with John Wayne, who heads a group of highly skilled professional game hunters in Africa. Only they don’t use bullets – they capture the ferocious big game with strong rope and cameras for zoos and circus attractions.

title: Hatched
description: Even the smallest creatures can make a big difference in this eggs-ceptionally funny adventure!

title: Hatched
description: When a spaceship crashes into their barn, animal friends set out on an incredible adventure

title: Hatchet II
description: HATCHET II serves up a ferocious and exceptionally gory dose of splatterific entertainment with groundbreaking make-up effects, a wildly twisted sense of humor, and an even darker and bloodier ride than the first film.

title: Hatchet III
description: In this action packed slasher, murderous Victor Crowley takes on an entire police department, paramedic team, and heavily armed S.W.A.T. unit, forcing Marybeth and the troops into an epic showdown.

title: Hateship, Loveship
description: A rebellious teen orchestrates a star-crossed romance between her nanny (Kristen Wiig) and dad (Guy Pearce) in this adaptation of an Alice Munro story. Also stars Nick Nolte.

title: Hatfields and McCoys: Bad Blood
description: Starring Jeff Fahey, Perry King, and Christian Slater. When a Union soldier on his way home crosses paths with a family of Confederate supporters, a bloody feud erupts between neighboring families.

title: Hats Off To Christmas!
description: For ten years, Mia has been a loyal and hard-working small-town Christmas hat shop manager. But this holiday season, her boss has gifted her a disappointing revelation.

title: Haunted Heart
description: At a seaside restaurant, Alex falls for manager Max, but desire soon twists into a harrowing fight for survival.

title: Haunted Places
description: Haunted Places explores some of the most remarkable haunted places in America. This companion piece to Hauntings Across America investigates some of the most baffling cases of ghostly activity.

title: Haunted Transylvania
description: Take a scary ride this Halloween season with creepy images, eerie sounds and scary music that will put you and your family in the Halloween spirit!

title: Haunted Transylvania 2
description: Turn your house into a Halloween haunted house party with Haunted Transylvania 2! Sing-Along and dance all night in this fun halloween celebration for kids of all ages.

title: Haunted Transylvania 3
description: This Halloween, turn your home into a haunted house party with songs, sights and frights!  Sing-Along and dance all night in this fun Halloween celebration. Spend some time with the dancing Skeletons, twist your hip with Frankenstein and jump around with ghosts!

title: Haunters: The Art Of The Scare
description: A mind-blowing documentary about how haunted houses for Halloween have spawned a controversial subculture of full-contact terror simulations. Go inside the most notorious extreme haunt in the world and ask yourself - how far is too far?

title: Haunting: Australia
description: Hailing from all corners of the globe, six of the best ghost hunters in the business have joined forces to investigate paranormal activity in Australia’s most haunted locations.

title: Hauntology
description: An older sister takes her runaway sibling on a road trip, to share the most chilling tales surrounding their hometown.

title: Hav Faith
description: Hamilton A. Vaughn, aka HAV, is catapulted as leader of prominent Mission Church where issues arise among him, the son of the retiring bishop, and a money-hungry real-estate broker.

title: Havana Motor Club
description: Reforms have offered opportunity in Cuba, but the children of the Revolution are unsure of the best route forward.

title: Havana Motor Club LAS
description: El cambio es correr por las calles de La Habana, donde los mejores corredores de arrastre subterráneos de Cuba luchan por preparar sus  hot rods clásicos para la primera carrera oficial de autos desde la Revolución.

title: Have Gun Will Travel
description: One of the most popular series of the 50's, featuring the adventures of Paladin, a high-priced, West Point-educated "gun for hire" in the ceaseless battle for law and order in the post-Civil War west.

title: Haven
description: Fritz owes money to the dangerous drug dealer Richie Rich and tells him about the fortune Carl has. Along a Friday 13th night, their lives entwine in a chain of tragic events.

title: Having It All
description: Thera Baylin owns a massive fashion empire, with divisions in New York and Los Angeles. In each of those cities, Thera's got a separate husband, each entirely unaware of the other's existence.

title: Hawaii
description: In this spectacular film starring Julie Andrews, Max von Sydow, Richard Harris and Gene Hackman two cultures collide when the Rev. Abner Hale (von Sydow) and his wife (Andrews) attempt to convert early 19th-century Hawaiian natives to Christianity.

title: Hawaii
description: Martin and Eugenio, two former childhood friends, reunite during a hot summer in the Argentinean countryside. As they work to restore Eugenio's summer home, a game of power and desire ensues forcing the two to grapple with their sexual attraction.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description: Special agent Steve McGarrett (Jack Lord) and his men keep Hawaii safe from villains in this consummate cop show.

title: Hawkeye
description: Hawkeye the woodsman meets a brave English woman trying to free her husband from the French. Set during the French and Indian War in the area of the Hudson Valley.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description: Nat Cutler, known as Hawkeye, is a fur trader. With his faithful Indian companion Chingachgook, the last of the Mohican tribe, he fights to protect settlers against the raiding Huron Indians.

title: Haywire
description: A highly trained operative, is double crossed & left for dead by someone in her own agency. When things go haywire, she finds ways to turn the tables on her ruthless adversary.

title: Hazlo como hombre
description: Mauricio Ochmann y Aislinn Derbez protagonizan esta divertidísima comedia sobre un hombre cuyo mundo se pone patas arriba cuando su mejor amigo - y futuro cuñado - le anuncia que es gay.

title: He Dreams Of Giants
description: Years after Lost in La Mancha, Keith Fulton and Louis Pepe come back to follow Terry Gilliam's new attempt at filming The Man Who Killed Don Quixote.

title: He Kills Coppers
description: Based on the best-selling book by Jake Arnott, this is a tense, crime drama set amidst London's World Cup fever of 1966.

title: He Loves Me... He Loves Me Not
description: A talented art student named Angélique is passionately in love with Dr. Loïc Le Garrec, a handsome married man whom she believes will leave his wife, Rachel. Loïc does leave Rachel after she miscarries.

title: He Never Left
description: A fugitive couple hides in an old motel, only to find themselves the next targets of the terrifying 'Pale Face' killer.

title: He Sees You When You're Sleeping
description: A young man's Christmas homecoming turns into a nightmare as a killer in a Santa suit gruesomely picks off his estranged, wealthy family for their fortune.

title: He Walked by Night (1948)
description: This iconic film noir stars Richard Basehart as a cold-hearted cop killer. This feature from director Alfred Werker is generally considered one of the great police dramas of all time, and a forerunner of TV's Dragnet.

title: He Was A Quiet Man 2020
description: An office worker inadvertently becomes a hero after he saves a woman's life.

title: He's Way More Famous Than You (2013)
description: When an aspiring actress loses her support system in one fell swoop, she sets out with a stolen script, her brother, and his boyfriend to make a movie.

title: Head Count
description: A group of college students on a weekend getaway accidentally summon a supernatural entity intent on using them for its deadly ritual.

title: Head Games
description: From Oscar nominated director Steve James ("Hoop Dreams") comes this revealing documentary about the concussion crisis in sports.

title: Headhunters
description: Roger is a charming scoundrel and Norway’s most accomplished headhunter. He lives a life of luxury well beyond his means and subsidizes his expensive lifestyle by stealing highly prized art.

title: Heading Home: The Tale of Team Israel
description: The underdog journey of Israel's national baseball team competing for the first time in the World Baseball Classic after years of defeat. The team laughs, cries, and discovers the pride of representing Israel on the world stage.

title: Headless Horseman
description: Seven college kids take a shortcut on their way to a party and unfortunately end up in Wormwood, where the spirit of the Headless Horseman hunts them one by one.

title: Healed By Grace
description: When a horrific accident shatters her dreams of becoming a world class dancer, Riley Adams (Natalie Weese) clings to her faith, determined to recover in time for the national competition.

title: Healed By Grace 2
description: Jesse is approaching her 15th birthday and the only gift she desires is a horse. Unbeknownst to Jesse, her mother Brandy is in the throes of a cancer diagnosis which has Jesse’s father jumping through unexpected obstacles.

title: Healer, The
description: A young man discovers he has the family gift of healing. A teenage girl with terminal cancer shows him how to help others and believe in himself.

title: Healing Scars
description: UK cage fighter and mixed martial artist Rob 'C4' Sinclair, battles to overcome a career-threatening injury in order to fulfill his dream of fighting in the USA.

title: Healing Towers
description: The detective's search for his daughter uncovers a sinister psychiatrist's facility where patients are forced to live out their darkest fantasies on innocent victims.

title: Hear Me Move (2016)
description: Muzi, the son of a famous street dancer tries to discover the truth about his father's tragic death 12 years prior. When he joins forces with his father's dance partner, he finds himself embroiled in a bitter rivalry that pushes him to his limit.

title: Heart Of A Champion
description: Charlie, a fourteen-year-old girl, from a divorced home, has a dream of raising a horse and competing in a riding competition.

title: Heart of Broadway
description: Heart of Broadway goes inside Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS for an in-depth look at the organization and its key players. Since 1988, they have raised more than $195 million for essential services for people with AIDS and other critical illnesses.

title: Heart of Stone
description: When Ron Stone becomes the principal, his school is overrun with gangs. Fearless, he convinces the local leader of the Bloods to help keep kids in school.

title: Heart Of The Country
description: With her husband jailed for Wall Street fraud, Faith leaves her life of luxury behind to return to rural North Carolina and the father and sister she'd left behind.

title: Heart of the Golden West
description: When the crooked truckers responsible for moving the local cattle herds decide to jack up their rates, Roy Rogers and his posse convince a wary riverboat operator to save the ranchers by running a water route up to Cherokee City.

title: Heart of the Manor
description: Before her sister's wedding, real estate agent Lisa is in competition with handsome developer Matthew who wants to buy her family's historic estate. But could he hold the key to Liz's heart?

title: Heart Of The Rio Grande
description: Gene Autry tames a spoiled teenage shrew sent to a Dude Ranch for the summer and in the process humanizes her father into being a better parent. Action includes stampeding horses, and a bold rescue!

title: Heartbeat
description: This beloved and long-running British soap follows the lives and adventures of the police constabulary, medical staff and residents of small-town 1960s Aidensfield.

title: Heartbeat (1946)
description: Arlette Lafron (Rogers) is a young pick pocket recruited by a corrupt foreign ambassador to steal a valuable watch from a wealthy and handsome young diplomat (Jean Pierre Aumont). Arlette not only bungles the job, but falls head over heels for her would-be victim. This entertaining remake of a popular French comedy stars such screen heavyweights as Basil Rathbone and Adolphe Menjou, was directed by Sam Wood (A Day At The Races and A Night At The Opera), and will have you thinking twice about your next European vacation!

title: Heartburn
description: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

title: Heartland
description: Heartland is an award-winning multi-generational drama that tells the story of a family making it through life together in both happy and trying times.

title: Heartland en español
description: Heartland es un drama multigeneracional ganador de premios que cuenta la historia de una familia haciéndole frente a la vida, juntos, en las buenas y en las malas.

title: Hearts & Bones
description: This slice-of-life ensemble drama follows a group of twenty- and thirty-something friends from Coventry who all move to London. Featuring appearances by Isla Fisher and Michael Fassbender.

title: Hearts Afire
description: John Ritter returns to TV in this genial sitcom. His life is somewhat complicated by his wife's father having spent a long stretch in prison for financial impropriety and her somewhat-unnecessary attempts to re-integrate him with society.

title: Hearts and Bones
description: Daniel is preparing an exhibition of his work from the world's war zones. When Sebastian learns that this exhibition may display photographs of a massacre in his village, he finds Daniel and appeals to him to exclude those photographs.

title: Hearts Beat Loud
description: A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.

title: Hearts Under the Olive Tree
description: When a world-renowned author can't find inspiration for her next fantasy book, her over-bearing mother takes her to a farmland retreat to get her creative juices flowing.

title: Heartstrings Attached
description: Violin prodigy Emma can make her dreams come true with an inheritance who's stipulation has her grandfather playing matchmaker from the grave.

title: Heartthrob
description: Henry is overjoyed to fall into an unexpected romance with popular Samantha the summer after high school graduation. When Henry spirals into twisted obsession, Samantha pulls back. Now he will never let her go, and things get dangerous.

title: Heathcliff
description: Heathcliff is based on a comic strip created by George Gately in 1973 featuring the title character, a wisecracking cat. Heathcliff knows he is the best cat around! When Heathcliff is not grabbing fish from the market or teasing Spike, he is full of love and good will for others, despite himself.

title: Heathers
description: Winona Ryder, Christian Slater, and Shannen Doherty star in this cruelly hilarious dark comedy, which became one of the biggest cult classics of the `80s.

title: Heaven
description: Two inspiring real-life stories are intertwined with never-before seen footage of Billy Graham talking about heaven, filmed at his North Carolina mountain home.

title: Heaven (2002)
description: A woman takes the law into her own hands after police ignore her pleas to arrest the man responsible for her husband's death, and finds herself not only under arrest for murder but falling in love with an officer.

title: Heaven Is Waiting
description: Though it’s been years since his wife died, Ned Stevens still cringes at the thought of dating. After all, why would he start seeing other women when he has to look out for his daughter Liz?

title: Heaven Sent
description: Elise, a grandmother hurt by her past, and Patrick, a widowed pastor, have closed the door on love. But with faith and a little help from technology, will their live-streamed romance find a way?

title: Heaven's Burning
description: After a botched bank job, a gang takes hostage a Japanese girl on the run from an arranged marriage. Their wheelman saves the girl from them and the two go on the run with cops, the gang, and her psycho husband on their tail.

title: Heavenly Sword
description: A power-hungry ruler known as King Bohan seeks to obtain the long-protected Heavenly Sword in order to use its devastating power for evil. Why doesn't anyone ever use immensely powerful swords for good anymore?

title: Heavy
description: Drug-dealer Sev and his equally broken girlfriend Maddie accept a risky deal from an old childhood friend, setting off an irreversible chain of events.

title: Heavy Metal: The Evolution of the Naval Warship
description: This film covers the evolution of the design and armament of ocean-going warships. The ships filmed include the Golden Hinde, the Amsterdam, H.M.S. Victory, H.M.C.S Sackville the last corvette, and more.

title: Hedgehog Hotel
description: The Hedgehog Hotel offers a rare and magical glimpse into the mysterious moonlit world of one of our best-loved, but little-known animals.

title: Heightened
description: Following a mental breakdown, an anxious young woman must return home for treatment. After she is unwillingly thrust into nature, she finds unexpected solace in the company of a neurotic park ranger, who is dealing with crippling issues of his own.

title: Held
description: A married couple is held hostage by an unseen, menacing stranger. The situation becomes brutal and they must work together to uncover the truth and find a way out before it’s too late.

title: Held for Ransom
description: Young Danish photographer Daniel Rye is captured by ISIS in 2013.

title: Heldorado
description: Roy Rogers goes to Las Vegas for the annual Heldorado Frontier Days Festival. There, he meets heiress Carol Randall, the Queen of the Heldorado. He learns that there are counterfeit thousand-dollar bills being passed over the gambling tables.

title: Helen
description: A talented professor is forced to come to terms with her clinical depression.

title: Heli
description: El trabajador de una fábrica se esfuerza por proteger a su familia de una corrupta fuerza policíaca cuando su joven hermana inadvertidamente lo lleva a una guerra del narcotráfico.

title: Hell and Back Again (2014)
description: From his embed with US Marines Echo Company in Afghanistan, photojournalist and filmmaker Danfung Dennis reveals the devastating impact a Taliban machine-gun bullet has on the life of 25-year-old Sergeant Nathan Harris.

title: Hell and Mr. Fudge
description: Join one man’s persistent pursuit of the truth behind what the Bible says and doesn’t say about hell in this thought-provoking family film.

title: Hell Baby
description: Jack (Rob Corddry) and Vanessa (Leslie Bibb) are an expectant couple that moves into the most haunted fixer-upper in New Orleans, a house with a deadly demonic curse.

title: Hell Fest
description: A serial killer in costume at a Halloween theme park kills off visitors, unbeknownst to bystanders who think it's part of the fun.

title: Hell Fest: Juegos diabólicos
description: En un parque temático de Noche de Brujas; un asesino serial disfrazado mata a los visitantes mientras los transeúntes creen que es parte de la diversión.

title: Hell Hath No Fury
description: When a powerful crime ring starts construction on the largest casino in all of Asia, the group is challenged by a young, vicious gangster (Jang Hyuk) from Seoul who will stop at nothing to gain power.

title: Hell House LLC 3: Lake Of Fire
description: Guests both past and present will be forced to battle for their souls as all is revealed about the Abaddon Hotel and the evil that dwells there. Set one year after the events of Hell House LLC II, the hotel is on the verge of being torn down when it is purchased by billionaire Russell Wynn as the new home for his popular interactive show, Insomnia. He invites journalist Venessa Sheppard and her crew to record everything happening inside the hotel leading up to the performance, but they soon encounter a more nefarious plot, one that threatens to unleash a veritable hell on earth.

title: Hell House LLC.
description: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

title: Hell Is For Heroes
description: It's 1944, and Nazi forces along the Siegfried Line have the numbers, the fortifications and the firepower to break through. GIs have little more than a dogged determination and the ingenuity to fool the Germans into thinking they are allies.

title: Hell Of The Living Dead
description: An accident at a chemical plant unleashes a horrific virus. When an elite SWAT team is sent to the hellish island to investigate, they discover a plague of flesh-eating zombies as well as a beautiful female reporter who practices nude anthropology.

title: Hell Town
description: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner.

title: Hell Up In Harlem
description: Sequel to Black Ceasar with Fred Williamson starring again as the underworld king of Harlem, the leader of a black syndicate who works his rackets like Robin Hood, doing continuous battle with dishonest politicians, corrupt police, and even his sidekick.

title: Hell's Kitchen (Censored)
description: In this five-time Emmy-nominated reality show, celebrity chef and Michelin Star-winner Gordon Ramsay roasts aspiring restauranteurs as they compete for the opportunity to run one of his eateries.

title: Hellboy: Blood & Iron
description: When Hellboy, Liz Sherman, and Abe Sapien are assigned to investigate the ghost-infested mansion of a publicity-hound billionaire, they uncover a plot to resurrect a beautiful yet monstrous vampire from Professor Bruttenholm’s past.

title: Hellboy: Sword Of Storms
description: A folklore professor becomes unwittingly possessed by the ancient Japanese demons of Thunder and Lightning.

title: Hellboy: The Dark Below
description: Hellboy falls into an ancient underground ruin where he descends into a mysterious doorway, through a tunnel, and down to a subterranean cavern with a lake that is home to a dormant monster.

title: Hellions
description: A teenager must survive a Halloween night from Hell when malevolent trick-or-treaters come knocking at her door.

title: Hellmouth
description: From the twisted mind of writer Tony Burgess comes a stunning, spectacular ode to classic horror and fantasy.

title: Hello Horror
description: Boys and Ghouls, welcome to Hello Horror with your host Vanessa Decker. A horror variety show filled with spooky guests, red carpet events, haunted houses, creepy cocktails, and more!

title: Hello I Must Be Going
description: An affair with a 19-year old actor (GIRLS' Christopher Abbott) helps reinvigorate life for thirty-something Amy after she moves home to her parents’ house following her divorce, in this humorous take on modern relationships.

title: Hello, Bookstore
description: In the shadow of the pandemic, a small town rallies to protect a beloved local bookstore.

title: Hello, It's Me
description: A woman coping with the loss of her husband and the task of raising two children on her own meets a handsome, rich man but doesn't feel right about pursuing anything. Stars Kellie Martin and Kavan Smith.

title: Hellraiser
description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

title: Hellraiser II: Hellbound
description: Kirsty is brought to an institution after the horrible events of Hellraiser (1987), where the occult-obsessive head doctor resurrects Julia and unleashes the Cenobites and their demonic underworld.

title: Hellraiser: Revelations
description: A pair of buddies on a mission to get laid over spring break unwitting release the demon Pinhead who creates havoc. This is the ninth film in the horror franchise.

title: Hells Angels On Wheels (1967)
description: At first gas station attendant Poet is happy when the Hells Angels gang finally accepts him. But he's shocked when he learns just how brutal they are.

title: Hell’s Kitchen en español
description: Un grupo de concursantes deberán superar pruebas para demostrar que son los cocineros con la mayor habilidad gastronómica. Todo ello lo harán bajo la atenta mirada de Gordon Ramsay.

title: Help I've Shrunk the Family
description: When Johannes discovers Wiplala, a little man with magical powers who lives in the cupboard, an errant spell accidentally shrinks him and his family. Now they must figure out a way to return everyone to normal and discover the courage inside themselves.

title: Hemlock Grove
description: In this Emmy-nominated series from executive producer and horror master Eli Roth, secrets are just part of daily life in the small town of Hemlock Grove, where the darkest evils hide in plain sight.

title: Hendrix (2000)
description: On stage, Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) electrified audiences with his powerful guitar playing and mesmerizing performances. But behind the scenes -- fueled by a dark haze of drugs and alcohol -- this rising star was on a crash course with destiny.

title: Henri Dauman: Looking Up
description: Henri Dauman spent his career photographing the likes of Marylin Monroe, Elvis Presley, & JFK. But few know his remarkable origin story rebuilding his life after being orphaned in WWII to become one of the greatest photojournalists of the 20th century.

title: Henry and Anne: The Lovers Who Changed History
description: Henry and Anne is an insightful and dramatic documentary that examines who the real Anne Boleyn and Henry VIII were, exploring the powerful effect their relationship had on history.

title: Henry V
description: A young and uncertain monarch, King Henry defeats the French, but sadly learns that victory takes its toll in bloodshed.

title: Henry V
description: In the midst of the Hundred Years' War, the young King Henry V of England embarks on the conquest of France in 1415.

title: Henry VIII's Enforcer: The Rise and Fall of Thomas Cromwell
description: Thomas Cromwell has gone down in history as one of the most corrupt and manipulative ruffians ever to hold power in England. Diarmaid MacCulloch reveals a very different image of Cromwell.

title: Henry's Crime
description: Released from prison for a crime he didn't commit, an ex-con targets the same bank he was sent away for robbing. Starring an ensemble cast including Keanu Reeves ("John Wick").

title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer: 30th Anniversary Edition
description: A seemingly mild-mannered drifter introduces an ex-con and his innocent sister into his world of cold-blooded killing in this shocking and thought-provoking plunge into the mind of a murderer.

title: Her Composition
description: A talented, artistically stuck composition student starts seeing escort clients after failing to secure her scholarship. Struck with unexpected sounds during her sexual encounters, she turns them into music and the clients into her muse.

title: Her Little Secret
description: When Lerrez finally manages to turn her life around, her dark past finds its way back in. How far will she go to keep HER LITTLE SECRET?

title: Her Sister's Keeper
description: Kate's life is turned upside down when her younger sister, Melissa, disappears. When Kate investigates, she discovers that a large amount of drug money vanished with her sister.

title: Her Smell
description: A self-destructive punk rocker struggles with sobriety while trying to recapture the creative inspiration that led her band to success.

title: Herb Alpert Is…
description: Herb Alpert, musician, artist and legend, has sold more than 72 million albums and co-founded A&M Records, the most successful independent record company in history. Herb Alpert Is...  looks at his life with rare footage and interviews.

title: Hercules in the Haunted World
description: Hercules must journey to the bowels of Hell to recover a magical plant to save a dying princess.

title: Hercules Reborn (2014)
description: When a young man's bride is kidnapped by an evil king, he turns to Hercules for help. Living in exile, banished for killing his family, the young man's courage inspires Hercules. They fight to rescue the bride and reclaim their honor

title: Hercules vs. The Hydra
description: Hercules must save his true love from an evil queen.

title: Herdsman Of The Sun
description: Herzog's documentary of the Wodaabe people of the Sahara/Sahel region. Particular attention is given to the tribe's spectacular courtship rituals and 'beauty pageants', where eligible young men strive to outshine each other and attract mates.

title: Here After
description: A struggling actor dies right after a bad breakup and finds himself in an afterlife where he's told that he must find true love in order for his soul to move on to the other side.

title: Here Before
description: Xia Tian is on the verge of a major discovery: time travel. When her son is kidnapped and killed, she desperately sends herself back in time, where she discovers multiple versions of her future self.

title: Here Come the Littles
description: When Henry Bigg's parents are lost in Africa, the boy must go live with his mean Uncle Augustus.

Now, a haunting look behind closed doors, uncovering the Eva Braun tapes.

description: Part 1 introduces Naresuan as a child prince captured by the Burmese King Bayinnaung in order to keep the province of Ayudhya subservient. Naresuan spends almost seven years away from home studying as a novice Buddhist monk.

title: Kingdom Of War: Part 2 (Aka King Naresuan Part 2)
description: Part 2 portrays Naresuan as a young adult prince, already a formidable military strategist, as he leads his army on exploits against breakaway kingdoms.

title: Kings of Beer
description: Kings of Beer is a documentary about a diverse group of elite Brewmasters from around the globe who compete in the world's most intense brewing competition.

title: Kings of Mulberry Street
description: An epic tale of two 9-year-old misfits who must overcome their differences and defeat the bullying local crime lord who's threatening their families.

title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
description: International superstar Charles Bronson is a vice squad veteran forced to battle his own racial prejudices when he's assigned to track down a young Japanese girl enslaved by a vicious child prostitution ring.

title: Kinks: IP
description: Leading the British invasion of America, The Kinks in Performance.

title: Kinky Boots
description: To save his family's shoe business from imminent bankruptcy, young Charlie Price turns to an unlikely new creative consultant: a fabulous drag queen whose creative style and wild designs are a breath of fresh air in the stuffy old factory.

title: Kirstie Allsopp's Home Style
description: This series is Kirstie's definitive guide to having a home you're proud of. Across four episodes she'll deliver master-classes that will show you how to be the ultimate home-maker. She will handpick her favorite moments and demonstrate bite-sized crafts.

title: Kirstie's Best of Both Worlds
description: Kirstie Allsopp, the walking encyclopaedia of house-buying knowledge, is back with a brand new series, helping people who are looking for the perfect home that will provide them with a slice of classic country living in easy reach of the city.

title: Kirstie's Celebrity Craft Masters
description: Kirstie Allsopp is back, and she's on a mission to share her love of all things handmade with some of the country's best-loved celebrities. Famous faces are taking on Kirstie's challenge to learn a host of new craft skills & let their creativity run wild.

title: Kirstie's Crafty Christmas
description: Kirstie shows how fast crafts can beat the clock. Her home-made delights include mince pie popcorn with pine tree syrup, a velvet Christmas cheesecake, a contemporary neon star, dramatic Christmas crowns, and traditional gifts.

title: Kirstie's Fill Your House for Free
description: Kirstie Allsopp takes on the challenge of transforming two homes each episode without spending any money! Showing how simple it can be to transform, repair, and give a new lease of life to once-loved furniture.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2014 Special
description: Christmas is coming and Kirstie home and crafting inspiration for the festive period.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2016
description: In this set of specials, Kirstie travels the UK to celebrate and indulge in everything that makes a great British Christmas. She visits castles, Christmas markets, stately homes, and drops in studios of some of the country’s most creative crafters.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2017
description: One great big Christmassy episode of festive cheer packed with wall-to-wall craft. We'll see Kirstie with some of the best crafters in the country, learning to make beautiful things that will make everyone's Christmas just a little bit more lovely.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2018
description: Kirsty returns with a joyful mix of festive makes, tricks, tips, and inspiration to help you celebrate the holiday magic. And they're all crafts that anyone can do.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2019
description: She's back with a joyful mix of festive makes, tricks, tips, and inspiration to help you celebrate the holiday magic. And they're all crafts that anyone can do.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2020
description: Kirstie provides a flurry of jovial festive fun - with enough competitions, makes, decorations, gifts, food and drink to inspire every kind of crafter.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas: Special: 2018
description: Kirstie shares her love of festive crafting and luxury presents.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas: Special: 2019
description: Kirstie shares her love of festive crafting and luxury presents.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas: Special: 2020
description: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas returns, bringing comfort and joy by the sleigh-load.

title: Kirstie's House of Craft
description: Combining archive favorites with brand new material shot in lockdown Kirstie proves there's a craft for everyone, sharing how to make bug hotels, homemade body scrubs, cushions and much more. You'll be surprised by the wonders you can create.

title: Kirstie's Vintage Home Christmas 2012
description: There’s a warm, festive glow in Kirstie’s vintage café, where she and her experts mentor homemakers and show how to inject a bit of vintage style into homes for the holiday season.

title: Kiss at Pine Lake
description: Luke Garvey buys his uncle's Camp Pine Lake only to find himself the owner of a sinking business.  Zoe McConnell, Luke's girlfriend from years ago, wants him to sell until an old flame is rekindled.

title: Kiss Me for Christmas
description: This Christmas, an unnoticed personal assistant has an unexpected encounter with her dream man, who's in a relationship with her boss. They're assigned to a project, growing closer, but their feelings risk her career.

title: Kiss Me For Christmas
description: After a chance encounter, a young assistant falls in love with her boss' Fiancee..He has no idea who she is.. She soon finds out that they are assigned to work on a Christmas project together.

title: Kiss Me, Stupid
description: In this comic gem from the legendary Billy Wilder and his long-time writing partner I.A.L. Diamond, Dean Martin is a famous singer targeted by two would-be songwriters who encourage a waitress (Kim Novak) to coerce Dino into a song-buying mood.

title: Kiss the Cook
description: Food blogger Kacey is approached with the opportunity to write a cookbook. The only problem is...she is actually not a good cook! With a little help from chef Gavin and a dash of chemistry, they may just have the recipe for success.

title: Kiss: Live in Las Vegas
description: This is the concert the world never got to see from the biggest live act in the music business. Go onstage with the world's hottest band as they perform the show over one billion people missed when the Internet servers crashed.

title: Kit Carson
description: Indian fighter, trapper, and frontier scout Kit Carson leads a wagon train of settlers from Fort Bridger, along the Oregon Trail through Shoshone territory, to California, which plans to secede from Mexico.

title: Kitchen Brigade
description: Cathy is a sous-chef wanting to open a restaurant. With financial difficulties, Cathy accepts a job at a shelter for young migrants. At first she hates the job then her passion for cuisine starts to change children's lives.

title: Kitchen Criminals
description: Kitchen Criminals is about the people who can't even boil water. These are the people that top chefs Angela Hartnett and John Burton Race are going to try and teach to cook like professionals.

title: Kitchen Nightmares en español
description: El célebre chef y ganador de una estrella Michelin, Gordon Ramsay, viaja por Estados Unidos intentando convertir restaurantes a punto de la quiebra en lugares de prestigio y convocatoria.

title: Kittie: Origins/Evolutions
description: Thrust into heavy metal stardom as teenagers with their debut release, the all-female Kittie has thrashed the heavy metal world for more than twenty years.

title: Kitty 911 (Blue Ant International)
description: Helpless and abandoned stray cats and kittens live in peril from predators and disease. Frontline cat sanctuary volunteers save kitties in crisis in these heart-warming rescues, relocations and adoptions.

title: Kitty is not a Cat
description: Kitty is Not a Cat is about a little girl 'Kitty' who believes she can be anything in life, even a cat. When Kitty arrives on the doorstep of a house full of partying felines.

title: Kitty the Killer
description: A highly trained teenage assassin, Dina, and her mentor, Charlie, form an unlikely duo as they unexpectedly join forces to stop a sinister plot and save millions of lives.

title: Klondike
description: The story of a Ukrainian family living on the border of Russia and Ukraine during the start of the war. Shortly after they find themselves at the center of an international air crash catastrophe on July 17, 2014.

title: Klondike: Quest For Gold
description: As seen on PBS comes this new \"living history\" series about eight \"average people\" who volunteer to relive an adventure. The epic 1200 kilometer journey by the Hudson's Bay Company fur traders of 1840s from Winnipeg, to the Hudson Bay.

title: Klowns asesinos
description: Cuando aterriza una nave con forma de carpa de circo y una tripulación de payasos alienígenas, la policía se muestra escéptica, pero al poco tiempo descubren que han venido para convertir a los habitantes de la Tierra en algodón dulce.

title: Knievel's Quest: Bigfoot
description: Join Kaptain Knievel, James “Bobo” Fay, and the Bluff Creek Group on their journey into the heart of Bigfoot Mecca – Willow Creek, CA. Explore this undeniably awesome Bigfoot habitat, discover recent encounters, and see evidence of its existence.

title: Knight Club
description: A wannabe actor becomes a bouncer and is seduced by the fast-paced world of Los Angeles nightlife.

title: Knight Hunters Eternity
description: Elite assassins Aya, Yoji, Ken and Omi return to fight a sinister new villain: a criminal organization masquerading as a school.

title: Knight Of Cups
description: A writer indulging in all that Los Angeles and Las Vegas have to offer, undertakes a search for love and self via a series of adventures with six different women.

title: Knightriders
description: A medieval reenactment troupe find it increasingly difficult to keep their family-like group together, with pressure from local law enforcement, interest from entertainment agents and a growing sense of delusion from their leader.

title: Knights of Badassdom
description: Live-action role players conjure up a demon from Hell by mistake and they must deal with the consequences.

title: Knock knock: seducción fatal
description: El gesto amable de un hombre de familia (Keanu Reeves) se convierte en una peligrosa seducción y el juego mortal del gato y el ratón cuando les abre la puerta a dos desamparadas jovencitas.

title: Knock Off
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme plays a fashion designer who must join forces with a C.I.A. agent to combat terrorism.

title: Knock, Knock, Hogi's Halloween
description: Sing and Dance with Hogi and Pinkfong!

title: Knockout Sportsworld
description: This Action Packed series brings you spectacular knockouts from across the globe. Knockout Sportsworld has all the jabs, hits, and collisions, slammed into one exciting show!

title: Knuckleball
description: After his Grandfather unexpectedly dies in the night, 12 year old Henry finds himself cut off and alone on an isolated farm.

title: Knuckleball!
description: A documentary that showcases baseball's most unpredictable pitch. Follow MLB's Tim Wakefield and R.A. Dickey through a dramatic MLB season. Featuring Phil Niekro, Charlie Hough, and Jim Bouton.

title: Knuckledust
description: A former marine is trapped in an elite underground fight club. When cops swoop in they discover only one man left alive, him. But all is not as it seems. Is he the sole survivor or a mass murderer?

title: Kobe Bryant: A Tribute
