category: Happy Birthday to Ian McKellan, Mike Myers, Ray Stevenson!

title: Richard Pryor: Live & Smokin'
description: Richard Pryor live comedy performance at the Improvisation in New York City.

title: Richard the Lionheart - The Trapped King
description: The story of King Richard, passionate, violent king who wielded Excalibur.

description: Explore Andalucia's rich mix of culture, cuisine, history, and natural wonders in Sevilla, Cordoba, and Granada. Soak in the sun's rays along the Costa del Sol, plus experience a dash of Britain in Gibraltar.

title: Rick Steves' Egypt: Yesterday and Today
description: In this hour-long special, Rick Steves explores the historic and cultural wonders of Egypt, from Cairo and Alexandria to Luxor and Abu Simbel.

title: Rick Steves' Europe
description: Rick Steves, author of the acclaimed travel guides Europe Through the Back Door, showcases the best of Europe.

title: Rick Steves' European Christmas
description: Join Rick Steves for a colorful, musical celebration of Christmas in eight joyous locations throughout Europe. Experience bright Christmas markets, hear local choirs, share holiday traditions with families… and even play in the snow.

title: Rick Steves' European Easter
description: Rick Steves sheds new light on the timeless 2,000-year-old holiday of Easter. From the holiday's pagan roots to its glorious finale, celebrate Easter in a variety of European countries and cultures, and a fascinating mix of traditions.

title: Rick Steves' European Festivals
description: It is party time in Europe. In addition to its epic history and culture, Europe also knows how to celebrate with amazing gusto. Joining Rick, we drop in on the Continent's top festivals, each one rich with tradition, great food, and fun.

title: Rick Steves' Iran: Yesterday and Today
description: Travel expert Rick Steves calls Iran the most poorly understood yet fascinating land he has ever visited. Rick journeys to Iran in the hopes of getting to know this ancient country, a leader in its corner of the world for 2,500 years, and to better understand the 70 million people living there.

title: Rick Wakeman: The Ultimate Anthology
description: In this appreciation of Rick Wakeman's artistry, we showcase his best concert performances with both a full electric band and just a solo piano.

title: Riddle of the Bones: Gender Revolution
description: Hunting men, gathering women - that is the picture of prehistory. The man as a hunter was long regarded as the main breadwinner of the family and is said to have been at the top of society from the very beginning of human history.

title: Ride Above
description: A teenager is raised with horses at her parent's racehorse stable who has a deep exceptional bond with young horse. An accident threatens to bring racing careers to an end but they battle together to achieve victory.

title: Ride In The Whirlwind
description: Two out of three cowboys (Cameron Mitchell, Jack Nicholson) run for their lives after meeting up with outlaws and a lynch-law posse.

title: Ride On
description: When debt collectors repeatedly try—and fail—to seize a horse from a stuntman, video of the attempt goes viral. Furious, the debt collectors return, leading to hilarious, action-packed antics that outdo even the pair’s most daring acts.

title: Ride Till I Die
description: Ricky Ringer enjoyed a stellar bull riding career, but he could never win a championship. 25 years later, with his son, Lil' Ricky, and fellow rider Ernie Courson by his side, Ricky is determined to chase that elusive title or die trying.

title: Ride to Freedom: The Rosa Parks Story
description: Rosa Parks recalls events leading to her act of peaceful defiance against racial bus segregation and inspiring the 1955 Montgomery Bus Boycott.

title: Ride with Norman Reedus
description: The Walking Dead star and motorcycle enthusiast Norman Reedus hits the open road to explore the local biker culture around the world.

title: Ride, Ranger, Ride
description: Former Texas Ranger Gene Autry receives a commission as lieutenant in the U.S. Cavalry and, along with troopers Frog Millhouse and Rufe Jones, reports to Colonel Summeral at Fort Adobe.

title: Ride: United
description: Join offroad superstars Antonio Cairoli and Jeffrey Herlings while they train in the Netherlands for the MXGP before watching Tom Pag.

title: Riders In The Sky
description: Gene Autry helps a gal clear her father's name who is accused of murdering a gambler. When the leader of the gamblers gets involved, it's up to Gene and his comic pal Pat Buttram to outwit the badmen.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: The water rights are controlled by Kincade and he charges outrageous rates. An agent for the government wants to make water more accessible and he makes a plan with the ranchers to make it happen.

title: Riders Of Justice
description: Recently deployed Markus returns home to care for his daughter after his wife is killed in an accident. But, Markus begins to suspect his wife was murdered and embarks on a mission of revenge.

title: Riders Of The Whistling Pines
description: Gene Autry believes he has accidentally shot a man, but learns that the guilt lies with men trying to stop a destructive moth infestation. Will modern chemicals be used to save the day, against Gene?

title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
description: Lumber men are cutting restricted timber. Since Gene is hired to deal with a moth infestation that threatens the trees, they accuse him of poisoning cattle to get him out of the way.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: A supernatural western! The Three Mesquiteers accompany an archeological expedition to a lost Indian city of gold called Lukachuke.

title: Ridiculousness
description: Rob Dyrdek hosts an internet video clip show with celebrity guests and co-hosts Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel West Coast (Fantasy Factory's rapping receptionist).

title: Riding the Bus With My Sister
description: A photographer and her developmentally challenged sister begin living together when their father dies. Stars Andie MacDowell and Rosie O'Donnell. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

title: Riding with a Spy
description: After being convicted of espionage, Israeli whistleblower Anat Kamm tries to rebuild her life in the United States. During her final months in the US, Kamm goes on a cross-country road trip to meet Daniel Ellsberg (whistleblower of The Pentagon Papers).

title: Ridley Road
description: Inspired by true events. In 1962 Vivien, a young Jewish hairdresser from Manchester, joins an underground movement trying to stop the rise of the far-right.

title: RiffTrax Presents: Sherlock Holmes and the Woman in Green
description: Originally in black and white, the woman The Woman in Green was difficult to identify — but because of the wonder of colorization, Bridget and Mary Jo figure out who's wearing green almost immediately! The rest of the mystery is elementary.

description: Come for the antics, tomfoolery, and mixups - and stay for a surprising change of heart. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax.

title: RiffTrax Short: A Case of Spring Fever
description: The stars of MST3K bring their comedic riffing treatment to this short about the importance of springs. Join Mike, Kevin, Bill, and Coily for A Case Of Spring Fever!

title: RiffTrax Short: A Visit to Santa
description: Just in time for the holidays, RiffTrax presents our take on A Visit to Santa, a Christmas short of unknown origin that most probably was the result of Santa's short-lived collaboration with the producing team of Screwtape and Wormwood.

title: RiffTrax Short: Act Your Age
description: Young Jim is caught in a shocking act of pencil-based vandalism, leading him to look deeply into the core of his soul and come to the inexorable conclusion that he is kind of a weenie.

title: RiffTrax Short: Aqua Frolics
description: If you were told you were about to see a film that contained turtles bigger than men, cliff-diving Mexicans and a family that eats Thanksgiving dinner underwater, you'd probably complain "But I don't like David Lynch!" Wrong you would be!

title: RiffTrax Short: Are You Popular
description: The short Are You Popular? will help you solve the question once and finally: the question, "Are you popular?" There are no easy answers, friends (that is, the answer is "no", of course, which is not always easy to hear) but Mike, Kevin, and Bill are…

title: RiffTrax Short: As We Like It
description: "Ah, beer. Balm of hurt minds, great nature's second course, chief nourisher in life's feast! (We think that's what the Swan of Avon was referring to...) Beer provides everything the human body needs.

title: RiffTrax Short: Buying Food
description: Buying food - how hard can it be? You go to a store pick out a few items, and start mashing them into the side of your head, right? WRONG!

title: RiffTrax Short: Carnivorous Plants
description: Carnivorous Plants!  Like Wii Boxing, they're one of those things that instantly becomes 1000X less cool the moment you bring it home and try it out.  Rather than quickly earning their keep and chomping down on your neighbor's annoying labradoodle.

title: RiffTrax Short: Christmas Toyshop
description: Can't anyone tell me what Christmas is all about!? an exasperated Charlie Brown once asked. Well, pace Linus van Pelt, the true meaning of Christmas—according to Christmas Toyshop—is a criminally incompetent father.

title: RiffTrax Short: Coffeehouse Rendezvous
description: The youth of today, no longer content to roll a hoop with a stick, play endless hours of mumbly peg, or work a lathe at a factory 14 hours a day for just pennies, need something to occupy them.

title: RiffTrax Short: Damaged Goods
description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this short that is a cautionary tale about a couple of young men who go on a harmless adventure in search of beer and girls and end up finding exactly that!

title: RiffTrax Short: Down and Out
description: If you like your safety shorts served with a heavy dose of groovy, then this is for you! Down and Out lays out a litany of dangers inherent in your every move from one location to the other.

title: RiffTrax Short: Drugs Are Like That
description: There are so many things to which drugs can be compared that to even attempt to catalog them would be an act of incomprehensible madness.

title: RiffTrax Short: Each Child is Different
description: “Each Child Is Different” goes the saying, and no truer words have ever been spoken. Take Miss Smith's fifth-grade class for instance.

title: RiffTrax Short: Going Steady
description: It's the most important decision you'll ever make: should I eat the rest of this BK Stacker, or just trust my vague feeling of nausea and quit while I'm ahead?

title: RiffTrax Short: Good Eating Habits
description: For many of us, Good Eating Habits boil down to a simple rule: avoid any food whose name ends in "-ator" or "-o-rama". But fifty years ago, in an era food historians refer to as "Pre GoGurt", what constituted a Good Eating Habit wasn't as widely known.

title: RiffTrax Short: Good Health Practices
description: Washing your hands after using the restroom - most of us only do so because a fellow co-worker is in the bathroom with us, and we wonder if he'll tell other people if we don't. But evidently, we should be doing this even when a co-worker isn't there.

title: RiffTrax Short: How Much Affection?
description: It's a question we ponder every time we tip the pizza guy: How much affection? Is it necessary to set the box down before embracing him?

title: RiffTrax Short: If Mirrors Could Speak
description: Cruel self-assessment is given a new twist as vulnerable grade-schoolers are forced to look into the deep blackness of their own souls.

title: RiffTrax Short: It Must Be The Neighbors
description: Bill Duncan had it all until the day when he discovered that his garbage cans had been deemed unfit for use by the city sanitation committee.

title: RiffTrax Short: Kitty Cleans Up
description: Years in the spotlight had left Kitty with fame, riches, and a drug habit to rival all but the Busey-ist of addicts.

title: RiffTrax Short: Know For Sure
description: You think you don't have syphilis, but how do really know? Has anyone you trust told you you don't have it? Have you been in contact with anyone from a big city in.

title: RiffTrax Short: Lunchroom Manners
description: Meet Phil. Like all children from the fifties, he enjoys playing ball, building soapbox racers, and taunting his non-blond-haired, blue-eyed classmates.

title: RiffTrax Short: One Got Fat
description: Do you find that you're sleeping a little too well as of late? That your dreams are of the innocuous stripe, i.e., old friends turning into llamas and eating your baseball hat, rather than full out.

title: RiffTrax Short: Overcoming Fear
description: Fear: Most of us rejected it in the mid-90s by wearing trendy t-shirts emblazoned with slogans such as "Second Place is the First Loser."

title: RiffTrax Short: Patriotism
description: When you hear the word "patriotism" what's the first name that pops into your head? Wrong! The answer is Bob Crane. And not "Hogan's Heroes" Bob Crane, but rather creepy, post-"Hogan's Heroes" Bob Crane, home video, um, "pioneer".

title: RiffTrax Short: Playing Together
description: "You would like to play with Donny and Duncan."So the narrator for Playing Together confidently tells us, and we have no reason to doubt him. But as the minutes pass it becomes clear that he may have been overselling Donny and Duncan just a bit.

title: RiffTrax Short: Primary Safety
description: The follow-up to the smash hit "Primary Safety: In the Three Mile Island Cooling Tower", Primary Safety: In The School Building starts with a catchy name and builds from there.

title: RiffTrax Short: Right or Wrong?
description: Right or Wrong tells the gritty story of Harry, a boy who doesn't vandalize a warehouse and suffers the consequences for it.

title: RiffTrax Short: Safety - Harm Hides at Home
description: Your home is crawling with hazards! You are not safe! EVERYTHING WILL KILL YOU! In fact, never mind, because you're already dead; killed by your stupid house.

title: RiffTrax Short: Self-Conscious Guy
description: Do you find yourself in a constant state of niggling self-criticism, e.g., "I bet everyone is laughing at me just because I have a waffle stuck to my back", or "I know it's the right thing to do, but will people look down on me because I jar.

title: RiffTrax Short: Shy Guy
description: Shyness—for years it has prevented boys from becoming men and girls from landing men.

title: RiffTrax Short: Skipper Learns a Lesson
description: Snoopy, Lassie, Cerberus, Rin-Tin-Tin: lovable canine companions are a dime a dozen.  Which makes Skipper: The Racist Dog such a breath of fresh air!

title: RiffTrax Short: The Terrible Truth
description: Heroin, it turns out, is bad. The Terrible Truth lays waste to the all-too-common myth that regular heroin use is a healthy part of a balanced diet.

title: RiffTrax Short: The Trouble With Women
description: Women - what the hell, man? I mean, what's your problem? Thankfully, for all of us non-women, some very smart people have put their best be-crew-cutted minds into coming up with a solution.

title: RiffTrax Short: Understanding Your
description: Pop quiz hotshot:  Your father tells you that your grandmother has fallen and badly hurt herself.

title: RiffTrax Short: Why Doesn't Cathy
description: At long last, the question of the ages is met head-on. No facet of the issue is left unexplored. The philosophical, eschatological, teleological, epistemological, and cosmological aspects are all given a thorough exegetical going over.

title: RiffTrax Short: Why Vandalism?
description: Why Vandalism?  It's the one question that kept parents in the fifties up at night.  Why would my boy turn to vandalism for thrills when they could be listening to Burl Ives 45s or campaigning for Adlai Stevenson?

title: RiffTrax Short: You and Your Family
description: You and Your Family. Much like gunpowder and an open flame, combining the two is not recommended (especially if mom's been drinking.)

title: RiffTrax Short: Your Chance To Live

title: RiffTrax Shorts: Ladybug, Ladybug, Winter is Coming

description: Sailing a Toy Boat and Making Sense with Sentences are two classic RiffTrax shorts. It combines the original movie with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax.

description: Setting Up a Room is a 27-minute parody about two women setting up a kindergarten classroom. It contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

title: Rifftrax Shorts: What Are Letters For? And What Makes Things Float?

description: Oblivion 2: Backlash! No, it's not just a compilation of all the backlash the first Oblivion received, it's the title of a direct-to-video sequel to Oblivion. What did we do to deserve this? No, seriously, what did we do to deserve this.

title: RiffTrax: Radical Jack

RIZE chronicles a dance movement that rises out of South Central Los Angeles with roots in clowning and street youth culture.

PG-13

description: At the Vytal Festival Tournament, it's Huntsmen against Huntresses and the new Remnant fighters.

title: RWBY: Volume 4
description: With the Fall of Beacon behind them each member of RWBY must now embark on their own unique journey.

title: RWBY: Volume 5
description: The members of RWBY each have their own journey, but they share a single destination: Haven Academy.

title: RWBY: Volume 6
description: RWBY is reunited and now they must begin the perilous job of escorting the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas.

title: RWBY: Volume 7
description: Team RWBY are brought the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas, but the futuristic city looks can be deceiving.

title: RWBY: Volume 8
description: Team RWBY's worst fears have materialized. Salem has arrived, and the timing couldn't be worse.

title: RWBY: Volume 9
description: RWBY have been thrust into an unknown world known as the Ever After! But appearances are deceptive.

title: Ryan Trahan
description: One thing about Ryan Trahan is that he ALWAYS full sends it. Catch Ryan as he attempts to pull off wild challenges no one asked him to take on!

title: Ryde
description: A new ride share app because a popular alternative to taking a taxi, but you never know who will be getting in a car with. Or if you'll ever get out.

title: S.F.W.
description: Cliff Spab is held hostage for a grueling 36 days with every move recorded on national TV. On release, he finds he has become a household name which provides imprisonment of a different sort.

title: Sabata
description: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

title: Sabotage
description: A Scotland Yard undercover detective is on the trail of a saboteur who is part of a plot to set off a bomb in London. But when the detective's cover is blown, the plot begins to unravel.

title: Sabotage
description: When a bodyguard fails to protect his client, he discovers ties between the assassins and a failed mission that ended a Navy career years earlier.  With the help of an FBI agent, he will try to bring the killers to justice and clear his name.

title: Sabrina
description: Bogie y Holden Larrabee son los hermanos megáricos de Long Island. Bogie trabaja y Holden es un casanova. Pero cuando Sabrina (Hepburn), la hija del chofer de la familia, regresa de París, se monta el escenario para las explosiones familiares.

title: Sabrina (1954)
description: Bogie and Holden are the mega-rich Larrabee brothers of Long Island. Bogie’s all work, Holden’s all playboy. But when Sabrina (Hepburn), daughter of the family’s chauffeur, returns from Paris, the stage is set for some family fireworks.

title: Sabrina The Animated
description: In the town of Greendale lives Sabrina Spellman: half-mortal and half witch! Despite many warnings never to use magic to solve problems, Sabrina often uses spells to wreak middle school havoc. Between her unpredictable relatives, her wealthy and conceited arch-nemesis, and her hilariously miscast spells, Sabrina's life is an adventure just waiting to happen!

title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
description: Melissa Joan Hart plays the not-so-normal new girl in town who discovers on her sixteenth birthday that she possesses magical powers. But Sabrina's biggest challenge isn't just fitting-in, it's surviving high school.

title: Sabrina's Secret Life
description: Sabrina enrolls in secret witchcraft training classes while attending her normal high school, but discovers she must share her clandestine instruction and her regular school with Portia, a snooty young witch from the “other side”.

title: Sabrina: Friends Forever
description: Sabrina turns 13 and goes off to Witch Academy. But Sabrina has a secret that makes her fear she’ll never be accepted at school or in life: she’s half-witch, half-mortal.

title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
description: Sabrina is a normal teenager, except for one thing -- she's a witch! Guided by her aunts, who come from a long line of witches, and Salem, a mischievous warlock doing penance as a black cat.

title: Sabuesos
description: Alberto es un hombre alocado cuyo mayor sueño es convertirse en detective. Para resolver los casos más difíciles, de los cuales es un apasionado, contará con ayuda de un perro parlanchín.

title: Sacred Blood
description: Infected by a vampire, a young circus performer flees her native country for San Francisco. There she finds others of her ilk but rejects affiliation with them and takes up instead with an infatuated young artist.

title: Sacrifice
description: Sacrifice.

title: Sacrifice
description: A tough undercover detective  delves into the dangerous underworld of human trafficking to save a young girl. His mission becomes personal, pushing him to the edge of morality in a gripping race against time.

title: Sacrifice
description: While visiting a remote Norwegian Island, a couple are drawn into a sinister cult that worships a sea-dwelling deity.

title: Sacrifice: The Liberation Of Paris
description: Sacrifice' is a gripping documentary series marking D-Day's 70th anniversary. Directed by renowned filmmakers, it features unseen archival footage, vividly colorized, and personal testimonies.

title: Sad People Factory
description: A worldwide investigation into the nature and epidemic scope of depression, shown from a societal view that challenges the individual notion of depression. Explore original points of view from: sociologists, philosophers, and neuropsychiatrists.

title: Saddle Club: Friends Forever
description: The arrival of beautiful, mysterious French Junior Champion DorothŽe Doutey, causes rumors and sparks to fly in this chapter of the classic series.

title: Saddle Club: Horse Crazy
description: Between school, riding, boys, and typical adolescent drama, the girls of the Pine Hollows ranch are never bored. They're in for even more excitement, however, when Skye Ransom, a young teenage heartthrob, comes to the farm to shoot a film.

title: Saddle Club: Horse of a Different Color
description: A valuable show horse transported from France arrives at Pine Hollow, with the horse's mysterious owner to arrive later. When the champion event horse (Hugo) escapes, Carol, Stevie, and Lisa take it upon themselves to help find him.

title: Saddle Club: Saving Pine Hollow
description: When financial issues at Pine Hollow have the Saddle Club scrambling to make money to help out, Veronica's father decides to help out by investing in the stables.

title: Saddle Club: Storm At Pine Hollow
description: Lisa takes a beautiful but violent foster horse named Storm to be rehabilitated at Pine Hollow.

title: Saddle Club: The First Adventure
description: Pine Hollow's new arrival, Lisa Atwood, gets a frosty reception from equestrians Stevie Lake and Carole Hanson after Lisa's mother nearly runs them down in this fun adventure based on the popular series of books by Bonnie Bryant.

title: Saddle Club: The Mane Event
description: In this chapter of the classic series, Carole, Stevie, and Lisa get involved in everything from a burning barn to an unexpected proposal.

title: Saddle Pals
description: Gene Autry goes to the home of hypochondriac landowner, who gets Gene to switch identities while he takes a vacation, giving Gene power-of-attorney. Gene has to raise $50,000 to save the properties.

title: Sadness of Sex
description: Comprised of 15 vignettes, this film is about love and the phases of courtship that lead to break-up.

title: Safaris épicos
description: Un recorrido por algunos de los destinos de safari más fascinantes de Zimbabue y el sur de África. En cada destino, se presentan algunos de los mejores guías de vida salvaje del planeta

title: Safe Harbor
description: Doug and Robbie are about to set sail on a long trip when they unexpectedly find themselves foster parenting a group of troubled boys. It changes their lives for the better, and they decide to stay in town and run the foster home for boys permanently.

title: Safe Haven
description: Danger and betrayal attend two sisters and their boyfriends on a remote Scottish island.

title: Saga of Death Valley
description: Roy comes back to Death Valley to take over the ranch some years after his father had been murdered by the local bigwig who is extorting the ranchers by threatening to cut off their water supply.

title: Saginaw Trail
description: Gene Autry is sent to investigate the murders of settlers with the help of Smiley Burnette and two young homesteaders. Gene soon discovers that rich fur trader is behind the staged Indian raids.

title: Sahara
description: Dos aventureros ávidos de emociones se cruzan con una hermosa doctora y van en busca del mayor tesoro, que se cobra las vidas de todos los que lo buscan.

title: Sahara
description: Two thrill-seeking adventurers cross paths with a beautiful doctor and they find themselves on the ultimate hunt for a treasure that claims all who seek it.

title: Sailing Around the World
description: Join The Wiggles on a Wiggly global adventure from London to Sicily to San Francisco! Climb aboard the S.S Feathersword for fifteen fun traveling tunes, and don't forget your passport — it's all hands on deck for fun!

title: Sailor Moon
description: Usagi Tsukino is a girl who transforms into the guardian, Sailor Moon. Usagi and her team of Sailor Guardians fight to protect the universe from evil.

title: Sailor Moon Crystal
description: Based on Naoko Takeuchi’s epic manga series, Sailor Moon Crystal retells the story of Sailor Moon as she searches for the Legendary Silver Crystal.

title: Sailor Moon R: The Movie
description: Sailor Moon and the Sailor Guardians unite to save Earth from an alien force!

title: Sailor Moon S: The Movie
description: Princess Snow Kaguya has a chilling plan to freeze Earth. Sailor Moon and her team are now the only hope!

title: Sailor Moon Super S: The Movie
description: The evil Queen plots to trap Earth in a energy field, powered by the dreams of children. Sailor Moon and the Sailor Guardians must now save the world!

title: Saint Jack
description: Jack Flowers, an American hustler in early 1970s Singapore, dreams of building a fortune by running a brothel and returning to the States to lead a life of luxury.

title: Saint Judy
description: The true story of immigration attorney Judy Wood as she represents an Afghan woman fleeing her home after Taliban persecution. Despite setbacks and losses, Judy single-handedly seeks to change the U.S. law of asylum to save women's lives.

title: Saint Patrick's Big Dance
description: It’s St. Patrick’s Day and all the inhabitants of Sunnyville are celebrating! Besties Beezbee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn the lion are looking for the best St. Patrick’s Day party in town!

title: Saint Ralph
description: The year 1954 finds teen outcast Ralph Walker getting in trouble at the Catholic school he attends in Ontario, Canada. When the headmaster catches Ralph smoking, he puts the boy on the school's cross-country team to force him to put his time.

title: Saint Seiya Soul of Gold
description: Transcending eternity, the 12 Gold Saints return to protect love and peace on Earth! They gave their lives to destroy the Wailing Wall to break the way for Seiya and the Saints in their battle against Hades in the Underworld!

title: Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas
description: When Hades finishes his painting that covers the sky, "The Lost Canvas," it is said that all lives on Earth will be lost. Tenma, hopes to stop his best friend Alone, who was chosen to become a vessel for Hades.

title: Sakra
description: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

title: Sala de emergencias: Historias inéditas
description: Estas intensas historias reales demuestran la verdadera naturaleza dramática de la medicina practicada bajo presión, donde cada momento puede ser un punto de inflexión.

title: Sala de parejas
description: El primer show de corte que sirvió de inspiración para Caso Cerrado y convirtió a la doctora Ana María Polo en una de las figuras más prestigiosas de la televisión en español.

title: Salamander (Dubbed)
description: A private bank in Brussels is robbed and 66 safe deposit boxes are cleaned out. Why these 66? The connection leads to a secret organization called Salamander that could bring down all of Belgium.

title: Salem Witch Trials
description: A masterful work accurately detailing the current consensus as to what exactly occurred to prompt the colonial witch trials. Starring Rebecca De Mornay, Shirley MacLaine and more.

title: Sally
description: Sally is a long-running American syndicated tabloid talk show that was hosted by radio talk show host Sally Jessy Raphael.

title: Sally Hemings: An American Scandal
description: This epic miniseries explores the complex relationship of Thomas Jefferson (Sam Neill) and the enslaved Sally Hemings (Carmen Ejogo), who shared a controversial 38-year love affair.

title: Salme:  Ancient Viking Burial Ships
description: In 2008, workers in Saaremaa uncovered two Viking-era ships with bones and grave goods. Salme: Ancient Viking Burial Ships explores who these people were and what happened 1,300 years ago.

title: Salt and Fire
description: A scientist blames the head of a large company for an ecological disaster in South America. But when a volcano begins to show signs of erupting, they must unite to avoid a disaster.

title: Salt in My Soul
description: Salt In My Soul is a documentary and a classic coming of age story about Mallory Smith, a young woman figuring out how to live while dying. Mallory's determination to fill her shortened life with hope and love will leave you breathless.

title: Salt of the Earth (1954)
description: Salt of the Earth centers on a long, difficult workers’ strike against a mining company in New Mexico. Ramon Quintero (Juan Chacon) fights for equity of wages as well as health and safety issues, but at home he mistreats his wife, Esperanza. When the men are forced to end their picketing, Esperanza joins the other women who demand to play a role in the strike, against their husband’s wishes. Written, directed, and produced by members of the original blacklisted “Hollywood Ten,” Salt of the Earth is a powerful, persuasive drama that educates and inspires.

title: Salud al natural
description: Existe una alternativa a la medicina moderna que puede prevenir enfermedades y otras afecciones corporales. En este espectáculo, descubra varias técnicas y medios disponibles para lograr una perfecta salud usándolos.

title: Salvador
description: A compelling drama based on the real experiences of journalist Richard Boyle in strife-ridden El Salvador in 1980-81.

title: Salvador
description: Es 1980. Los jóvenes, las mujeres y los niños están siendo brutalmente asesinados en una sangrienta guerra civil en El Salvador. Es un escenario horrible, pero perfecto para Richard Boyle, reportero gráfico de guerra cuya carrera necesita un impulso.

title: Salvage Hunters
description: Join modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard as he crisscrosses the UK in search of derelict gems and rusty gold.

title: Salvage Mice
description: Betrayed by her friend and partner after stealing a valuable item and giving it back to its rightful owner, Maisu is wanted for being a thief. For help, Maisu reaches out to the mighty fighter Mio, and soon they form a powerful team.

title: Salvajes del mar azul
description: El lanzamiento de la película, Tiburones, en 1975 inculcó un miedo irracional, casi maníaco de los tiburones en el público en general. No son máquinas asesinas sin sentido, sino depredadores mucho más complejos de lo que imaginamos.

title: Salvation, The
description: The mighty Mads Mikkelsen unleashes a maelstrom of bloodshed in the Wild West in this white-knuckle tale of revenge, co-starring Eva Green.

title: Sam & Cat
description: In the crossover comedic spin-off of both iCarly and Victorious created by Dan Schneider, feisty Sam Puckett (Jennette McCurdy) and flighty Cat Valentine (Ariana Grande) become best buddies and unlikely roommates.

title: Sam & Mattie Make a Zombie Film
description: Sam and Mattie, two badass best friends with Down syndrome, rally the entire town of Providence RI to help them storyboard, script, produce, cast, and star in their own dream movie: 'Spring Break Zombie Massacre.'

title: Sam and Colby
description: Join Sam and Colby as they explore and document the creepiest haunted sites. Maintaining their infectious humor in even the darkest of situations, paranormal investigation has never been more fun.

title: Sam and Max
description: THE ADVENTURES OF SAM AND MAX: FREELANCE POLICE is an edgy and often irreverent, impudent, insolent, impious, and silly series about a pair of likable law enforcement types who don't let anyone bother them, including the Network.  It's about the timeless struggle between good, evil, and snacktime. The weekly stories chronicle the tales of a six-foot dog and a three-foot hyperactive rabbity thing who have a great time trying to solve only the weirdest criminal cases of the day. It's a sort of Saturday morning version of the X-Files - only funny.

title: Sam Whiskey
description: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

title: Samba
description: Senegalese Samba has worked 10 years in France. He's arrested and befriends the woman helping him with legal matters as volunteer after a burnout at work. He's released after being told to leave France. Chemistry?

title: Same Difference
description: Freeride, Freestyle and Alpine racing united! Legs of Steel presents the multi-discipline ski film 'Same Difference’. True to the credo –‘a film about skiers’, this documentary will provide a one-of-a-kind view into skiing’s diversity.

title: Same Kind Of Different As Me
description: From The NY Times bestseller comes an inspirational true story about two men from drastically different backgrounds, who develop a surprising bond that will lead them on the most remarkable journey of their lives and forge an everlasting friendship.

title: Samsara
description: Prepare yourself for an unparalleled sensory experience. SAMSARA reunites director Ron Fricke and producer Mark Magidson, whose award-winning films BARAKA and CHRONOS were acclaimed for their combining visual and musical artistry.

title: Samson & Delilah
description: A glue-sniffing boy and his girlfriend escape the government-controlled no-hope Aboriginal community they live in and go to the city, Alice Springs, looking for a better life.

title: SAMURAI COP
description: A bitter samurai cop and his sidekick intend to get their revenge and bravely try to go after the Yakuza.

title: Samurai Cop 2: Deadly Vengeance
description: After finding a recluse Joe Marshall, detective Frank Washington teams up with him to solve a case involving a turf war between three rival clans, the Katanas, the Shinjukus, and the Ginzas.

title: Samurai Marathon
description: A young ninja goes undercover in the court of an ageing Lord to win a race to prevent a shogunate from wrecking an alliance.

title: Samurai Of Fukushima
description: This documentary will follow five modern-day samurais who had suffered by the disaster and radiation since March 11, 2011. Now samurais are fighting against radiation which is the latest technology we human invented and risking their lives to maintain.

title: Samurai Reincarnation
description: The villain is called Amakusa Shiro Tokaisada. He is actually based on a real christian samurai. The movie was one of the inspirations for the game called 'Samurai Shodown' (actual spelling)

title: Samurai Troopers (Ronin Warriors)
description: The Ronin Warriors, each armed with mystical powers, defend the world from the evil lord Talpa. Guided by their trusted friend Mia, and the powerful monk The Ancient, the Warriors head on a death-defying adventure to bring an end to Talpa.

title: Samurai Troopers (Ronin Warriors): Gaiden
description: In this anime classic, a gang of troopers investigate an New York serial killer when one of their own goes missing.

title: Samurai Troopers (Ronin Warriors): Legend of the Inferno Armor
description: In this anime classic, the Samurai Troopers must head back into battle when a mysterious warrior begins a deadly attack.

title: Samurai Troopers (Ronin Warriors): Message
description: In this anime classic, the Samurai Troopers find their deadliest enemy yet when a centuries-old book foretells their fates. Can they overcome the sinister powers foreseeing their futures?

title: Samurai, detrás del sable
description: Un documental especial que revela cómo los Samuráis del pasado se han enfrentado a la sociedad moderna, al tiempo que un resurgimiento popular de la cultura Samurái arrasa Japón.

title: San Andreas Quake (2015)
description: When a discredited L.A. Seismologist warns of an impending 12.7 earthquake, no one takes her seriously. Now on her own, she races desperately to get her family to safety before the earthquake breaks Los Angeles apart from the mainland.

title: San Fernando Valley
description: A ranch owner fires his ranch hands and brings in women to replace them. The owner's daughter wants the male hands back and comes up with a plan to do it. They will rustle the horses and bring the men in to get their old jobs back.

title: San Francisco Story
description: In the 1850s San Francisco newspaper editor Jim Martin seeks the help of wealthy miner Rick Nelson in ousting crooked politician Andrew Cain.

title: Sanctified
description: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, 'Sanctified' is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance at a local church.

title: Sand, Sun & Holiday Fun: A Florida Getaway
description: Celebrating the holidays in Florida, with a 100-boat light parade, sunset yoga on the beach, and holiday catch-and-cook meals.

title: Sands of Iwo Jima
description: Tough-as-nails career Marine Sergeant John Stryker is greatly disliked by the men of his squad, particularly the combat replacements, for the rigorous training he puts them through.

title: Sands Of Oblivion
description: A replica of ancient Egypt was rebuilt in 1923 for a movie and then mysteriously burried when the filming stopped. Now a soon-to-be-divorced archaeologist couple and an Iraq War combat veteran have uncovered the secret DeMille could not keep hidden...

title: Sangre, sudor y gloria
description: Un equipo de fisicoculturistas de Miami llevan una vida de lujo a través del secuestro y de la extorsión en esta comedia policial basada en una historia real.

title: Santa and Pete
description: It's the first Christmas without Grandma and a difficult time for the family until Grandpa decides to share a story with his ten-year-old grandson Terence.

title: Santa Baby
description: An ambitious businesswoman (Jenny McCarthy) sees an opportunity when her father — who just happens to be Santa (George Wendt) — falls ill.

title: Santa Claus Presents A Children's Christmas
description: A Christmas collection designed especially with children in mind. Stories like Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, The Night Before Chirstmas and more!

title: Santa Claus visit
description: Warm up to the comforting glow of a wood-burning fireplace with a surprise visitor.

title: Santa Claws
description: Tommy leaves his kittens out for Santa to take back to the North Pole, but after a major allergic reaction Santa can't deliver presents anymore, so the kittens have to deliver the rest of the presents to all the boys and girls.

title: Santa Fake
description: Santa Fake is a musical comedy filled with Christmas spirit and holiday hijinks as an orphan gets a job as a shopping mall Santa Claus to hide from a gang of hooligans, only to find out his role as Santa is more than just a disguise.

title: Santa Girl
description: Santa Claus’ only daughter wants to experience the “real world” before she must marry the son of Jack Frost and take over the family business. Cassie Claus sets off to college while trying to keep her famous father a secret.

title: Santa Jaws
description: A young aspiring comic book artist is gifted a mysterious pen that brings his drawing to life. Now his creation, Santa Jaws, begins to devour his family and the remaining must battle for survival against this creature.

title: Santa Saves the Universe
description: During Christmas time, Santa has just finished his worldwide deliveries, but an unthinkable tragedy occurs! Marshmallow, his most trusted reindeer, has forgotten an entire planet. Now, Santa must travel through space to bring presents to distant aliens while steering clear of his evil brother, who intends to stop him from succeeding!

title: Santa's Christmas Circus
description: Whizzo the clown takes a bunch of kids on a magic carpet ride to North Pole to see Santa Claus, but not before the kids perform as circus animals in "Whizzoland."

title: Santa's Got Style
description: When department store exec Madison is charged with coming up with a new idea for the holiday season, she decides to hire her long-time best friend, Ethan, to be the young Santa.

title: Santa's Magic Toy Bag
description: Sherman, an apprentice Elf, tries his best to fit in but can't seem to do anything right! Santa tries to bolster his self-esteem by entrusting him with a special task. From the creator of the character Alf!

title: Santa's Squad
description: Unemployed art teacher Allie (Rebecca Dalton) accepts a job with the Santa Squad to help lift the spirits of a wealthy widower (Aaron Ashmore) and his two adorable daughters.

title: Santana: Live At US Festival
description: From award-winning filmmaker and rockumentarian Glenn Aveni, Santana: Live At US Festival offers a tremendous performance from the legendary Carlos Santana, rivaling his set at Woodstock for its energy, excitement, and inspiring musicianship

title: Santo contra Capulina
description: Capulina es un gran admirador del campeón El Santo, quien ayuda a la policía en su tiempo libre. Un científico crea un robot idéntico a Capulina para matar a El Santo, y pronto se enfrentan en la arena.

title: Santo contra los cazadores de cabezas (LAS)
description: El valiente e infatigable luchador se encuentra en el Amazonas, enfrentado a los Jíbaros para salvar a una heroína.

title: Santuario: población uno
description: Un joven idealista, Ethan, se queda buscando a su familia mientras lucha contra los infectados, la milicia Med-Ex y los merodeadores sedientos de sangre, así como contra los fantasmas de su pasado.

title: Sanya’s Glam & Gold
description: Sanya's Glam & Gold, a new series chronicling the fast-paced life of Olympic Gold Medalist Sanya Richards-Ross and her husband, NFL star and two-time Super Bowl champion, Aaron Ross.

title: Sapphire And Steel
description: When time itself is threatened by the forces of evil, it's time to call on Sapphire and Steel.

title: Sappy Holiday
description: A sous chef begins doubting her future with her boyfriend after a handsome maple farmer comes to her rescue.

title: Sarah
description: Sarah loves school, but traditional Maasai culture and a long drought cause disruption. A generous dowry offer means her family must decide whether to conduct traditional circumcision and accept, or miss a rare chance to rebuild their wealth.

title: Sasquatch Gang
description: When fantasy/sci-fi aficionado Gavin (Jeremy Sumpter) ventures into the woods, he stumbles onto some mammoth footprints and a large turd. Could this be the infamous Sasquatch or just another one of Zerk's (Justin Long) ludicrous pranks?

title: Sasquatch Mountain Man
description: Laramy "Sasquatch" Miller, trained by true Mountain Men, does it all the hard way. In a world of high-tech hunters, weapons, and technology, he shows us what real hunting and living in the great wilderness truly is.

title: Sasquatch Sunset
description: Acclaimed directors David and Nathan Zellner take you on absurdist, strange, hilarious, and ultimately poignant journey through four seasons with family of Sasquatches.

title: Satanic Hispanics
description: Police find a house full of dead Latinos and only one survivor, "The Traveler." He recounts tales of horrors and mythical beings from Latino folklore.

title: Satellite Girl And Milk Cow
description: Il-ho, a satellite girl, wants to learn about human emotions, and crash lands on Earth. She transforms into a human girl and tries to help Kyung-chun after he is transformed into a milk cow.

title: Satellite Girl And Milk Cow [English-Language Version]
description: Il-ho, a satellite girl, wants to learn about human emotions, and crash lands on Earth. She transforms into a human girl and tries to help Kyung-chun after he is transformed into a milk cow.

title: Saturday Church
description: A 14 year-old-boy, struggling with gender identity and religion, begins to use fantasy to escape his life in the inner city and find his passion in the process.

title: Saturday Morning Massacre
description: A dark and bloody parody about a Scooby-Doo-like team of paranormal investigators and their devoted dog. With the crew nearing bankruptcy, they're hired to get to the bottom of a series of spooky events at the remote Kyser mansion.

title: Saturday Night at the Baths
description: A pianist at a legendary gay bathhouse struggles with his own homophobia while developing feelings for a man.

title: Saturday The 14th
description: A family moves into a house inhabited by scary creatures and a number of close calls ensue.

title: Saul And Ruby's Holocaust Survivor Band
description: Like many survivors of the Holocaust, after World War II, Saul and Ruby moved to America, started families and careers, grew old, and retired to South Florida.

title: Saul: The Journey to Damascus
description: As a dedicated leader, Saul fights to defend his faith and traditions - his fanatical behaviour reaching its climax when he organizes a brutal scheme to rid Judea of anyone who follows Christ, earning him the title Butcher of Tarsus.

title: Savage
description: Buried by treacherous conditions at the top of Mt. Baekdu, a policeman must brave the extreme weather until his transfer comes through. When a group of thieves stumbles into the station, both sides must fight for survival.

title: Savage Dog
description: A story set in Indochina in 1959, a land beyond rule and a time without mercy, and the birth of a legend.

title: Savage River
description: Miki Anderson (Katherine Langford) returns home after eight years in prison, determined to move on with her life.

title: Savage State
description: When the American Civil War breaks out, a family of french settlers must abandon their Missouri home.

title: Savage Wild
description: Predatory expert Manny Puig navigates treacherous waters and hazardous terrain, offering an eye-opening and thrilling half-hour experience.

title: Savage!
description: A young black man becomes the legendary leader of a rebel army, as the daring ambush on the beach takes place the leader of the rebel army is captured.

title: Savannah Sunrise
description: A high-strung woman and her free-spirited mother-in-law take a road trip and discover that they need each other more than they know.

title: Save Me
description: An honest stock-trader is seduced by a mysterious young woman into an erotic adventure beyond his wildest fantasies, until someone tries to kill him.

title: Save The Wedding
description: Meg and Tyler have never gotten along with each other but when they work together to save the best friends' wedding, they discover they actually make a good team and begin a little romance of their own.

title: Saved From Extinction
description: Over forty endangered species currently inhabit the Earth. Humans have put many in conservation programs, and some species have even seen rehabilitation. Yet others, even after being rescued, have come up against unseen obstacles to their return.

title: Saved!

description: Based on a true story of a renowned doctor who used his own sperm to impregnate patients, without informing them.

title: Seeing Other People
description: Engaged couple Ed and Alice think a premarital sexual free-for-all will help ease their tension. As it turns out fooling around with multiple partners as a method of strengthening the sanctity of marriage isn't as easy as it appeared.

title: Seeking Justice
description: Nicolas Cage (CON AIR) is Will Gerard, a family man whose wife, Laura (January Jones of MAD MEN), is attacked. A stranger, Simon (Guy Pearce of THE KING'S SPEECH) offers revenge on the attacker in exchange for a favor from Will.

title: Seijuu Sentai Gingaman
description: Three millennia after the first invasion of the Space Pirates Barban, a new set of Gingamen - Hyuuga, Gouki, Hayate, Hikaru, Saya - have been selected to protect the Earth. That is, unless the Barban are able to disrupt the ceremony!

title: Seleccion Natural
description: Como el chico nuevo, un tímido estudiante de último año de secundaria se ve atormentado por todos sus compañeros excepto uno, pero su nuevo amigo tiene una perspectiva oscura y contagiosa.

title: Selena Gomez: Devotion
description: After returning from her 5 year break from music, Selena Gomez has blown the world away with her 3rd studio album Rare. She has transformed over the years, from Disney pop star to award winning film and tv producer.

title: Selena Gomez: Dreaming
description: Selena is one of the worlds rising stars. A former Disney superstar who has gone on to become one of Hollywood’s most recognizable talents.

title: Selena Gomez: On Cloud 9
description: Selena Gomez landed a role in the classic children's TV show Barney & Friends in 2002, and since then she's gone to achieve fame and fortune beyond her wildest dreams.

title: Sell This House!
description: On "Sell This House," host Tanya Memme and designer Roger Hazard travel the country helping homeowners reinvent homes that have been on the market too long.

title: Sellado con un beso. Boda: 6 de marzo
description: Los planes de boda de un Mick y Olivia se salen de control. Él, siendo una celebridad, tiene una oportunidad inesperada y tentadora que puede poner en peligro su gran día. Protagonizada por Jack Wagner y Josie Bissett

title: Selling it in the ATL
description: Tensions rise as seven realtors compete in the booming ATL market. Their business practices are as diverse as their clients--can these boss women let profits prevail over personal drama?

title: Semana del tiburón
description: Un millonario chiflado secuestra a un grupo de completos extraños, y los aísla en un complejo en su isla. Se ven obligados a atravesar un tormento espantoso donde deberán sobrevivir a un aluvión de especies de tiburones cada vez más letales.

title: Semi-Tough
description: Barbara Jane (Jill Clayburgh), Billy Clyde (Burt Reynolds) and Shake (Kris Kristofferson) have been best friends for years. But when Barbara Jane's new interest in Shake turns into love, Billy Clyde realizes she's the woman he’s wanted all along!

title: Semper Fi
description: When his reckless younger brother is given an unfair prison sentence, a Marine Corps reservist is torn between his by-the-book code and loyalty to family.

title: Senior Moment
description: Starring Emmy Award winners William Shatner, Jean Smart and Christopher Lloyd, this romantic comedy follows a retired NASA test pilot as he learns to navigate love and life again.

title: Seniors: A Dogumentary
description: An old dog can teach you new tricks!

title: Sensatez y sentimientos
description: Del aclamado escritor Andrew Davies, llega esta encantadora nueva adaptación de la clásica novela de Jane Austen sobre el amor y el matrimonio.

title: Sense and Sensibility (1981)
description: This is Jane Austen's tale of two devoted sisters with totally different attitudes towards life and love. Filmed on location in the stately homes of picturesque Dorset and Somerset.

title: Sentencia de muerte
description: La superestrella de acción Jean-Claude van Damme (Contacto sangriento, Cyborg) es un veterano agente secreto que se hace pasar por un recluso en una peligrosa prisión estatal.

title: Sentidos de los animales
description: Desde delfines y murciélagos utilizando ecolocación, hasta la increíble habilidad de un pequeño insecto para no perderse,  y un cazador eléctrico de apariencia extraña, siempre hay preguntas interesantes que Sentidos animales responde.

title: Seobok: Project Clone
description: Ex intelligence agent Ki Heon is tasked with safely transporting Seo Bok, the first ever human clone, who holds the secret of eternal life. Several forces try to take control of Seo Bok to serve their own agendas.

title: Separation
description: A young girl finds solace in her artist father and the ghost of her dead mother.

title: Serangoon Road en español
description: Ambientada en la tumultuosa década de 1960, esta serie de misterio sigue al detective Sam Callaghan mientras investiga crímenes en el peligroso mundo de los expatriados internacionales en Singapur.

title: Serena Williams: The Power and The Glory
description: Serena Williams – champion, inspiration, icon. A once-in-a-generation talent, The Power and The Glory traces Serena's remarkable journey, from a Compton prodigy to the greatest female tennis player of all time.

title: Serendipity
description: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

title: Serenity
description: A fishing boat captain juggles facing his mysterious past and finding himself ensnared in a reality where nothing is what it seems.

title: Sergio Mendes In the Key of Joy
description: A joyful cinematic celebration of this singular musical artist who remains as vital and relevant today as when he exploded on the scene with his group, Brasil '66.

title: Serial Killers
description: Murderers as you've never seen them before, with exclusive one-on-one interviews. Witness infamous killers such as Ted Bundy and Henry Lee Lucas chillingly describe how they stalked and killed their victims in cold blood.

title: Serious Moonlight
description: A high-powered attorney duct tapes her adulterous husband to the toilet ... right before their home is invaded by burglars.

title: Serpico
description: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

title: Serpico
description: Serpico presenta una ciudad en descenso literal como moralmente, ya que policías y criminales son casi intercambiables.

title: Serpientes en el tren
description: Una joven mujer es víctima de una maldición maya que hace que incube serpientes que la devoran lentamente desde adentro. Su única posibilidad de sobrevivir es un poderoso chamán que vive al otro lado de la frontera.

title: Served Like A Girl
description: Director Lysa Heslov's documentary, "Served Like a Girl, provides a candid look at several American women as they transition from active duty to civilian life after serving tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan.

title: Serving Sara
description: Joe Tyler is a process server who will do anything to deliver legal documents to victims. But nothing in Joe's bag of tricks prepares him for Sara, the stunning, soon-to-be ex-wife of a playboy cattle baron named Gordon Moore.

title: Seven Psychopaths
description: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

title: Seven Samurai
description: Farmers from a village exploited by bandits hire a veteran samurai for protection, and he gathers six other samurai to join him.

title: Seven Swords: Bone of the Godmaker (2019)
description: In this action fantasy saga, a group of four swordsmen teams up to battle a powerful demonic force.

title: Seven Swords: Eye of Shura (2019)
description: In this fantasy saga, a man battles against an ages-old evil demon that has long haunted his family.

title: Seventeen Again
description: When 17-year-old Sydney's divorced grandparents visit simultaneously, it seems there will be no end to the bickering. Then little brother's science experiment goes awry and instead of preserving roses, he sends both grandparents back to their youth.

title: Severe Off-Road 1
description: Severe Off-Road 1 is a gritty thrill ride into the sport of off-road racing and features some of the best racing and personalities in off-road. The film features killer action from trick trucks, bikes, buggies, ATVs, trophy karts, rhinos and more.

title: Severe Off-Road 2
description: Severe Racing Films is back at it with Severe Off-Road 2. The new film is an intense thrill ride into the sport of off-road racing, filmed at spectacular races all over the western U.S. and Mexico.

title: Severe Off-Road 3
description: Severe Racing gets Down and Dirty with their 3rd film in the Red Hot sport of Off-Road Racing. Trophy Trucks, Buggies, MX Motorcycles, ATV's and UTV’s battle it out across Americas toughest terrains.

title: Severe Offroad 4
description: Severe Racing presents their 4th Off Road Racing film. Featuring Trophy Trucks, Buggies, Bikes, ATV's and UTV’s, all tearing it up through the deserts of America and Baja Mexico.

title: Sex Drive
description: When an online hottie offers to help him become a man, Ian embarks on a wild road trip to a sure thing.

title: Sex Pot
description: A pair of losers discover a legendary weed with aphrodisiac powers.  "American Pie" meets "Half-Baked" in this screw ball comedy!

title: Sex Revolutions

title: Sex(ed): The Movie
description: The awkward and often hilarious ways Americans have learned about sex, from the early 1900s to the present.

title: Sex, Lies & Murder
description: When lies collapse and hidden love triangles are revealed, crimes of passion turn what should have been simple breakups into headline-grabbing, real-life stories with severe consequences.

title: Sex-Positive

title: Sexual Outlaws

title: Señorita Navidad

description: Una ama de casa suburbana felizmente casada publica un mensaje falso en las redes sociales diciendo que se está divorciando, solo para ver cuál de sus amigas intentará robarle el marido.

title: Shackled
description: Chained to a pickup truck in the Californian desert, a young woman must unravel her captor's twisted scheme, before she is undone herself.

title: Shade

title: Shadow Fighter
description: Reggie, an inner-city teen struggling with the murder of his brother and the drug dealers who pulled the trigger, forms an unexpected bond with a homeless ex-boxer, "Lightning" Rhodes.

title: Shadow Fighter
description: Reggie, an inner-city teen struggling with the murder of his brother and the drug dealers who pulled the trigger, forms an unexpected bond with a homeless ex-boxer, 'Lightning' Rhodes.

title: Shadow Government

title: Shadow Master
description: After being slain by a group of criminals, a man is reborn with animal-like superpowers and makes it his mission to right the wrongs of his city.

title: Shake, Rattle & Rock!

description: Follow the rise of one of the most successful Latin-American pop artists of all time.  Known for her catchy lyrics and hip shaking dance moves, Shakira has swept up millions of fans around the globe.

description: Catchy lyrics and hip-shaking dance moves; Shakira is one of the greatest artists of our time. Her songs have been played all over the globe and have influenced audiences everywhere.

title: Shaman King en español
description: Cada 500 años hay una competencia para determinar quién se convertirá en el Rey Chamán, quién será el que obtendrá el máximo poder para gobernar el mundo humano y espiritual. Es la historia de la búsqueda de un chamán para convertirse en el Rey Chamán.

title: Shameless
description: Meet the Gallagher family, as they experience life on the edge in a blur of sexual adventures, triumphs, love, scams and petty crime in Manchester. Just be thankful they’re not your neighbors.

title: Shane the Chef
description: Animated preschool series about healthy eating.

description: A Shanghai doctor named Tangsan, is trying to help the town's poor people. Meanwhile, he has the murderous Axe Gang to deal with as well as his feelings for the gang leader's sister.

description: In Shanghai Six, Level 1 charges full speed ahead with nothing short of the most progressive freeskiing/jib film ever produced.

title: Shanghai Surprise
description: In this romantic adventure-comedy set in the turbulent 1930s, a sharp-witted, very honorable American fortune hunter (Sean Penn) and a beautiful, fairly honorable missionary (Madonna) join forces to seek out a legendary cache of stolen opium!

description: Two young, damaged lovers head to Los Angeles to kill the King of Rock n Roll in the summer of 1974.

description: Shannen Says follows icon Shannen Doherty as she prepares for her wedding to international photographer Kurt Iswarienko. With only seven weeks to plan, Shannen enlists My Fair Wedding host David Tutera to bring her vision to life.

description: Two friends from rival schools are turned against one another by a jealous chief who wants to eliminate those whose fighting styles may rival his own.

title: Shaolin Deadly Hands
description: The girlfriend of a con-man and Wing Chun fighter is being held in a brothel.

description: Romance blossoms between two rival families practicing Shaolin and Wudang kungfu respectively. despite familial opposition - until they overcome a gang of scheming bandits together.

description: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

title: Shaq's Garage
description: Shaq's Garage is a modern-day adventure series where Shaq brings his “family” of cars, the Shaq Paq, to life. Each episode features O'Neil and his Shaq Paq on adventures about helping and doing good in the neighborhood.

title: Shark Divers Part 1
description: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums.

title: Shark Divers Part 2
description: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums.

title: Shark Killer
description: The services of shark killer Chase Walker have been requested by his brother Jake, the head of a South African crime ring. His job? Kill the black-finned shark that swallowed a valuable diamond.

title: Shark Lake
description: Fiercely protective single-mom Meredith Hendricks happens to also be the best cop in her quiet town on Lake Tahoe. When a black-market exotic species dealer named Clint, is paroled from prison, something he let loose begins to make its presence known.

title: Shark School: Whale World
description: Swim with Milo and Bella to Shark School and learn all about the wonderful world of whales!

title: Shark Squad
description: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks and fight for the protection of these supreme predators - before it’s too late.

title: Shark Week
description: A group of complete strangers find themselves isolated by a wealthy madman on his island compound. They are forced into a horrifying gauntlet where they must survive a barrage of ever deadlier species of shark.

title: Sharknado: Feeding Frenzy
description: What began as another Syfy creature feature has now become an important piece of pop culture, poised to take over the entire world.

title: Sharknado: Heart of Sharkness
description: Discover the untold story of David Moore, the filmmaker who first dreamed of sharks in a tornado and brought on disaster by using real sharks. The first SHARKNADO was to be a movie never seen, a crime never reported, a tale never told. Until now.

title: Sharks

description: Examine sharks in their natural environments, study their behaviors and dispel common misconceptions about one of the world's most savage and intricate creatures.

description: Before being an earthly paradise with enchanting colours, the lagoon of New Caledonia is above all a paradise for sharks.  But not just any sharks: they are used to being considered as fearsome predators, they are essentially opportunistic scavengers.

description: Dive into the world of sharks. Coined as monsters by the media, experience these behemoth majestic creatures in their natural habitat and learn about the threat of extinction to nearly one in four shark species and why they need our help.

title: Sharks: The Big Five
description: Delve deep into the African waters and discover a new side of these prehistoric predators of the sea, while reconsidering the Hollywood portrayal which has done much to damage the reputation of these gentle creatures.

title: Sharpshooter
description: A mercenary sniper is assigned a secret mission to assassinate a dangerous drug czar, but after completing the job he finds that he has an assassin assigned to kill him as well.

title: Shattered
description: In this thriller starring Academy Award® nominee John Malkovich (RED) and Frank Grillo (AVENGERS: ENDGAME), a millionaire (Cameron Monaghan) falls for a woman (Lilly Krug) he meets by chance—but soon suspects her of dangerous motives.

title: Shattered
description: When your memory has been taken, whom do you trust? Tom Berenger, Bob Hoskins, Greta Scacchi and Joanne Whalley breathe life into this gripping neo-noir about the survivor of a car accident who begins to suspect his near-death was no accident.

title: Shattered
description: When his daughter is kidnapped, Neil (Gerard Butler) must take matters into his own hands to get her back. Also starring Pierce Brosnan and Maria Bello.

title: Shattered Glass
description: Hayden Christensen stars in this critically acclaimed true story of a disgraced journalist, directed and co-written by Billy Ray, Oscar®-nominated writer of CAPTAIN PHILLIPS.

title: Shattered Memories
description: With no memory of events, a woman wakes up next to the dead body of her ex-lover and must find the killer to exonerate herself.

title: Shattering the Silence
description: When postpartum depression reawakens long-dormant memories of childhood rape by her father, Veronica takes her tormentor to court.  She and her siblings must confront their father in order to stop the cycle of abuse and save the next generation.

title: She
description: A group of explorers search for the legendary "flame of life," a mysterious force that bestows immortality. In Vibrant Color designed by Ray Harryhausen!

title: She Belongs To Me
description: As Pete's machinations unfold, the lives of Lorraine and Jelly are irrevocably altered, forcing them to confront uncomfortable truths about their relationship and the secrets that lurk beneath the surface.

description: On the way to her father's wedding, Charlie is involved in a life-threatening car accident. During a brief moment of death, she reunites with her deceased mother, Claire. Charlie survives, but Claire's spirit is determined to keep her.

title: She Devil
description: The author of 32 best-selling romance books takes her accountant away from his frumpy wife. And when this overweight suburban wife discovers what's been going on, she wreaks malicious and delicious revenge.

title: She Freak
description: A waitress leaves the greasy-diner business for the carnival and quickly discovers that she despises freaks and human oddities.

description: Khanyisile is a talented performer who wants to be a star. She travels from her home in Nongoma in Zululand, to audition for a new musical to be staged at the Joburg Theatre. After a couple of detours, she lands a role in the chorus.

title: She Is Love
description: A divorced couple unexpectedly cross paths at a country inn. What starts as an awkward encounter leads them to revisit a love long lost.

title: She Is The Ocean
description: A woman is like the ocean: a force of nature with depths unknown. SHE IS THE OCEAN follows nine extraordinary women - women who live in all corners of the globe, but are united by their love and devotion to the same sea.

title: She Makes Comics
description: This documentary is about the women and their important role in the comic book industry. It includes numerous interviews with icons like Kelly Sue DeConnick, Karen Berger and Jenette Kahn.

title: She Paradise
description: A film about sisterhood and dance, SHE PARADISE is an engaging coming-of-age tale set in the World of Soca dance in Trinidad. Sparkle spends her days taking care of her grandfather when she discovers a free-spirited dance troupe.

title: She Wants Me
description: A neurotic writer working on his new film gets into a tricky situation when an A-list actress shows interest in the role intended for his girlfriend.

title: She's All That
description: A high school jock makes a bet that he can turn an unattractive girl into the school's prom queen.

title: She's Having a Baby
description: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

title: She's on Duty
description: Jea-in, a tough cop with a wild past, goes undercover as a high schooler to catch a gangster. While tracking his daughter, she falls for the charming student No-young—and starts forgetting her mission.

title: She's Out of My League
description: In this comedy, Kirk, an average guy, can’t believe his luck when the successful and gorgeous babe Molly falls for him. His smart-ass friends, his crazy family, and even his obnoxious ex-girlfriend are just as shocked as he is.

title: She's The Man
description: The laughs are non-stop when Viola, disguised as her twin brother, Sebastian, joins the high school boy's soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke, the hot star forward.

title: She-Devil
description: The author of 32 best-selling romance books takes her accountant away from his frumpy wife.  And when this overweight suburban wife discovers what's been going on, she wreaks malicious and delicious revenge...

title: She-Wolves: England’s Early Queens
description: In this series, historian Helen Castor explores seven queens who challenged male power, the fierce reactions they provoked, and whether the term 'She-Wolves' was deserved. Based on her critically acclaimed book 'She-Wolves'.

title: Shelter
description: A homeless Nigerian immigrant (Anthony Mackie) and a junkie (Jennifer Connelly) band together for survival on the streets of New York.

title: Shepherd
description: A young Scottish shepherd, following the death of his unfaithful wife, fights to maintain his own sanity when the past catches up to him.

title: Sheriffs: El Dorado County
description: Cameras follow law enforcement officers from the El Dorado County Sheriff's Department in California as they patrol, answer calls and perform various enforcement duties.

title: Sherlock Bones: Undercover Dog
description: Ten-year-old Billy's plans to spend the summer with his father go awry when Sherlock, a talking police dog, demands his help to rescue his police detective handler who was kidnapped by smugglers.

title: Sherlock Gnomes (ESP)
description: ¡Únete a una aventura fe-gnome-nal en el mundo secreto de los gnomos de jardín! Cuando Gnomeo y Julieta descubren que sus amigos han desaparecido, junto al detective SHERLOCK GNOMES, resuelven el misterio y traen a los gnomos a casa.

title: Sherlock Holmes And The Deadly Necklace
description: Sherlock Holmes and Watson do battle with their nemesis, Professor Moriarity, over an ancient necklace attributed to Cleopatra.

title: Sherlock Holmes And The Secret Weapon
description: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson must protect a Swiss inventor of an advanced weapon

title: Sherlock Holmes and The Secret Weapon (in Color)
description: Kidnappers of the inventor of a new wartime bombsight threaten to sell the invention to the Nazis. In Color!

title: Sherlock Holmes Dressed To Kill
description: Sherlock Holmes must discover why three beautiful women are chasing a mysterious music box

title: Sherlock Holmes y la maldición de Baskerville
description: El Dr. Mortimer no está satisfecho con el veredicto del forense, según el cual la muerte de Sir Charles Baskerville en los páramos fue causada por un ataque cardíaco. Por eso, contrata a Sherlock Holmes para que lo investigue.

title: Sherlock Holmes: Estudio en escarlata
description: Con solo un anillo de bodas y la palabra 'Rache' grabada en la escena del crimen como pistas para la investigación, Sherlock Holmes lidera la búsqueda de un asesino que está empeñado en vengarse.

title: Sherlock Holmes: Prelude to Murder (in Color)
description: A trio of music boxes contains the hidden secret to riches, and a group of criminals will kill for them. In Vibrant Color!

title: Sherri Papini: REELZ Investigates
description: A young mom goes for a run and disappears into thin air, then miraculously shows up 22 days later.

title: Sheryl Crow - Live At The Capitol Theater
description: On November 10, 2017, at the historic Capitol Theatre in Port Chester New York, Sheryl Crow played the final night of her Be Myself tour.

title: Sheryl Underwood: Too Much Information

title: Some Velvet Morning
description: Stanley Tucci stars as a man who surprises his former mistress (Alice Eve), claiming to have left his wife. Before too long, a dark history between the two has come into focus. From Neil LaBute.

title: Somebody Up There Likes Me
description: Nick Offerman (Parks and Recreation) stumbles through life with his best friend and the woman they both adore (Jess Weixler) in this smart, subversive comedy about watching your life fly by.

title: Something from Nothing: The Art of Rap
description: Ice-T travels coast to coast interviewing rap performers such as Q-Tip, Common and Kanye West to pay tribute to the musical art form.

title: Something Like a Business

title: Something to Sing About (1937)
description: Something to Sing About is the high-spirited account of Terry Rooney (James Cagney), a popular band leader with an offer to work in Hollywood. But nothing is ever easy in show business; Rooney learns that being famous is just as troublesome as being unknown. This colorful, comical film was directed by Victor Schertzinger (The Road to Zanzibar) who also wrote the movie's many songs. The movie also features a superb supporting cast which includes William Frawley (I Love Lucy) and Dwight Fry (Dracula).

title: Something Wild
description: A conservative executive accepts a ride with a wild, eccentric woman, who takes him on an outrageous odyssey that turns both their worlds upside down.

title: Something You Said Last Night
description: After being fired from her job, Ren joins her family on vacation. The realities of being a stunted millennial and a trans woman coalesce as Ren struggles to balance yearning for independence with the comfort of being taken care of.

title: Something's Brewing

title: Something's Gonna Live (2012)
description: Ten years in the making, this documentary is an intimate portrait of life, death, friendship, and the movies, as recalled by some of Hollywood's greatest cinema artists.

description: From his day’s in live TV to the big screen, Neufeld’s films include The Omen, No Way Out, The Hunt for Red October and The Equalizer.

Will Proudfoot (Bill Milner) is looking for an escape from his family’s stifling home life when he encounters Lee Carter (Will Poulter), the school bully. Armed with a video camera and a copy of Rambo: First Blood, Lee plans to make cinematic history by filming his own action-packed video epic. Together, these two newfound friends-turned-budding-filmmakers quickly discover that their imaginative – and sometimes mishap-filled – cinematic adventure has begun to take on a life of its own! Entertaining, uplifting, and brimming with nostalgia, Son of Rambow “makes you feel like a kid again” (Ethan Alter, Giant Magazine).

description: Sonic Boom

Following a horrible car accident, a beautiful college freshman finds herself trapped in a twilight world somewhere between life and death in this haunting supernatural thriller.
