description: In this series, Zebra Gamer will be playing through Nintendo's newest adventure on the Nintendo Switch, Splatoon 2. Between the Story Mode, Online Mode, and Salmon Run there will be plenty to do in this series!

title: Splice Here: A Projected Odyssey
description: FILM IS DEAD! The mantra that accompanied the dawn of the digital projection age. But was it really true? Now ten years on from that momentous transition, journey to find out what has really happened to film.

title: Spliced
description: Dr. Moreau finally achieved his goal of creating an island populated by prototype mutant animals: all spliced, and warped into new and bizarre forms. When the Doctor leaves, the island becomes home to a thriving community of

title: Splinter
description: A young couple and an escaped convict find themselves working together to survive and escape from a vicious parasitic monster that transforms people into bloodthirsty hosts.

title: Splish, Splash, Big Red Boat!
description: Set sail on The Wiggles' big red boat for a fantastic ocean journey! Enjoy songs from 'Big Red Boat' to 'Wiggly Party'! Come aboard and get ready to make waves of rippling good fun!

title: Split Decisions
description: A father struggles to keep his family together as his two boxer sons go down two very different paths in the sport: one son is headed for the Olympics and the other is headed for the grave if he does not take a dive in a fixed fight.

title: Split Second
description: In a futuristic London where rising sea levels have placed large areas of the city underwater, a burned-out cop is assigned to investigate a series of bizarre murders that point to a non-human killer.

title: Spookley and the Christmas Kittens
description: Spookley the Square Pumpkin helps a special green cat and three stray kittens find a home and teaches us that it’s never wrong to do the right thing.

title: Spookley: The Square Pumpkin
description: Poor Spookley is a pumpkin who's shape is square rather than round. He's teased and taunted by other mean round pumpkins. But he receives help from a Scarecrow and his 2 bat side-kicks and 3 very funny spiders.

title: Spooks
description: After a shocking death, the group set out to become even stronger in their battle to safeguard the nation.

title: Spoor
description: Janina Duszejko, an elderly woman, lives alone in the Klodzko Valley where a series of mysterious crimes are committed. Duszejko is convinced that she knows who or what is the murderer, but nobody believes her.

title: Sport Fishing on the Fly
description: Join Don Freschi as he travels from the glacier tipped interior of British Columbia all the way to the tropics of Cuba catching different fish. Don and friends demonstrate how to fly fish on a variety of different waters and weather conditions.

title: Sport Fishing TV
description: The history and future of fishing - told one destination at a time. In this season of SFTV, the show explores the evolution of the sport by traveling to some of the most storied fisheries in the world.

title: Sports Car Wars
description: Witness the excitement for the 2008 GT Championship Race. Be sure to catch all 10 episodes full of excitement, thrilling speeds and racing fun.

title: Sports Gone Wild
description: Sports blooper clip show

title: Sports Legends, Hosted by Michael Jordan
description: Host Michael Jordan, winner of six NBA championships, takes viewers on incredible ride as he interviews the biggest names in sports.

title: Sportsman's Adventures
description: Capt. Rick Murphy travels to global hot spots chasing sought-after species with top fishing enthusiasts. Rick’s experiences, humor, conservation focus, tips, and trends deliver entertaining, action-packed episodes guaranteed to share the adventure.

title: Spot Bots
description: Laugh and play along with the Spot Bots as they host fun games and puzzles.

title: Spotlight
description: This critically acclaimed film chronicles the true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered a decades-long cover-up of child abuse within the local Catholic Archdiocese.

title: Spotlight on Christmas
description: Dumped right before Christmas, famous actress Olivia (Tori Anderson, NCIS: Hawai'i) returns to her hometown, where she unexpectedly meets someone new.

title: Spread
description: High-end lothario Nikki (Ashton Kutcher) sleeps his way into a life of privilege all while crashing at the Hollywood Hills home of a middle-aged female attorney (Anne Heche).

title: Spreadsheet
description: Katherine Parkinson stars as a divorced mum of two and working lawyer who develops a spreadsheet to track her active but casual sex life. Before she knows it, matters become complicated.

title: Spree
description: A woman abused by her drug-dealer husband decides enough is enough and it's time to take revenge for the sake of her children.

title: Springtime in the Rockies
description: When cattle-ranch foreman Gene Autry learns that the new ranch owner, Sandra Knight, plans to raise sheep on a scientific basis, he must convince her to sell them as they will ruin the land.

title: Springtime Vibes
description: BIRDS OF A FEATHER (Official Music Video), Calm Down (Official Music Video), Die With A Smile (Official Music Video), Flowers (Official Video), I Like You (A Happier Song) w. Doja Cat [Official Music Video], Peaches, Sunshine & Rain... (Official Video), S

title: Sprinter
description: A Jamaican teen who is burdened by family troubles hopes his meteoric rise in track and field can reunite him with his mother in the US. Executive produced by Will and Jada Pinkett Smith.

title: Spun
description: A drug dealer introduces one of his customers, a 'speed freak', to the man who runs the meth lab. A crazy three-day adventure ensues.

title: Sputnik Declassified
description: On a normal Friday night in America, the Soviet satellite Sputnik is thrust into space-altering the Cold War and space travel forever.

title: Spy
description: Tim is in a custody battle with his ex-wife when he quits his job. He applies for a job as a civil servant doing data entry, but discovers during the job interview that he has been offered a job as a trainee spy for MI5.

title: Spy Kids 4: All the Time in the World
description: The action packed franchise is back…with the next generation of Spy Kids!

title: Spycraft
description: Explore espionage's techniques, tech, and methods. Uncover history's espionage marvels, ingenious inventors, and agents using them. From ancient times to modern intrigue, witness the secrets of covert operations.

title: Squeal
description: Lost in a remote part of Eastern Europe, Sam is a foreigner searching for his biological father when a minor road accident leads to a chance meeting with a pig farmer's daughter, who captures him, making him a slave on the farm.

title: Squirm
description: In the small town of Fly Creek, the power lines fall onto wet soil after a powerful storm, driving large, bloodthirsty worms to the surface. Inundated by carnivorous creatures, the terrorized locals race to find the cause of the rampage!

title: St Paddy
description: Meet Patrick, the cutest leprechaun you’ll ever know on a mission to bring good luck and grant wishes to the whole world! But Goldie the Golden Goos teaches the little leprechaun that for every wish granted, there is a consequence.

title: St. Peter: The Persecution of Christians
description: Following the resurrection of Christ, Peter begins to spread the teachings of Jesus across the world. Journeying to Rome, he experiences the pain & sorrow brought upon the Christians by the Romans.

title: St. Vincent
description: Bill Murray and Melissa McCarthy star in this hilarious comedy about a war vet whose idea of after-school activities for his 12-year-old neighbor includes race tracks and strip clubs.

title: Stacked
description: Twenty-three years after a fly ball determined the outcome of one of the greatest high school baseball games ever played, for the first time ever players from both teams sit down to recant that game, that play, and the effect it's made on their lives.

title: Stadium Championship Series
description: Monster Jam brings you all the action from the Stadium Championship Series in every action packed episode. The race for the championship is on!

title: Stage Door Canteen
description: A young soldier on a pass in New York City finds entertainment and romance when he visits the famed Stage Door Canteen, where famous stars appear and host servicemen during the war. The sensational cast includes Katherine Hepburn, Helen Hayes, Gracie Fields, Edgar Bergen and Charlie McCarthy, Harpo Marx, Gypsy Rose Lee, Ethel Merman, and the always outrageous Tallulah Bankhead. The rollicking comedy directed by two-time Oscar winner Frank Borzage also features great music from some of the top band leaders of the day, including Benny Goodman, Count Basie, and Xavier Cougat!

title: Stage Fright
description: In this genre-bending musical comedy, a starry-eyed teenager stuck in the kitchen of a snobby performing arts camp dreams of Broadway. She sneaks into an audition and lands the lead role. But just as rehearsals begin, blood starts to spill.

title: Stagecoach
description: Dallas is a woman with a past who has been driven out of town by the high-minded ladies of the community. Lucy Mallory is the wife of a cavalry officer stationed in Lordsburg, and she's determined to be with him.

title: Stagecoach: The Texas Jack Story (Apple Tree)
description: A former stagecoach robber is hunted by a vengeful US Marshal.

title: Stagefright
description: While a group of young actors rehearse a new musical about a mass murderer, a notorious psychopath escapes from a nearby insane asylum and is accidentally locked inside the theater with the unsuspecting cast.

title: Stagnation
description: No athlete in action sports wants to train into a robot, risk their lives on the daily and not enjoy it. This isn't about the fake interviews or one of those played out Hollywood style flicks.

title: Stake Land
description: When an epidemic of vampirism strikes and his family is slaughtered, Martin is taken under the wing of a grizzled, wayward hunter whose new prey are the undead. Mister takes Martin on a journey through the locked-down towns of America’s heartland.

title: Stake Land II
description: After his family is murdered, Martin ventures into the American badlands in search of Mister, hoping to reteam with him against a new Vamp threat.

title: Stalag 17
description: Laced with comedy and cynicism, this is the story of a group of GIs who are thrown together in the notorious German prison camp Stalag 17, their suspicions about one being a spy and their efforts to escape.

title: Stalin vs Hitler: The Russian German War
description: A rare look at one of the worst horror stories in the long infamous history of warfare. Here is what really happened between Stalin's Russia and Hitler's Germany on the Eastern Front during World War II.

title: Stalin's James Bond
description: This is a story about ideals, beliefs and betrayal. Richard Sorge fought against Hitler and National Socialism.

title: Stalked By My Doctor
description: A world-renowned but desperate doctor saves a teenage girl after a horrific traffic accident and develops a twisted, sexual obsession with her.

title: Stalked By My Mother
description: When Maddy falls in love with a college guy, her over-protective mom disapproves. Maddy realizes her own mother is a deranged stalker with a twisted desire to kill her boyfriend...or is she?

title: Stalked By My Neighbor
description: A mother and her 18-year-old daughter move to suburbia to help recover from a traumatic home invasion, but a sinister shadow seems to be stalking them.

title: Stalked Within
description: A command center operator becomes increasingly obsessed with a single mother when he begins monitoring her life through his company's residential interior cameras.

title: Stan Lee's Mighty 7
description: Stan Lee encounters a group of actual aliens and teaches them to be a team of superheroes, using their "actual" exploits as comic book stories.

title: Stand By Me: Ben E. King Legacy Live
description: The legendary composer of "Stand By Me," Ben E. King's last live performance in Tokyo, Japan. Previously unreleased songs are included.

title: Stand On It
description: John Schneider's Stand On It: A tribute to throwback southern race movies, where The Duke, played by Schneider, bets half a million dollars in a race against the clock to bring microbrew from Austin to Holden in less than 24 hours.

title: Stand Up Guys
description: Oscar winners Al Pacino, Christopher Walken, and Alan Arkin star in this action-comedy about retired gangsters who reunite for one last epic night.

title: Stand Up Nashville!
description: Aspiring comics from rural America join a popular comedic host to showcase their abilities in front of an audience.

title: Stand Up To Cancer
description: The entertainment community unites in support of Stand Up To Cancer.

title: Stand Your Ground
description: Former Special Forces operative, Jack Johnson, uses the Stand Your Ground law to seek vengeance for his wife's murder, igniting a brutal war against a local crime lord's family and ending in an explosive showdown.

title: Stand-In
description: A New York bank plans to sell a Hollywood studio at a big loss. But the head accountant is suspicious and goes to investigate. He finds chicanery, romance, and help to save the studio.

title: Stand-Up Central
description: Live from Camden's legendary Electric Ballroom, Russell Howard performs stand-up, answers audience questions and presents two stand-up guests.

title: Standby
description: In an Irish airport, a woman waiting standby (Mad Men's Jessica Paré) for a flight home to the US runs into an old flame. They discover they're more compatible than ever, but with an ocean between them, is their second chance meant to be?

title: Standing Ovation
description: About a group of friends competing in a national tween music video contest. Enter a world of hilarious adventures, original songs and never before seen dance routines. You will be left believing in the power of childhood dreams.

title: Standing Up
description: Three unlikely aspiring stand-up comedians – an ultra-Orthodox Jew, a couchsurfing custodian, and a personal injury lawyer – risk everything to find their voices on the cutthroat New York comedy scene.

title: Standing Up For Sunny
description: A reclusive man with cerebral palsy helps a timid comic and discovers love and belonging through stand-up comedy.

title: Stanford Prison Experiment, The
description: Based on the infamous true story, 24 students role-play as prisoners & guards in an experiment that shocked the world. This chilling thriller stars Ezra Miller & Billy Crudup.

title: Stanley & Iris
description: Jane Fonda and Robert De Niro star in a touching story of two people who escape their own private prisons -- he can't read, she's still grieving for her dead husband -- to explore a tender relationship.

title: Stanley and the Dinosaurs
description: Stanley is no ordinary caveman.  He paints, grows a garden and is polite to others including dinosaurs. He leaves his dark, damp cave and builds the world's first house, serenaded in four-part harmony by his dinosaur friends. From a book by Syd Hoff.

title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
description: STAR TREK: DEEP SPACE NINE takes place in the mid-24th century and chronicles the adventures of a team of Starfleet officers who take command of a remote alien space station on the edge of a new frontier.

title: Star Trek: Enterprise
description: STAR TREK: ENTERPRISE takes place during the pioneering days of deep space exploration, when interstellar travel is in its infancy. With their star charts mostly empty, the crew of ENTERPRISE are here to prove they are ready for life among the stars.

title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
description: Picking up decades after Gene Roddenberry's original Star Trek series, The Next Generation follows the intergalactic adventures of Capt. Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his crew aboard the all-new USS Enterprise NCC-1701D as they explore new worlds.

title: Star Trek: The Original Series
description: STAR TREK: THE ORIGINAL SERIES follows the 23rd century adventures of Captain James T. Kirk and the U.S.S. Enterprise, a powerful interstellar spacecraft dispatched by Starfleet to explore the galaxy and seek out new life and civilizations.

title: Star Trek: Voyager
description: The legend continues with Star Trek: Voyager, the newest chapter in the franchise. Catapulted into the distant sector of the galaxy, the Federation's first female captain and her crew encounter strange new worlds in their quest to return home.

title: Starbucks Unfiltered
description: Starbucks is now a part of our daily lives. Like McDonald’s, its 22,000 coffeehouses present in 67 countries have made it a recognizable symbol of globalization. This investigative report explores the brand’s success story and their dark underside.

title: StarCrash
description: An outlaw smuggler and her alien companion are recruited by the Emperor of the Galaxy to rescue his son and destroy a secret weapon by the evil Count Zarth Arn.

title: Stardog and Turbocat
description: When genius cat, Felix, and loyal canine, Buddy, set out to find Buddy's lost owner, they discover not only the power of friendship but their inner superpowers along the way.

title: Stardom
description: In this spellbinding drama, Jessica Paré (“Mad Men”) stars as a young girl who is plucked from small-town obscurity and thrust into the glamorous world of supermodels.

title: Stardust on the Sage
description: When a radio commentator fakes Gene Autry's voice on her show telling cattlemen to invest their money in a hydraulic mining venture rather than in cattle, Gene must correct the error of her ways.

title: Starfish
description: Tom has a perfect life until a devastating illness strikes. This is a story of the survival of love against all odds.

title: Starfish Throwers
description: Though they are worlds apart, a five-star chef, a twelve year-old girl, and a retired schoolteacher discover how their individual efforts to feed the poor ignite a movement in the fight against hunger.

title: Stargate Atlantis
description: Dive into adventure as infinite as the universe itself! When SG-1 discovers the remnants of the Lost City of the Ancients, a new team of explorers travels to the distant Pegasus Galaxy where they discover a deadly enemy that feeds on human fear!

title: Stargate Origins: Catherine
description: 'Stargate Origins' follows Catherine Langford, whose father,  archeologist Paul Langford, discovered the eponymous Stargate in 1928, when Catherine was a young girl. Young Catherine explores the mysteries of the Stargate in an attempt to save Earth.

title: Stargate SG-1
description: Stargate SG-1 picks up where the blockbuster film left off as the SG-1 team sets out to explore the mysteries of the Stargate and the worlds beyond it in the pulse-pounding series which became a worldwide phenomenon and a science fiction classic.

title: Stargate Universe
description: The only mission is survival as a band of soldiers, scientists and civilians must fend for themselves when they are forced through a Stargate, emerging aboard an ancient ship that is locked on an unknown course and unable to return to Earth.

title: Stargate: Continuum
description: In this adrenaline-driven, action-adventure, members of SG-1 find themselves returning to a world where their history has been dramatically altered and the Stargate program never existed! Richard Dean Anderson, Beau Bridges, and Michael Shanks star.

title: Stargate: El arca de la verdad
description: Este emocionante filme continúa la exitosa serie de ciencia ficción. Ahora el equipo élite SG-1 busca un antiguo artefacto que les permitiría derrotar a sus enemigos, los Ori.

title: Stargate: El Continuo
description: Después de que dos miembros del equipo SG-1 desaparecen, el resto del equipo élite militar vuelve a la Tierra y descubre que su propia historia ha sido borrada.

title: Stargate: The Ark of Truth
description: When the SG-1 crew discovers that a final assault on Earth is in the works and a double-agent is scheming among them, their mission takes on a new meaning as they travel to the Ori's home galaxy to overtake their arch enemy before it's too late.

title: Starla & The Jewel Riders
description: A young princess and her friends defend the kingdom of Avalon and the throne of New Camelot against the forces of evil.

title: Starred Up
description: Condemned to an adult prison, an explosively violent young man is forced to fight for survival as criminal forces attempt to control him for their own good. Help comes from the unlikeliest source, his estranged father also serving time.

title: Starry Eyes
description: In the city of dreams, a desperate actress will do whatever it takes for the role of a lifetime…no matter what the cost.

title: Stars at Noon
description: A young American journalist (Margaret Qualley) stranded in Nicaragua seduces an enigmatic Englishman (Joe Alwyn) who seems like her best chance of escape. She soon realizes, though, that their torrid affair has only put her in more danger.

title: Stars Fell Again
description: Sequel to Stars Fell on Alabama. Bryce is ready to propose to Madison while they visit her family for Christmas. However, the spontaneous wedding of Madison’s sister, Harper, throws Bryce’s perfect proposal plans into a tailspin.

title: Stars Fell On Alabama
description: Bryce Dixon is returning to Alabama for the first time in 15 years for his high school reunion. When he learns he's the only one of his friends who isn't married with children, he gets his client, starlet Madison Belle, to pretend to be his girlfriend.

title: Starstruck
description: A Sydney teen tries to make it as a rock singer, with help from her odd 14-year-old cousin.

title: StarTalk Cosmic Queries
description: You have questions, they have answers. Renowned astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson and other top science minds take on fan questions about life and the universe. Uncover a new mind-bending topic each season, from space and physics to nature and more.

title: StarTalk Down to a Science
description: Famed astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson teams up with notable experts to spotlight the most pressing topics that face society. Join them for cosmic perspectives about our planet, economic and political events, and innovations that impact our future.

title: StarTalk Sportiverse
description: Behind every touchdown, goal, and slam dunk is a scientific wonder. Professional athletes and sports science experts join leading scientific mind Neil deGrasse Tyson to discuss the physics, technology, and biology that fuel our favorite games.

title: StarTalk Things You Thought You Knew
description: Science surrounds us every day. Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson takes you from novice to knowledgeable, explaining how planes fly, what makes a rainbow, why hurricanes form, and the many other fascinating wonders that make up our world.

title: StarTalk with Neil deGrasse Tyson
description: Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson and an extraordinary lineup of top field experts dive deep into unique realms of science. Join them for thought-provoking discussions about the theories, discoveries, and phenomena that matter most to us all.

title: Stasis
description: After a night out of partying, Ava wakes up and sneaks back home only to find that she's already safe in bed. But that's not Ava - it's a time-traveling fugitive that has stolen the teenager's body, her identity, and her life.

title: State Like Sleep
description: One year after her husband's (Michiel Huisman) untimely death, a young widow (Katherine Waterston) receives an unsettling phone call that forces her to revisit the past.

title: State Of Grace
description: In this neo-noir crime film, an undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in New York City's Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia, which is now led by two of his childhood friends (Gary Oldman and Ed Harris).

title: State of the Culture
description: Joe Budden and co-hosts Remy Ma, Scottie Beam, Eboni K. Williams, and Brandon “Jinx” Jenkins get straight to the most controversial and challenging conversations in pop culture, politics, social justice, and more — all through the lens of hip hop.

title: State Property
description: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

title: State Property 2: Blood on the Streets
description: Three gangsters vie for power in Philadelphia.

title: State to State
description: State to State travels to every entertaining nook and cranny of America. The biggest events. And the hidden gems. Everything from State to State. Let's hit the road!

title: Staten Island Cakes
description: At work, Vinny is the young prodigy who opened a bakery and employs his family and friends. At home, mom rules and he's just a kid. When you blend family and business, it's only a matter of time before the larger-than-life personalities collide.

title: Stateside
description: The film follows a rebellious teenager on leave from the Marines who falls in love with a female musician. The relationship is threatened when she develops a mental illness...

title: Status Quo: 68-79
description: The rockers from an inside perspective.

title: Status Quo: Live Legends
description: On the 25th anniversary of Status Quo's formation, the band delivers a spectacular concert highlighting every point in their long, glittering career.

title: Statute of Limitations Hosted by Mike "The Situation" Sorrentino
description: "Statute of Limitations" pushes the boundaries of justice as brazen individuals come forward to confess to non-violent crimes that have long surpassed the statute of limitations.

title: Stay Cool
description: An author who returns to his hometown to deliver a commencement address to a class of graduating high school students has to deal with his feelings for an old flame as well as the advances of a student who has the hots for him.

title: Stay Human
description: Award winning musician Michael Franti takes us on a personal journey where he meets extraordinary humans who inspire him to overcome cynicism with optimism in today's challenging times and STAY HUMAN. Featuring new music from Franti's tenth studio album.

title: Stay Hungry
description: Jeff Bridges and Sally Field star in this quirky, sensitive drama about a wealthy Southern bachelor who learns that money and charm have their limitations.  Arnold Schwarzenegger also appears.

title: Stay Prayed Up
description: A spirited celebration of 83-year-old Lena Mae Perry and her legendary North Carolina gospel group The Branchettes.

title: Stay The Night
description: GRACE feels like a romantic outcast, but when she meets CARTER STONE, a professional athlete on the outs, she wonders if maybe he's the perfect solution to her problem.

title: Staycation
description: This show highlights the best vacation rentals in the world that are staycation worthy. Our job is to show the world why these are the most luxurious, unique, and geographically desirable properties you have to see to believe.

title: Steal your heart
description: A mix up over a purchase leaves amateur jeweler, Melissa being enlisted by the CEO of the biggest jewelry company in Miami to help create a bridal line with the CEO's too-serious son Jake.

title: Stealing Charlie Chaplin
description: Shortly after Charlie Chaplin's death, his body disappeared from its grave. After being left initially with no clues - only outrageous rumors - the robbers finally made contact with the family and started a tense, but often comedic game of cat and mouse.

title: Stealing Jokes
description: Comedian Jake Burman and friends head out on tour. After getting stiffed for their pay on their first gig, they rob the venue, which sets the stage for a hilarious Ocean's Eleventype ride through the comedy underworld.

title: Stealing Pulp Fiction
description: A group of enterprising wannabes and their eccentric therapist as they concoct a plot to steal Quentin Tarantino's personal 35mm print of his famous 1994 film.

title: Steam! The Musical
description: A musical thriller about the conductor of a tourist steam train who deserts his boyfriend for a wild night with a real life outlaw.

title: Steamboat Bill Jr.
description: The effete son of a cantankerous riverboat captain comes to join his father's crew.

title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
description: The effete son of a cantankerous riverboat captain comes to join his father's crew.

title: Steel Dawn
description: A nomad warrior must help save a beautiful woman and her young son from a band of henchmen stalking them through the desert after a nuclear war.

title: Steel Tempest: The Last Blitzkreig
description: "Steel Tempest" is the harrowing story of a German unit's mission to take a bridge during the Ardennes offensive, Hitler's last Blitzkrieg. All is clearly lost, but the Commander continues to fight in the face of overwhelming Allied superiority.

title: Stella - A History of War
description: Stella Andrássy fled the Red Army invasion of Hungary in 1945. Born in Sweden, she married into one of Hungary's most influential families. Her world torn apart from the war, she wrote a book about her experiences.

title: Stella Dallas
description: A working-class woman is willing to do whatever it takes to give her daughter a socially promising future.

title: Stella: Live in Boston (2009)
description: Stella is the unique comedy trio known for their critically acclaimed TV series, their long-running nightclub show and their wildly popular series of shorts on the Web. Now Stella are captured live in concert in all of their uncensored glory.

title: Stendhal Syndrome
description: A young policewoman slowly goes insane while tracking down an elusive serial rapist/killer through Italy, when she herself becomes a victim of the brutal man's obsession.

title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
description: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
description: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

title: Stephen King's Silver Bullet
description: Something is killing off townsfolk in Tarker's Mills. Something ingenious. Something remotely human. But the only person in town with courage to stop this lurking menace is a 13-year-old boy, confined to a wheelchair since birth.

title: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
description: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler, and William Sanderson also star. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

title: Stephen King's Thinner
description: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

title: Stephen King's un buen matrimonio
description: Con un asesino serial suelto y un desconocido acosando a su familia, una esposa dedicada revela un secreto sobre su marido que amenaza su matrimonio y sus vidas.

title: Stephen King: A Necessary Evil
description: Featuring rarely-seen interviews, this doc explores the long and successful career of the King of Horror, who has captivated readers for decades.

title: Stephen King: Al filo del abismo
description: Un empresario emergente ha decidido comprar el viejo molino textil de Gates Fall. Para poner su negocio en marcha, se ve obligado a contratar a un grupo de hombres para que le ayuden a despejar los sótanos y a realizar la limpieza del lugar. Conforme avanzan su trabajo, los hombres comienzan a notar cosas extrañas, el lugar no sólo está infestado de ratas, también comienzan a ocurrir cosas sobrenaturales a quienes trabajan durante la noche. Todo se sale de control cuando un empleado fallece de forma misteriosa. Un forastero decide tomar la oportunidad de trabajo, pero le esperará la misma amenaza misteriosa.

title: Stephen King: la bala de plata
description: En esta película de terror, basada en la novela Ciclo del hombre lobo, de Stephen King. Un hombre lobo está aterrorizando a un pequeño pueblo y depende de un niño discapacitado, Marty Coslaw (Corey Haim), y su tío (Gary Busey) para liberar la ciudad de su bestial amenaza.

title: Steppin
description: College students prepare to enter a step-dance competition that features a big money prize. Sororities and fraternities battle to recruit the best talent to help them win.

title: Stepping into Love
description: When her art museum faces money problems, a conventional curator works with an avant garde artist to develop an unconventional exhibit. Can they find a way to work together and find love?

title: Steps Of Faith
description: Steps of Faith is a light-heart dramedy about Faith Houston an accountant, who is directed by God to move to a small town to work on a Hippotherapy farm helping children.

title: Steve Austin's Broken Skull Challenge
description: Hall of Fame professional wrestler Steve Austin invites eight elite athletes to his ranch each week to compete in head to head battles until only one is left standing.

title: Steve Coogan Live: The Man Who Thinks He's It

description: There is only one Yul Brynner. No other actor had his looks, his range of talents, his energy, and his capacity to draw others into the spell of his charm.

title: The Holstein Dilemma
description: What the heck is a heritage breed, anyway, and why should we all care?

title: The Homesman
description: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

title: The Honeymooners Specials: A Christmas Carol
description: The Honeymooners return for their final series of long-lost specials – in color!

title: The Honeymooners: Lost Episodes
description: From 1952-1955 and 1956-1957, 'The Jackie Gleason Show' featured dozens of classic Honeymooners productions broadcast live nationwide on CBS-TV, airing only once.

title: The Honeymooners: The Christmas Special
description: As Christmas approaches, Ralph Kramden's latest get-rich scheme risks his and Alice's life savings -- and trusting pal Ed Norton's holiday bonus -- on the lottery. The gamble also places Alice's mother's Social Security check in jeopardy.

title: The Hoobs
description: Join Iver, Tula, Groove, and Roma on a friendly, fun-filled, journey as they investigate the human world and search for answers to everything Hoobs could ever want to know.

title: The Hooping Life
description: Hula-hooping's back. The Hooping Life's about the rise of a hot new trend: sultry dance, cool culture, slammin' clothes, outer struggle and inner peace. Featuring Shaq O'Neal, The String Cheese Incident, The Scissor Sisters, and a score by Basement Jaxx.

title: The Horde
description: Ex-Navy SEAL John Crenshaw accompanies his fiance and her students on a photo trip deep into the woods. A fun trip turns to horror as they are besieged by a horde of mutated humans. Things worsen and Crenshaw is their only hope to survive.

title: The Hornet's Nest
description: War changes a person. Take an unprecedented journey with an elite group of U.S. troops into battle. A riveting and powerful, authentic look into what was scheduled to be a one day mission yet turned into nine grueling days of combat.

title: The Horror Of Party Beach
description: Sea creatures created from radioactive sludge terrorize a beach community.

title: The Horse Dancer
description: When a promising young gymnast is cut from the Olympic team, she decides to follow her dreams of horseback riding by joining a girl’s horse camp.

title: The Horseman
description: When Christian’s daughter dies, so does any sense of remorse as he searches for vengeance at all costs. Tracking down the men responsible one by one, he reaches a new level of brutality and discovers how far he has to go to settle the score.

title: The Hospital
description: Paddy Chayefsky’s magnificently dark comedy, directed by Arthur Hiller, starring George C. Scott as the Head of Medicine at a hospital where, over one night, everything falls apart. Diana Rigg also stars as the free spirit who arrives just in time.

title: The Host (2013)
description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

title: The Hot Flashes
description: Brooke Shields stars in this raunchy comedy that proves that women over 40 know how to do it better.

title: The Hot Potato
description: Kenny Smith and Danny Nash, a couple of local lads, try to find a buyer for a large lump of misappropriated Uranium, the so-called “hot potato.”

title: The Hot Spot

title: The Hotel Inspector
description: The Hotel Inspector is on a mission: to scare the hell out of the nation's hoteliers and to drag hotels, guest homes and B&Bs out of the doldrums — and up to a standard befitting a top tourist nation.

title: The Hotel Inspector Returns
description: Hotel Inspector Alex Polizzi revisits some of the struggling hoteliers and businesses she previously helped.

title: The Hottest State
description: A young actor from Texas tries to make it in New York while struggling in his relationship with a beautiful singer/songwriter.

title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
description: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

title: The Hour
description: A behind-the-scenes drama and espionage thriller in Cold War-era England that centers on a journalist, a producer, and an anchorman for an investigative news programme.

title: The House in Between
description: A beautiful documentary telling the real story of a homeowner, and the team looking for answers that will move Alice back into her house. This documentary shows a detailed look at what could be the most haunted house in America.

title: The House of the Devil
description: Desperate for quick cash, college sophomore Samantha Hughes takes a babysitting job in the isolated mansion of the creepy Ulman family. Samantha has no idea that a nightmare of unspeakable fear and torment awaits her within these walls.

title: The House Of The Lost On The Cape [English-Language Version]
description: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house overlooking the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.

title: The House Of The Lost On The Cape [Japanese-Language Version]
description: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house overlooking the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.

title: The House Of The Spirits
description: Based on Isabel Allende's best-selling novel, is a hauntingly romantic tale spanning three generations of the Trueba family. At its core is the stormy passionate relationship between the supernaturally gifted Clara and her controlling husband Esteban.

title: The House Of Tomorrow
description: Sebastian is a sixteen-year-old who has spent most of his life with his Nana in their geodesic dome home, a tourist attraction where she raises him on the futurist teachings of her former mentor Buckminster Fuller

title: The House Of Yes
description: Marty just wants a normal life, but that blows up when he brings his fiancée home to meet his far-from-normal family. Soon, Mother is hiding the kitchen knives, but she can't hide the family's shockingly hilarious secrets!

title: The House on Sorority Row
description: After a seemingly innocent prank goes horribly wrong, a group of sorority sisters are stalked and murdered one by one in their sorority house while throwing a party to celebrate their graduation.

title: The House on the Hill
description: After years in a mental hospital, Megan goes home to visit her brother. But once she arrives, her brother has vanished, and no one in town remembers him ever existing. Is Megan losing her mind, or is something more diabolical at work?

title: The House Sitter
description: A family still reeling after the accidental death of one of their daughters, returns home after an aborted month long getaway to Rebecca, a seemingly pleasant house sitter. Since they returned early, Rebecca has nowhere to go, so the family invite her to

title: The House That Never Dies: Reawakening
description: A century after the Zhisheng household murders, relic restorer Song Teng unravels eerie events in the mansion, unveiling a haunting quest for justice from the restless dead.

title: The Houses October Built
description: Looking to find an authentic, blood-curdling good fright for Halloween, five friends set off on a road trip in an RV to track down the ultimate haunted house.

title: The Houses October Built 2
description: Recovering from being kidnapped last Halloween, five friends head back out to visit more haunted house attractions and a new terror begins...

title: The Howling III: The Marsupials
description: A female werewolf runs away from her family and falls in love with a man who works in the movie business, while a sociologist who studies these creatures is looking for proof of their existence.

title: The Howling V: The Rebirth
description: In this fifth installment of 'The Howling' films, a group of people is stranded in an ancient Hungarian castle with a werewolf.

title: The Howling: New Moon Rising
description: A number of brutal, werewolf-like slayings begin occurring in a small California town after the arrival of an unfamiliar motorcyclist.

title: The Human Factor
description: After his family is brutally murdered for an unknown reason, a computer engineer sets out to find those responsible.

title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
description: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII - and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

title: The Humanity Bureau
description: A dystopian thriller set in the year 2030 that sees the world in a permanent state of economic recession and facing serious environmental problems as a result of global warming.

title: The Humbling
description: Based on a Phillip Roth novel, this is the story of an over-the-hill stage actor (Al Pacino, The Godfather) and his controversially invigorating relationship with a young and lustful lesbian (Greta Gerwig, Frances Ha).

title: The Hunt
description: The Hunt is a disturbing depiction of how a lie is taken as truth when gossip, doubt, and malice are allowed to flourish and ignite a witch-hunt that soon threatens to destroy an innocent man’s life.

title: The Hunt For Dark Matter
description: The search for the substance that physicists and astronomers believe holds the universe together.

title: The Hunter (1980)
description: Steve McQueen's last movie shows the dynamic talent of the late, great actor in one of his most memorable roles: The true story of Ralph "Papa" Thorson, a modern day bounty hunter.

title: The Hunter Legacy
description: Grandchildren of big game hunters travel through Kenya to see how to save endangered species.

title: The Hunter's Prayer
description: An assassin (Sam Worthington) helps a young woman avenge the death of her family.

title: The Hunters
description: A group of friends spend a weekend in the woods and find themselves trapped with no way out. They will soon become prey to The Hunters!

title: The Hunting Party
description: A young journalist, a cameraman, and a discredited war correspondent go on an unauthorized mission to find the most wanted war criminal in Bosnia.

title: The Hunting Party (1971)
description: To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

title: The Huntresses
description: When a mysterious assassin begins killing off royal messengers, three female bounty hunters, the Huntresses, are sent to foil the sinister plot. With a large reward on the table, Jin-ok, Hong-dan and Ga-bi team up to bring an end to the murders.

title: The Hurricane Express
description: When his father is killed in a train wreck, Larry Baker vows to unmask a mysterious criminal called "The Wrecker," who has targeted the L&M Railroad for deadly "accidents."

title: The Hybrids Family
description: Two teenage siblings have a secret—they’re the world’s first vampire/witch hybrids! Their supernatural parents have kept them hidden away for years, but when they move to Florida to start a new normal life, a family-filled adventure ensues.

title: The Hydra
description: “The Hydra” is about the rise of ecstasy and other synthetic drugs in Europe after the collapse of the Soviet Union in the early 1990s. The film tells the extraordinary covert operation to bring down the drug cartels.

title: The Hyena Lady - Wolves on the Waterline
description: The brown hyena lives in the coastal regions of Namibia. It provides an example of excellent adjustment in that it has developed a highly unusual hunting behaviour.

title: The Hyperborean
description: A whiskey magnate summons his contentious family to sample his legacy product: casks of Scotch aged 170 years, recovered from a ghost ship in the Canadian Arctic.

title: The Hyperions
description: In this inventive superhero thriller, Professor Mandulbaum grants three kids superpowers, creating the legendary Hyperions. Years later, a high-stakes heist threatens their legacy, forcing the fractured heroes to reunite and battle to save the world.

title: The Hütter Brothers
description: Austrian brothers and pilots, Wolfgang and Ulrich Hutter, have a passion for engineering and aviation that is harnessed by the Luftwaffe in WWII.

title: The Ice King
description: John Curry transformed ice skating from a dated sport into a new artistic medium. Coming out on the night of his Olympic win in 1976, he became the first openly gay Olympian in a time when homosexuality was not even fully legal.

title: The Iceman Cometh
description: Theodore Hickman, a hardware salesman, makes by-yearly visits to Harry Hope's 1910-era waterfront bar for his periodical drinking binges. But on this visit he has decided to try to save the bar's patrons from their "lying pipe dreams."

title: The Iceman of Oetz Valley
description: Enter the mystery of the world's most investigated man - Otzi, an Austrian from the Alps whose corpse was uncovered in 1991, thousands of years after his death. Using modern technology, Kurt Mundl and his team of scientists examine Otzi for a glimpse.

title: The Ideal Husband
description: A couple is joyously expecting their first child, but a secret from the husband's past threatens to destroy their happiness.

title: The Identical
description: The story of twin brothers separated at birth in the Great Depression. With different upbringings, one brother becomes a music legend while the other struggles to find a balance between his passion for music and trying to please his father.

title: The Identity Theft of Mitch Mustain
description: In 2005, Mitch Mustain was the most decorated high school football player in all of America.

title: The Idolmaker (1980)
description: Vinnie Vacarri (Ray Sharkey) has the songs and the voice. He just doesn’t have the face of a teen idol. But Vinnie has a plan: if he can’t be an idol...he’ll create them! Peter Gallagher and Paul Land also star in this parable of ambition and fame.

title: The Illusionist
description: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

title: The Image Revolution
description: In 1992, Marvel Comics was the number-one publisher of comic books in the world, largely due to its dynamic artwork. But as a response to what was believed to be years of mistreatment toward creative talent by the industry's leading publishers.

title: The Imitation Game
description: Benedict Cumberbatch shines as real-life war hero and pioneer of modern-day computing, Alan Turing, who saved millions of lives by cracking Germany's so-called unbreakable code during WWII.

title: The Immaculate Room
description: Secrets and private demons emerge when a young couple joins a psychological experiment to compete for a $5 million prize by isolating themselves in an empty white room for 50 days. No phones, no family...only the room trying to break their resolve.

title: The Immigrant
description: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

title: The Imposter
description: A documentary centered on a young man in Spain who claims to a grieving Texas family that he is their 16-year-old son who has been missing for 3 years.

title: The Imposters
description: Maya splits with her long-term girlfriend and meets the enigmatic Hattie but everything is not as it seems.

title: The Inbetweeners
description: Will McKenzie is on a bad run. His parents have just divorced and, to make matters worse, his mum has moved him from a posh private school and into the sixth form at the local comprehensive.

title: The Incomparable Rose Hartman
description: With a career spanning decades Photographer Rose Hartman is known for her Iconic Photos from Studio 54 and the fashion world, her boisterous personality and ever presence capturing the New York social scene.

title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
description: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah.  Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes.  But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side.

title: The Incredible Journey of Apollo 12
description: It's the ultimate buddy movie. Pete Conrad and Alan Bean were the second pair of Apollo astronauts to land on the moon. They combined precision with a sense of humor. But it was the rocks they picked up that would define the mission's legacy.

title: The Incredible Journey of Mary Bryant
description: A true epic of an extraordinary young woman and her fight for the freedom and dignity of her young family in the penal colony of Botany Bay, on the open seas of the Pacific Ocean, in the fine homes of Timor and in the courts of Georgian England.

title: The Incredible Melting Man
description: In this sci-fi horror thriller, Col. West (Alex Rebar) returns from a trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh will keep him alive! While under observation, West escapes and begins an unending hunt for prey.

title: The Incredible Miniature Fighters
description: During WWII, Germany's incredible 'Miniature Fighter Competition' leads to aeronautical marvels.

title: The Incubus (1982)
description: A small town doctor and sheriff join forces to track down a vicious sex-killer who may be the indestructible incarnation of a demon spawned from hell.

title: The Indian Runner
description: In his writing and directing debut, Sean Penn delivers a profound picture of two very different brothers, one a cop, one a lawbreaking Vietnam vet, who attempt to get through life...one day at a time.

title: The Infinite World of H.G. Wells
description: Brings H.G. Wells' visions to life with an inventive speculation on the origins of his brilliant flights of fantasy.

title: The Inhabitant
description: A teenage descendant of Lizzie Borden grapples with paranoia and her dark family past amid a series of real-life small-town murders in this chilling psychological horror ride.

title: The Initiation
description: After breaking into a department store for a hazing ritual, sorority sisters and their boyfriends are hunted by a deranged killer. Starring Vera Miles (Psycho).

title: The Innkeepers
description: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

title: The Inquiry
description: In 35 A.D., a Roman tribune is sent to Palestine to investigate the death and possible resurrection of a certain Jesus from Nazareth.

title: The Insider: Reggie Yates
description: The Insider sees Reggie Yates live life for real inside some of the world's most brutal institutions.

title: The Insomniac (2016)
description: Believing he'll be robbed again, a burglary victim refuses to sleep until the thief is caught. Certain that the culprit is someone he knows, he grows increasingly unhinged as he scribbles accusations in his notepads.

title: The Inspection
description: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

title: The Inspector General
description: A town's corrupt officials think a fool is actually an investigator in disguise

title: The Instant Gardener
description: Presented by Helen Skelton and expert garden designer Danny Clarke, this refreshing series transforms unloved gardens into beautiful spaces using clever design and imaginative ideas.

title: The Institute
description: Many San Franciscans take part in an elaborate alternate-reality game created by Jeff Hull, but as more players become involved, the game begins to spin out of control.

title: The Instrumental Chemist
description: The Instrumental Chemist features the remarkable life of chemist, inventor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Arnold O. Beckman. His brilliantly designed instruments enabled scientists to answer old questions faster and more accurately.

title: The Insufferable Groo
description: The film follows eccentric, indie filmmaker Stephen Groo as he tries and succeeds in casting super-fan Jack Black (SCHOOL OF ROCK) as the small-town sheriff in his original elf/human romance film.

title: The Integrity of Joseph Chambers
description: Desperate to acquire the skills necessary to provide for his family in case of an apocalypse, insurance salesman Joseph Chambers goes deer hunting for the first time ever, alone, when his experienced buddy is too sick to join him.

title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
description: Hosted by Vivica A. Fox, this true-crime series takes a unique look at the battle of wits between police and suspects in some of the most disturbing US and UK criminal cases in recent years.

title: The Intruder
description: After a whirlwind romance and rushed marriage, Catherine (Charlotte Gainsbourg, 'I'm Not There') moves into her husband's apartment. As strange things begin to happen, she finds herself questioning her own sanity. With Nastassja Kinski & John Hannah.

title: The Invisible Man
description: A scientist suffers a tragic accident in the lab which accidentally turns him invisible. While he works to reverse his ailment, the government puts him to work fighting crime

title: The Invisible War
description: From Oscar- and Emmy-nominated filmmaker Kirby Dick comes THE INVISIBLE WAR, a groundbreaking investigative documentary about one of America's most shameful and best-kept secrets: the epidemic of rape within the U.S. military.

title: The Invisibles
description: While Joseph Goebbels infamously declared Berlin "free of Jews" in 1943, 1,700 managed to survive in the Nazi capital through the end of WWII. The Invisibles traces the stories of four young people who learned to hide in plain sight.

title: The Invitation
description: In this taut psychological thriller by Karyn Kusama (Girlfight, Jennifer's Body), the tension is palpable when Will shows up to his ex-wife Eden and new husband David's dinner party.

title: The Invited
description: A young married couple discovers that a great evil has resided in their new home for nearly a century.

title: The Irish Mob
description: From the Irish gangs of New York in the late 1800s through to the 1970s, this six-part documentary series tells the stories of the first generation Irish kids who became some of America’s most notorious and wanted gangsters.

title: The Irish Pub
description: The Irish Pub is a eulogy to the greatest institution in Irish society, the pub or more specifically the traditional Irish publicans who run them.

title: The Iron Lady
description: OSCAR-winning Meryl Streep is Margaret Thatcher in this insightful and intimate portrait of the first and only female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

title: The Iron Orchard
description: "The Iron Orchard" is the story of Jim McNeely, a young man thrust into  the vibrant and brutal West Texas oilfields in 1939, who works his way through the ranks to ultimately become a formidable wildcatter.

description: The story of one hot night in Alabama as an Independent Pro Wrestling Show rolls into town with its cast of high flying characters in faded tights.

description: Sterling Hayden plays a sheriff with continuing moral dilemmas. Should he relate a deathbed confession which falsely implicates his son in a murder? Should he carry out his threat to cold-bloodedly kill the real murderer or bring him to legal justice?

title: The Island
description: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

title: The Island
description: A cataclysmic event causes a man, who dreams of winning the lottery, to become stranded on an island with his co-workers.

title: The Island Diaries
description: Join host Sophie Fouron as she travels the globe to discover the unique lifestyles found on islands.

title: The Island of Lost Girls
description: When a riptide sweeps three young sisters away, they wash up on an island of sea caves, sea lions, and giant elephant seals and head to a distant lighthouse, learning the importance of never giving up and sticking together along the way.

title: The Island President
description: After bringing democracy to his country, President Mohamed Nasheed of the Maldives, the lowest-lying country in the world, takes up the fight to keep his homeland from disappearing under the sea.

title: The Island with Bear Grylls
description: In this series of epic survival, Bear Grylls maroons two sets of people from different generations on deserted islands. Wearing just the clothes on their backs and armed with some basic tools, which generation is better equipped to survive?

title: The Island with Bear Grylls UK
description: The ultimate survival challenge returns as 16 brave souls are dropped on a remote island in the Pacific. Half the group are high earners, while the other half earn below the UK national average wage.

description: In the age-old clash of IT vs. the corporation, a pair of basement-dwelling dweebs squares off against their cloddish owner-come-lately, with their ambitious but tech-illiterate manager running interference.

description: When a vintage Jack-in-the-box is unearthed and opened, it's new owners soon have reason to believe the creepy clown doll has a life of it's own.

title: The Jack in the Box Rises
description: When Raven is sent to an all-girls boarding school, she unleashes a demon from a vintage Jack-in-the-box prompting a fight for survival.

title: The Jack in the Box: Awakening
description: When a Jack-in-the-box is opened by a dying woman, she makes a deal with the demon within, to be cured in return for it helping it claim six victims.

title: The Jackie Stiles Story
description: The Jackie Stiles Story is an inspirational film about a 5'8" girl from a small Kansas town who became a basketball legend in the Midwest.  Against all odds, Jackie became the all-time leading scorer in NCAA history and the WNBA Rookie-of-the-Year.

title: The Jade Pendant
description: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

title: The James Dean Story
description: This documentary, which was undertaken soon after James Dean's death, looks at Dean's life through the use of still photographs with narration, and interviews with many of the people involved in his short life.

description: A killer comedy that has an ex-cop trailing a serial murderer... and the mayor's sexy daughter! Kevin Kline leads an all-star cast that includes Susan Sarandon, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Harvey Keitel, and Rod Steiger.

description: In this one-man show, Jerry Lewis performs various sketches and bits, exhibiting his multi-faceted talents as a comedian, singer and dancer.

description: In this spin-off of The Big Lebowski directed by and starring John Turturro, bowler Jesus Quintana pairs up with fellow misfits Petey and Marie after his release from prison for a freewheeling joyride of petty crime and romance.
