description: Homeowners hand over their keys, allowing four designers to decorate their homes. Each has three days to decorate a room, then the presenter returns, views their work, shows the couples, and the designers work together on a final room.

title: Your Host
description: Four friends get trapped in a sadistic game show, forced to outwit a twisted serial killer while racing against time. Every move brings them closer to freedom or a gruesome fate.

title: Your Mother Wears Combat Boots
description: When her son quits college to become an Army Ranger, the only way his mom can stop him is to enlist herself. They strike a deal: if she completes basic training, he'll return to college.

title: Your Room or Mine?
description: Four couples compete to prove they have the best taste in home design as they make over replicas of each other's rooms in our mock up room sets in a warehouse studio. But only the best room design in the studio each day will become reality in their home!

title: Yours, Mine & Ours
description: A widowed Coast Guard Admiral and a widow handbag designer fall in love and marry, much to the dismay of her 10 and his 8 children.

title: Yours, Mine and Ours
description: When widowed nurse Helen North (Lucille Ball) meets widower Frank Beardsley (Henry Fonda), a population explosion takes place as her eight kids blend (or don't) with his ten in this chaotic, classic comedy! Van Johnson and Tom Bosley co-star.

title: Youth in Revolt
description: While his trailer trash parents teeter on the edge of divorce, a 14-year-old boy sets his sights on his dream girl, hoping that she'll be the one to take away his virginity.

title: Yowamushi Pedal
description: Sakamichi Onoda is a rather timid, first-year student at Sohoku High School. Upon entering high school, he tried to join the anime research club, but after meeting Shunsuke Imaizumi and Shoukichi Naruko he joins the cycling club.

title: Yowamushi Pedal en español
description: Onoda Sakamichi es un estudiante de primero en la Preparatoria Sohoku, aunque es tímido y lo que más le gusta es el anime. Pero tras encontrarse con Imaizumi Shunsuke y Naruko Shoukichi, Sakamichi acaba uniéndose al competitivo club de ciclismo.

title: Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road
description: Sakamichi Onoda is a rather timid, first-year student at Sohoku High School. Upon entering high school, he tried to join the anime research club, but after meeting Shunsuke Imaizumi and Shoukichi Naruko he joins the cycling club.

title: Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road en español
description: Onoda Sakamichi es un estudiante de primero en la Preparatoria Sohoku, aunque es tímido y lo que más le gusta es el anime. Pero tras encontrarse con Imaizumi Shunsuke y Naruko Shoukichi, Sakamichi acaba uniéndose al competitivo club de ciclismo.

title: Yowamushi Pedal Re: RIDE (ESP)
description: Experimenta la primera temporada de Yowamushi Pedal en Re:RIDE, una compilación que te preparara para Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road.

title: Yowamushi Pedal Re: ROAD (ESP)
description: Re:ROAD es una película que recopila lo mejor de Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road.

title: Yowamushi Pedal Re:RIDE
description: Experience the first season of Yowamushi Pedal in Re:RIDE, a compilation movie to get you pumped for Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road.

title: Yowamushi Pedal Re:ROAD
description: Re:ROAD highlights the best of Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road in this non-stop compilation movie.

title: Yowamushi Pedal: The Movie
description: In this anime classic, Sakamichi his bike team must race against their rivals from Hakone Academy.

title: Yowamushi Pedal: The Movie
description: After an anime-loving teen and his school team win the Inter High tournament, they receive an invitation to compete against their rivals in a race in Kumamoto.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
description: Yu-Gi-Oh! Follows the adventures of high school student Yugi, who has a magical secret that comes to life when he plays his favorite card game: 'Duel Monsters.'

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
description: Welcome to New Domino City! Once the playground to legendary duelist Yugi Muto, this sprawling metropolis has since been transformed into a futuristic society where dueling has kicked into overdrive.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
description: Swing into action with Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V! Yuya Sakaki’s dream is to follow in his father’s footsteps and become the greatest “dueltainer” in history – and he just might pull it off.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Bonds Beyond Time
description: It's a whole new deal! For the first time, Yugi, Jaden & Yusei are together in an all-new adventure!

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! en español
description: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! Sigue las aventuras del estudiante de secundaria Yugi, quien tiene un secreto mágico que cobra vida cuando juega su juego de cartas favorito: 'Duel Monsters'.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
description: Set several years after the previous Yu-Gi-Oh! series, GX follows a new generation of duelists at the prestigious Duel Academy—a highly competitive boarding school where pencils and books have been replaced by Duel Disks and monster cards!

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions
description: The stakes have never been higher, the rivalries never as fierce, the risks never so great. One wrong move - one card short - and it's game over for good.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Movie
description: Heroic Yugi squares off against archrival Kaiba in an adventure even more dangerous when the imaginary monsters in their playing cards become ferociously real…and when an old evil enters the fray.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
description: Welcome to the world of Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS, where virtual reality, artificial intelligence, and high-speed dueling merge into a fighting extravaganza!

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS en español
description: ¡Bienvenido al mundo de Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS, donde la realidad virtual, la inteligencia artificial y los duelos de alta velocidad se fusionan en un espectáculo de lucha.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
description: When aspiring duelist Yuma meets Astral, a mysterious visitor from another universe, it seems like destiny. Yuma needs Astral to teach him how to duel, and Astral needs Yuma to help him regain his memories.

title: Yukon Gold
description: Yukon Gold follows four gold mining crews who have only four short months in Canada’s wild Yukon to earn one BIG payday.

title: Yul Brynner: The Man Who Was King
description: There is only one Yul Brynner. No other actor had his looks, his range of talents, his energy, and his capacity to draw others into the spell of his charm.

title: Yummy Yummy
description: Get set for a deliciously good time with The Wiggles! They've re-recorded all of your favorite songs and added some new treats for you to enjoy, with brighter colors, brighter sounds and a whole lot of fun!

title: Yves Saint Laurent
description: Following a rise to fame in the wake of Christian Dior's death, YVES SAINT LAURENT is a captivating story about the making of a fashion icon and a testament to the power of enduring love.

title: Z Channel: A Magnificent Obsession
description: Xan Cassavetes' film explores the euphoric rise and tragic descent of Z Channel, Los Angeles’ first pay cable service and its virtuosic film programmer Jerry Harvey.

title: Z For Zachariah
description: Chris Pine, Margot Robbie and Chiwetel Ejiofor are the last three people on earth, struggling to survive, secrets, suspicions and threats in this intense thriller based on the award-winning book.

title: Z Nation
description: In the midst of a devastating zombie apocalypse, a team of everyday heroes must transport the only known survivor of the virus across the country to the last functioning viral lab.

title: Z Nation en español
description: En medio de un apocalipsis zombi, un equipo de héroes cotidianos debe transportar al único superviviente conocido del virus por todo el país hasta el último laboratorio viral en funcionamiento.

title: Z Special: Australia's Secret Heroes
description: This series uncovers a dramatic forgotten episode of Australia's Second World War involvement.

title: Z/X Ignition
description: Five portals to different parallel worlds suddenly appear. Each must fight for survival with the key being the card device that can capture the invading Z/X creatures from the other worlds.

title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
description: In order to resolve their financial woes, lifelong platonic friends Zack and Miri decide to produce a porno film.

title: Zambezi Crescent
description: Building a 5-star safari lodge in Zimbabwe was a near-impossible task for four friends. Managing wild animals, missing building materials and endless red tape are the most significant challenges they have ever encountered.

title: Zara: The World's Richest Man
description: One of the world's iconic fashion moguls is explored in this documentary. Armancio Ortega, founder of Zara, is profiled in a doc that delves into the secret to Zara's success in the French fashion world and beyond.

title: Zarra's Law
description: A retired detective, Tony Zarra (Tony Sirico) is pushed into the world of crime after the murder of his younger brother.

title: Zatiochi: Darkness is His Ally
description: This thrilling martial arts epic finds nomadic hero Zatôichi in the middle of a bloody turf war between two rival clans.   It is a blood-stained epic that shows the facilities of a man at odds with the Bushido Code.

title: Zedd - True Colors
description: Embark on a career journey with multi-platinum, Grammy winning, EDM artist Zedd.

title: Zeitgeist
description: Zeitgeist: The Movie (2007) is a treatment on Mythology and Belief in society today presenting uncommon perspectives of common cultural issues. Chapter 1 presents historical data relating to the astronomical/astrological origins of the Judeo-Christian theology. Chapter 2 presents a alternative view of the events of Sept. 11th 2001. Chapter 3 presents a shotgun tour through the subjects of Central Banking, War Pretexts, Banking Panics, the Military Industrial Complex, Media Culture and ultimately the mental neurosis and deadly addiction known as Power.

title: Zenith – Advances In Space Exploration
description: A revolution in space technology is unfolding. New players in the launch industry are radically cutting the cost of access to space.

title: Zero Charisma
description: In this darkly comedic ode to nerds from every realm, a passionate Game Master of a fantasy role-playing game becomes unhinged when a charismatic hipster joins his group, disrupting the balance of power with an unexpected coup.

title: Zero Tolerance
description:
Johnny and Peter, former paramilitary operatives, search Bangkok - leaving carnage in their wake - to find the men who killed Johnny's daughter, Angel. (2015)

Rated R

title: Zeros And Ones
description: Ethan Hawke and Abel Ferrara join forces for this gritty, tense political thriller set in one deadly night in Rome as a soldier (Hawke) races to stop an imminent terrorist bombing.

title: ZHC
description: Join the fun with the wildly popular artist Zach Hsieh as he makes the world a brighter place — one customized painting at a time.

title: Zig Zag
description: An autistic 15-year-old boy steals money from his boss to provide rent for his abusive father, who uses the money to repay a loan shark.

title: Zimbelism
description: Remarkable tales from the darkroom on Marilyn Monroe, JFK and others, from one of the last working elders of street photography: humanist photographer George S. Zimbel.

title: Zinba
description: Kan stumbles into a world where humans live with beings called Zinba. Kan discovers his abilities as a Linker, and sets off on numerous adventures with his Zinba Kingstar, and their many friends.

title: Zodiac
description: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

title: Zodiaco
description: La película está basada en los libros de Robert Graysmith sobre la vida real del famoso Zodiaco, un asesino serial que aterrorizó San Francisco mediante aparentes homicidios aleatorios durante las décadas del 60 y 70.

title: Zoe Gone
description: Sixteen-year-old Jennifer life changes when she gives birth to baby Zoe. Her boyfriend Randy refuses to help and her mother Alicia is not interested in raising another child. But when Zoe is kidnapped, Jennifer will stop at nothing to find her baby.

title: Zoe va a tener un bebé
description: Zoe quiere un bebé. Soltera y cansada del ambiente de citas neoyorquino, decide vivir sola. Con la ayuda de un donante anónimo, Zoe queda embarazada. Pero las cosas se complican cuando dos solteros entraban en su vida...

title: Zoey 101
description: Zoey Brooks is making history by being one of the first girls to attend Pacific Coast Academy, an elite former all-boys boarding school. Zoey is an independent and outgoing 13-year-old, who is out to leave her mark on PCA.

title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
description: With his nightmare job no longer, Akira's got his mojo back. Let the bucket listing begin!

title: Zombeavers
description: They're ferocious, they're furry, they're ZOMBEAVERS, the stars of this 2015 horror-comedy, directed by Jordan Rubin. When a trio of sexy college girls (Cortney Palm, Rachel Melvin, Lexi Atkins) arrive at a remote cabin for a weekend getaway.

title: Zombie
description: Tisa Farrow, Ian McCulloch, Al Cliver, and Richard Johnson star in this worldwide splatter sensation directed by Lucio Fulci that remains one of the most eye-skewering, skin-ripping, gore-gushingly graphic horror hits of all time!

title: Zombie House Flipping
description: In “Zombie House Flipping,” millennial house flipper Justin Stamper and his team of renovators have found a solution to Florida's the abandoned, rundown homes. As the “Robin Hoods of Real Estate” in Orlando.

title: Zombie Hunter
description: The world is turned into a wasteland full of zombies, and one man hunts down flesh eaters with his car and guns. He meets a group of survivors and helps them survive, putting his skills to the test.

title: Zombie Night
description: As night falls in a small California town, the dead rise from its graves, mausoleums, and morgues. The townspeople must fight to survive until sunrise.

title: Zombie Shark
description: A perfect getaway weekend turns into a nightmare for four friends who find themselves fighting for their lives against an experimental shark. In order to survive, they must fight sharks, zombies, and shark zombies.

title: Zombies
description: In this fantastical horror film, a widow (Lori Heuring) and her two daughters (Scout Taylor-Compton, Chloë Grace Moretz) inherit a remote house where zombie children roam the woods.

title: Zombiology: Enjoy Yourself Tonight
description: When a monster from a popular animated show appears and starts a zombie outbreak, it's up to eccentric duo Lung and Chi-Yeung to stand up and fight the horde of the recently deceased, and save their friends from all around chaos!

title: Zona de peligro
description: Cuando el desastre ataca y la tragedia es inminente, solo hay una esperanza en la zona de peligro: rescatistas, paramédicos, y médicos altamente entrenados. Sus trabajos son peligrosos, y sus rescates, dramáticos.

title: Zona mortal (LAS)
description: Después de un accidente vehicular, un hombre se despierta amnésico. Mientras busca por ayuda, solo encuentra cadáveres. Luego descubrirá la horrible verdad, cualquier ser viviente que esté a 50 pies de radio de él morirá instantáneamente.

title: Zone 414
description: Guy Pearce, Matilda Lutz, and Travis Fimmel star in the sci-fi thriller set in Zone 414, a colony of humanoids known as "the city of robots." The colony's creator hires private investigator David Carmichael to track down his missing daughter.

title: Zoo Babies
description: A heart warming and inspiring series that welcomes the arrival of new members of the animal kingdom in Zoo's around the world, as well as showcasing endangered species being born in captivity.

title: Zoo Clues
description: We'll investigate some incredible animal tails and discover why some animals have them. - and some don't.

title: Zoom
description: A comic book artist, a novelist and a film director are connected by a multi-dimensional interface. Each lives in a separate reality but writes a story about one of the others. With Gael García Bernal and Alison Pill.

title: Zoom Zoom Zoom With Baby Shark
description: Hmm... What will it be? How fun it is to learn the words by doing the zoom to everything!

title: Zorro
description: In the New World, a new Spanish governor finds the province of Nueva Aragón under the iron fist of the corrupt Colonel Huerta and vows to bring justice under the guise of a masked avenger.

title: Zorro's Black Whip -1st Female Zorro
description: Hammond, owner of the town's stagecoach line & a leading citizen, is secretly opposed to Idaho becoming a state, & conducts raids against citizens to prevent order.

title: Zorro's Fighting Legion
description: Mysterious Don Del Oro "Lord of Gold", an idol of the Yaqui tribe, emerges & attacks the gold trade of the Republic of Mexico, intent on becoming Emperor.

title: ZoZo el demonio de la tabla Ouija
description: Basada en hechos reales, cinco amigos juegan con una ouija y despiertan una presencia demoníaca que transforma su curiosidad en una pesadilla. Filmada en Super 8, su estilo crudo intensifica el terror psicológico.

title: Zulu
description: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

title: Zulu (2013)
description: Based on the novel by Caryl Férey. Set against the backdrop of post-apartheid South Africa, two South African police officers on opposing sides of the apartheid divide work together to fight crime.

title: Zyzzyx Road
description: Two adulterous lovers head to the desert to bury the corpse of her jealous boyfriend, only to discover that the body is missing from the trunk.

title: ZZ Top: Live at Montreux 2013
description: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances.

title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!
description: Un desenlace explosivo aguarda a un terrorista irlandés (James Coburn) obsesionado con la dinamita, quien se alía con un campesino mexicano convertido en revolucionario (Rod Steiger) en este trepidante relato de poder y política.

title: ¡ALTO! Frontera
description: Alto! Frontera te lleva a las fronteras de México, Brasil, Colombia, Chile, Bolivia y Perú, donde miles arriesgan todo para burlar los controles.

title: ¡ALTO! Frontera
description: ¡Alto! Frontera te lleva a las fronteras de México, Brasil, Colombia, Chile, Bolivia y Perú, donde miles arriesgan todo para burlar los controles.

title: ¡Ay, qué hijo!
description: El jugador más grande en la historia de Ridgefield College usa su influencia y reputación para conseguir que su único hijo; un enfermizo y descoordinado nerd, forme parte del equipo universitario de fútbol con resultados cómicos.

title: ¡Buenos días, Navidad!
description: Dos peleadores presentadores de televisión son enviados a un pequeño pueblo festivo en Navidad. Mientras fingen llevarse bien, descubren que hay más entre ellos de lo que pensaban.

title: ¡Bum, Bum! Mundo Dino
description: ¡Aquí vamos! ¡Bum-bum, Mundo Dino!

title: ¡Pinkfong! Especial de tiburón bebé
description: ¿Quieres pasar el tiempo con tiburón bebé? ¡Los mejores episodios de las canciones de la familia tiburón te están esperando!

title: ¡Ripley's, aunque usted no lo crea!
description: Únanse a Michael “Rip” Ripley, sobrino del célebre Robert Ripley, mientras recorre el mundo para descubrir historias extrañas y artefactos extraños.

title: ¡Salud por eso!
description: El chef José del Castillo nos cuenta los valores que lo ayudaron en su camino hacia la maestría y lo comparte con la nueva generación de cocineros que tienen el mismo objetivo. Mira las deliciosas propuestas gastronómicas que tienen para ti.

title: ¡Sigue la risa!
description: Entre Nos is a laugh-out-loud comedy special featuring top U.S. Latino comedians. Tune in for an evening of sure-fire entertainment, as the funniest folks in comedy share personal, yet universal, stories about life, love, and being Latino.

title: ¡Todos quieren algo!
description: Es 1980, Jake y sus locos amigos, estudiantes de primer año, viven su odisea con fiestas y partidos justo antes de comenzar las clases. Del guionista y director Richard Linklater, llega la película que demuestra que los buenos tiempos nunca envejecen.

title: ¡Átame!
description: Un desequilibrado pero seductor ex-paciente con problemas mentales toma a una estrella porno prisionera con la esperanza de convencerla de que se case con él.

title: ¿Alguien ha visto a Lupita?
description: Lupita se ve obligada a separarse de su familia pues quieren internarla en un hospital. Comienza así un viaje, en el cual ella nos llevará a descubrir un mundo que, al parecer, está mucho más loco que ella.

title: ¿Justicia y Olvido?
description: Este documental atraviesa las vidas de víctimas, victimarios, guerrilleros, rehenes políticos y autoridades del más alto nivel, y los desafíos de un proceso sin precedentes.

title: ¿Quién Diablos Es Juliette?
description: Es una historia verdadera, una ficción robada de la realidad, que comienza con el sorprendente paralelismo entre dos mujeres de piel dorada y ojos verdes: Juliette, una adolescente cubana, y Fabiola una modelo mexicana que vive en Manhattan.

title: ¿Quién es quién?
description: Dos hermanos gemelos, Perico y Leonardo, son tan idénticos que ni su madre podría diferenciarlos. Fueron separados al nacer y les tocó vivir vidas opuestas. Se reúnen tras años separados, esta vez, intercambian roles con resultados muy divertidos.

title: ¿Qué haría Jesús? 2: El tallador de madera
description: Matthew es un chico rebelde que destruye la iglesia que su padre está renovando como carpintero. Trabajando se dan cuenta que todo es posible con fe, familia y amistad.

title: ¿Qué le dijiste a Dios?
description: Martina y Lupita son empleadas domésticas que arriesgan todo por amor. Toman prestada la ropa de su jefa y viajan a su pueblo natal, pero su jefa les está pisando los talones. Una comedia musical inspirada en las canciones de Juan Gabriel.

title: ¿Soy Niño o Niña?
description: Desde el momento en que nace un bebé, lo primero que la gente quiere saber es si es niño o niña. ¿Qué sucede cuando sabes quién eres por dentro, pero el mundo exterior ve algo diferente?

title: ¿Y dónde está el piloto?
description: Considerada "una de las 10 películas más divertidas de la historia" por el American Film Institute, "¿Y dónde está el piloto?" es una obra maestra de la comedia de disparate.

title: ¿Y dónde está el piloto? II
description: El primer transbordador espacial comercial envía al chiflado Ted (Robert Hays) y a su exnovia (Julie Hagerty) a un viaje a la Luna.

title: Évocateur: The Morton Downey Jr. Movie
description: In the late '80s, Morton Downey Jr. tore apart the traditional talk format by turning debate of current issues into a gladiator pit. His blow-smoke-in-your-face style drew a rabid cult following, but also the title "Father of Trash Television."

title: Íconos de nuestra era: Che Guevara
description: La imagen del Che es un fenómeno mundial, visto en todas partes, desde los barrios más pobres hasta las ciudades más ricas. ¿Pero la verdadera historia del Che Guevara se ha separado completamente del ícono?

title: Última oportunidad para Navidad
description: Justo antes de Navidad, el encargado del almacén de Santa debe apresurarse a encontrar un reemplazo para un reno herido. Cuando encuentra uno, surgen complicaciones y amor.

title: Último viaje a Las Vegas
description: Cuatro mejores amigos de toda la vida van a Las Vegas para dejar de portarse como adultos de su edad y revivir sus días de gloria. Al llegar, se dan cuenta de que las décadas transformaron Sin City y pusieron a prueba su amistad de manera impensada.

title: Únicos: Papa Francisco
description: Preserva la memoria del Papa Francisco tras su fallecimiento. El primer Papa latinoamericano se hizo famoso por su humildad y compromiso con la justicia social.
